# dsh-model-gear

DSH 输入框里的模型挡位面板：模型选择、推理强度滑条、显示名，外加闪电编排三档。
它只注入编排相关的契约、每轮提醒、子会话分层说明和关闭提示；除此之外不注入人设、身份或核查段落。

## 前置条件

- 使用带有 `dsh plugin` CLI 的 DSH 桌面版，并选择一个启用 Web 客户端的 profile。
- 该 profile 需要提供插件使用的 Connection RPC、模型目录、槽位注册和 `agent/pre-step` 宿主服务；正常通过 DSH profile 安装时由宿主提供。
- 只有从源码构建或运行本地测试时才需要 Node.js `>=20`；GitHub 安装直接使用仓库内已提交的 `lib/` 构建产物。
- 若要让「超快」的第二层实际创建孙代理，宿主的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent` 有效配置需要 `maxDepth: 2`；本插件的 [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml) 只插入本插件，不修改这个宿主参数。

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chenyuxuan-official/dsh-model-gear
```

将 `desktop` 替换成实际 profile 名称。安装后重启 DSH；插件会出现在该 profile 的 `package.json` 依赖中。卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-model-gear
```

> `dsh plugin --profile <名字> <参数>` 使用 DSH 桌面版自带 CLI。GitHub 安装会锁定仓库提交；仓库有新提交后重新执行一次 `add` 才会更新。

## 实现

### 面板（`src/model-ui.js`）

面板注册在 `conversation.input.model` 槽位上（priority `-10`），槽位的 `inject(sessionId)` 返回四样东西：

| prop | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `directory` / `load` / `select` | 宿主模型目录的 store、加载和选中写入（`select()` 直接落到宿主的模型选择上） |
| `gear.read` / `gear.select` | 编排档位的读与写，走下面那条宿主路由 |
| `available` | 子会话里为 `false`，面板不提供选择 |

- **模型列表**：按 provider 分组，支持搜索；「默认」组只显示最常用的那一个模型（按使用频次统计，`dsh-model-gear/model-usage`，只在本机 localStorage）。
- **强度滑条**：档位全部来自宿主目录里该模型的 `reasoning.efforts`，不额外造虚拟档；拖动时只改本地预览，松手/键盘操作才写回；「重置」写回模型自己的 `defaultEffort`。
- **显示名**：以 `provider/model` 为键存在本机 localStorage（键名沿用旧版的 `dsh-codex-ui/model-aliases`），只影响列表里的显示。
- **模型名装饰**：平台把「1017」这类发布徽标挂在 `conversation.input.model.label` 子槽位上，而该子槽位只能由声明它的官方模型选择组件渲染——本插件替换了整个 composer 控件，框架不允许第二个注册项复用该子槽位，所以这类装饰不会出现在本面板里。
- **档位未知**：读不到宿主状态时不猜「标准」，滑条不画填充、闪电显示为灰、三档菜单禁用并提示「未同步」。

**档位状态**由宿主持有，客户端只做三件事：挂载时读一次、切换时乐观更新（失败回滚）、每次打开面板再对齐一次。重读不会先清空当前值，早到的旧响应按序号丢弃，所以状态不会被来回覆盖。

### 编排（`src/host.js`）

**路由**：`POST /api/dsh-model-gear/orchestration`，走 DSH 的 Connection 载体，信封是 `client-request` / `server-response`，用 `rpcId` 对齐。

```jsonc
{ "action": "read",   "sessionId": "…" }                  // → { mode: "off" | "fast" | "tree" }
{ "action": "update", "sessionId": "…", "mode": "tree" }  // 同上
```

校验失败返回 `{ ok: false, error: { code, message, details: {} } }`——`details` 不能省，客户端的响应解析器要求它是对象，缺了会把所有校验错误变成解析失败。

**状态**：`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-model-gear-orchestration.json`（没有 `DSH_HOME` 时落在 `~/.dsh/storages/`）。

```jsonc
{ "sessions": { "<sessionId>": { "mode": "fast", "at": 1730000000000 } } }
```

最多保留 40 个会话，`off` 即删行；写盘是「临时文件 + rename」的原子写，失败只记一条 warn，内存里的值继续生效。

**注入**：`agent/pre-step` 是一个 waterfall，处理器先调用 `next()` 拿到框架的决定，再按会话往里追加消息（`source.kind = "plugin:dsh-model-gear"`，`form: "instructions"`）。

| 会话 | 追加内容 |
|---|---|
| 父会话 · `fast` | `LIGHTNING_POLICY`（首次或换档时） |
| 父会话 · `tree` | `LIGHTNING_POLICY` + `SUPERFAST_POLICY` |
| 父会话 · 每轮 step 1–3 | 一条提醒，文本里带 `turn` 和 `step`，所以每轮每条都不同 |
| 父会话 · 切回 `off` | 一次性关闭说明，条件是「本插件在日志里留下的最新一条不是这条说明」 |
| 子会话 | 只按自己提示词首行的 `Tier: N of 2` 拿到对应分层说明；没有这一行就什么都不注入 |

**去重**不看进程内记忆，只看载体：本次 step 的消息、`session.deriveMessages()` 的日志、两个 inbox 队列。这样被丢弃的 step 不会让契约永久消失，日志被压缩后也会自动补回；切换档位时以「日志里最新的那份契约」为准，换档必然重新声明。

整个注入和路由都用 try/catch 兜底：写盘、日志、路由、注入任何一处失败，都不会影响宿主的一步或一个请求。

**超快的第二层**：`SUPERFAST_POLICY` 要求 tier-1 子代理各自再开两个孙代理，但宿主默认只允许直接子代理（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent` 的 `maxDepth` 默认 `1`），所以默认安装下超快实际就是 2 个子代理。要把第二层跑起来，把 `maxDepth` 调到 `2`——改法、验证和回滚见 [docs/subagent-depth.md](docs/subagent-depth.md)。

### 官方子代理模型选择兼容（`src/subagent-routing.js`）

宿主存在 `subagentModelSelection` 服务且其同步 `current()` 返回 `enabled: true` 时，父会话每步会收到一条独立的 advisory：分别列出官方允许模型（`available`）与项目路由推荐（`recommended`），并明确真正约束由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`/宿主持有；本插件只提醒，不伪造强制。当前已确认的官方接口只提供 `enabled` 与 `allowedModels`，未确认 cooldown/status 字段，因此插件不会从未知字段推断冷却；冷却状态仍以宿主/CPA 请求日志为准。服务缺失、关闭、异常、异步 getter 或形状不匹配时不追加任何新消息，原有 fast/tree 行为保持不变。官方允许列表按 provider+model 去重；既有子会话策略仍由宿主冻结，本插件不写 projection、不创建子代理。宿主日志会记录不含提示词/token 的 `session`、`mode`、匹配 `route` 和 `selectedModel` 字段。

#### 配置项目路由

仓库可以在工作区的 `agents.md` 或 `AGENTS.md` 中声明“任务类型/关键词 → 推荐模型”。本仓库自带一份示例配置，见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)。最小结构如下：

````md
<!-- dsh-model-gear:routes-v1 -->
```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "routes": [
    {
      "id": "implementation",
      "match": { "taskType": "implementation", "keywords": ["新功能"] },
      "target": { "provider": "cpa", "model": "gpt-6.1-terra" },
      "effort": "high",
      "priority": 50
    }
  ]
}
```
````

只有 marker 后紧邻的 `json` 代码块会被读取；普通工作区指令、自然语言、YAML front matter 和无标记内容全部忽略。程序从当前工作目录向上查找最近的配置，同一目录下 `agents.md` 优先于 `AGENTS.md`。`match` 可以使用 `taskType`、`keywords` 或两者；`priority` 越大越优先展示。路由只渲染为 advisory：若目标不在官方 allowlist 中会标为 `unavailable`，不会绕过宿主约束。

要看到这条提示，需要同时满足：官方模型选择服务已启用、当前是父会话、工作目录能定位到配置文件，并且 DSH 已重启加载最新宿主代码。关闭或缺少官方服务时，原有 fast/tree 行为保持不变。

### 提示词（`src/orchestration-policy.js`）

Lightning / Superfast 契约原文逐字取自上游（含原编号），另外提供 `fastNudge` / `treeNudge`（每轮提醒）、`CHILD_NOTE_ONE` / `CHILD_NOTE_TWO`（子会话分层）、`OFF_NOTICE`（关闭说明）。这一层只导出文本，不发任何请求。

### 样式（`src/style.css` + `src/client.js`）

- **光带**只落在「已填充到当前档位」的那一段：shell 上写入 `--cg-fill-width`（与填充同宽）和 `--cg-meteor-travel`，CSS 把光带层裁到该宽度；`off` / 档位未知时组件不渲染该层，样式表另有一条 `display: none !important` 硬停。
- **模式配色**由根节点上的 `data-lightning="true"` / `data-superfast="true"` 驱动：快速整条滑条（填充、圆点、滑块、光带、描边）走紫色，超快走金色，标准档保留各档位自己的色阶；未命名的档位 id 也落模式色，不会掉回蓝色。
- **闪电颜色**按模式内联写进 `style.color`（`--cg-fast-ink` / `--cg-tree-ink`，深浅主题各一套），不依赖属性选择器链——任意一帧属性没落地也不会闪回紫色。
- **样式表只能有一个写者**：最后一个加载的实例通过页面全局令牌认领 `<style>`，旧实例的「每秒修复」计时器看到令牌不是自己的就直接退出。热重载时新旧两套 CSS 不会每秒轮流覆盖（那会让所有改过颜色的控件以 1 Hz 闪烁）。

## 目录结构

```
src/model-ui.js              面板本体（模型目录 / 强度滑条 / 改名 / 默认组 / 闪电与三档菜单）
src/client.js                客户端 apply：装样式表 + 注册面板（inject 为空）
src/host.js                  宿主 apply：编排路由 + agent/pre-step 注入
src/orchestration-policy.js  闪电 / 树契约原文、每轮提醒、子会话分层说明、关闭提示
src/subagent-routing.js      官方模型选择兼容与 agents 路由 advisory
src/style.css                面板规则、模式配色、光带
AGENTS.md                    本仓库的显式任务路由与协作约定
src/alias-sync.js            显示名的 localStorage 读写
src/providers.js             提供商参考清单（静态数据）
lib/client.js                客户端构建产物（提交进仓库）
lib/index.js                 宿主入口，re-export src/host.js
scripts/build.mjs            把客户端模块拼成 lib/client.js（确定性输出）
scripts/extract-css.mjs      从上游样式表筛出面板规则（开发工具）
tests/                       五个 Node 测试，见下
docs/subagent-depth.md       子代理深度：让「超快」长出第二层（宿主侧配置）
```

## 模型档位与 profile 配置

模型强度不在插件内硬编码。插件读取 DSH 当前 profile 组合后的模型目录，并使用模型自身暴露的档位：

```text
profile/CPA reasoningEfforts
        ↓
DSH model directory
        ↓
dsh-model-gear UI
        ↓
directory.select({ reasoningEffort: 原始档位 ID })
```

因此不同用户安装同一个插件时，会显示各自 profile 实际提供的档位。`max`、`xhigh`、`ultra` 和未来新增 ID 都保持原值，不会互相映射。插件兼容 `reasoning.efforts`、`reasoning.levels` 和 `reasoning.reasoningEfforts` 三种目录形状。

如果要让某个用户的 GPT 模型出现 Ultra，需要在该用户的 profile/CPA 模型配置中声明：

```yaml
reasoningEfforts:
  low: low
  medium: medium
  high: high
  xhigh: xhigh
  ultra: ultra
```

重启 DSH 后，模型目录会重新组合，插件再读取并显示 Ultra。插件本身不会给没有声明或上游不支持的模型虚构档位；这样 UI 中显示的值与实际提交给宿主的 `reasoningEffort` 保持一致。

### 一键修复档位（1.3.0）

档位少于该系列常见配置时（例如 GPT 只暴露到 `xhigh`），强度面板底部会出现诊断和「查看档位修复方案」按钮：

```text
档位诊断：当前 profile 已暴露 low、medium、high、xhigh；缺少 ultra 时可一键补齐，然后重启 DSH。
[查看档位修复方案]
  → 将向 C:\Users\<用户>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml 的 gpt-6.1-sol 追加：ultra
  [写入 profile] [取消]
  → 已写入 …，重启 DSH 后生效。备份：…cordis.patch.yml.bak-2026-11-17T09-30-00-000Z
```

写入规则：

- 只在该模型自己的 `reasoningEfforts:` 块里追加缺失档位，一项一行；
- provider、API 地址、其他模型、其他字段逐字节保持不变；
- `reasoningEfforts: false` 就地替换为真实档位块；模型没有该块时在条目末尾新建；
- 写入前 `copyFileSync` 到带时间戳的 `.bak-*`，备份失败则整次写入放弃；
- 没有要补的档位时报告「无需写入」，不产生备份；
- 目标是本机 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，写入后需要重启 DSH 才会进入模型目录。

修复模块是 `src/profile-efforts.js`，只做文本增量编辑，不引入 YAML 依赖，也不会重排用户文件。

## 开发

```sh
node scripts/build.mjs     # src/* → lib/client.js
npm test                   # 运行全部六个测试
npm run check              # 构建并确认提交的 lib/ 与源码一致
```

> `npm run check` 只检查客户端 `lib/` 构建产物；宿主端 `src/host.js`、`src/subagent-routing.js` 通过 Node 语法检查和测试覆盖。

发布或提交前建议执行：

```sh
node --check src/host.js
node --check src/subagent-routing.js
git diff --check
npm test
```

`npm run check` 会检查构建后的 `lib/` 是否产生未提交差异；如果源码刚改过但还没重新构建，它会明确失败，重新运行 `npm run build` 即可。

| 测试 | 覆盖 |
|---|---|
| `tests/smoke.mjs` | 产物能被加载、槽位只注册一次、样式表装上、`inject` 为空 |
| `tests/render.mjs` | 渲染树：模型、默认组、光带与 `--cg-fill-width`、闪电按钮、三档菜单、未同步分支 |
| `tests/host.mjs` | 假宿主：路由读写、持久化、契约与提醒注入、去重、关闭提示、子会话分层、官方模型选择 advisory |
| `tests/routing.mjs` | 显式 agents 路由标记/schema、官方 allowlist 归一化与 advisory 回退 |
| `tests/efforts.mjs` | 档位修复：预览不写入、追加行、备份、幂等、`false` 分支、缺块新建、错误码 |
| `tests/style-owner.mjs` | 两个实例装进同一页面时，旧实例不能再改写样式表 |

边改边看时可以把 profile 指回本地目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本目录绝对路径>
```

改完重新 `node scripts/build.mjs` 并刷新页面即可；**宿主半段（`src/host.js`、`src/orchestration-policy.js`、`src/subagent-routing.js`）改动要重启应用**，面板显示「未同步」就说明还在跑旧宿主。

`lib/` 是提交进仓库的构建产物，因此 GitHub 安装不需要再构建；改完 `src/` 后要重新构建并同步更新 `lib/`。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。衍生于 dsh-codex-ui（作者 MeteorNOX / jiangshen275-beep，上游 Loliyer520，同为 MIT）。随包不含 OpenAI 字体与图标资源。

# dsh-model-rotator

> [简体中文](./README.zh.md) | **English** | [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)

Model auto-ranking and transparent failover for DeepSeek Harness.

When the current model hits a quota wall, an expired credential, a rate limit or
a transient network error, this plugin switches to the next-best configured
model **inside the same turn** — and the user sees an ordinary reply.

## What it does

1. **Discovers** every dialable `provider/model` on this machine
   (`ctx.llm.listProviders()` + each adapter's `listModels()`).
2. **Filters** out families that cannot answer a chat turn — embeddings,
   rerankers, ASR/TTS, OCR, image/video generation, content moderators and
   judges. Dialing one of those can only fail the turn and burn a cooldown slot
   that a real model could have used.
3. **Skips the image-reading mode.** dsh-vision-router wraps a chat route into a
   twin (`<provider>-vision`) whose only job is to add image reading to that same
   model. It is one model reachable twice, not a second one, so failing a text
   turn over into it would answer through the image pipeline — and the
   same-model preference below would rank the twin *first*. Those routes are
   therefore never candidates (a model id that merely *mentions* vision is still
   a chat model and stays). The model list can switch one back on when a wrapper
   name does not follow the convention.
4. **Ranks** the survivors by measured connectivity (Laplace-smoothed success
   rate), speed (median TTFT and throughput) and an active failure cooldown. A
   model that *is* the current one — or a close relative of it — on another
   provider carries a bonus, because the model you picked is usually the model
   you want, just from a working channel.
4. **Retries before it believes a failure.** A provider fails transiently: a
   rate-limit blip, a reset socket, an overloaded channel. One miss therefore
   does not count as a fault — the same model gets `retriesPerModel` more tries
   (2 by default, 0–5), `retryBackoffMs` apart (300 ms, then the double of it),
   before the failure is acted on. A retry is not a switch: it asks nothing and
   changes nothing.
5. **Fails over** at the `llm/stream` waterfall: attempt 1 is the untouched
   harness path; a failure that produced **no content at all** abandons that
   attempt, closes its upstream stream, and re-dispatches the next candidate as
   a fresh `ctx.llm.stream()` — the same model first while retries remain, then
   the ranking above.

Once any content chunk has been yielded the attempt is never retried — a second
attempt would duplicate visible text. That zero-content window is exactly the
retryable window.

A turn the caller cancelled (Stop, a deadline, a closed client) ends there: the
walk stops instead of burning attempts on a reply nobody will read.

### What counts as content

"Flow" is the switch that closes the retry window, so it means *the user has been
shown reply text* — and nothing weaker. A `reasoning-delta` is not content: the
harness folds reasoning away again when a retry happens, which is exactly what
makes retrying a reasoning-loop or reasoning-effort failure safe. Markup chunks
(`block-start`, or a `block-end` carrying a reasoning block) are not content
either. Counting those was a real defect: a live model looked dead because a
block-start closed the window and the very next error was taken as final.

### Automatic calls are not conversation turns

A compaction summary and a session title ride the same `llm/stream` seam but are
not a user turn. Their refusals are usually statements about *that lane* — a
proxy answering "bili owns compression here" — so asking a second provider to
carry the plumbing is the wrong reflex: it burns a real model on work nobody
reads, and it is the single loudest source of spurious switching. The plugin
therefore passes any call carrying `purpose: "compaction"` or
`purpose: "session-title"` straight through, error included. An unnamed call —
every ordinary turn — keeps failing over exactly as before.

## Announcing a switch

A switch is otherwise silent: the reply simply arrives from a different model.
The plugin now records it on the **Model switches** tab, beside 对话 / 轨迹 /
上下文, one row per switch — when it happened, which model answered instead, and
why:

```
14:07:31  modelscope/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash → trae/deepseek-v4.1-flash   (quota)
```

The tab reads the plugin's own record
(`GET /_dsh/model-rotator/switches?session=<id>`), so a switch costs **no
conversation context**. The conversation it belongs to is **injected by the Host**
— the cell registers `inject: (sessionId) => ({ sessionId })` and reads
`props.sessionId`, the same contract the built-in 对话 and 轨迹 tabs use (before
0.2.11 it read a field the Host never had, so the tab could not tell which
conversation it was in). Records are filed per conversation, and the session is
bound **where the switch happens** — `ctx.get('agents').currentInitiator()` answers
with the agent that started the call — rather than at the turn boundary, which is
process-wide: whichever conversation stops a turn next would otherwise drain the
queue and take everyone else's rows with it. A call with no live turn (a plugin
route, a host without `agents`) still records, with an empty session; empty-session
rows appear only in the every-session view.

When this conversation has no rows of its own but the log is not empty, the tab
falls back to **every conversation's** rows and labels the view as such, so history
never reads as "nothing happened".

If you also want the old line in the transcript, turn `noticeSwitch` on and the
plugin posts it as before — `模型已切换：A → B`, with the failure kind in brackets
when it is known (`(quota)`, `(rate-limit)`).

| Behaviour | |
|-----------|--|
| Default | **not posted** (`noticeSwitch: false`). The record is on the tab; the row is optional |
| Shape | the host's own notice mechanism: a `user/message` whose source is `{ kind: 'model-rotator/switch', form: 'notice', summary }`. The conversation UI renders that form as a context row, not as something you typed |
| Timing | the notice row is posted at the turn boundary, via `agent/turn-stopping` + `agent.steer`. The switch already happened and the answer is already streaming, so announcing it mid-turn would insert a row in the middle of the reply it describes (the *record* is not written here — see above) |
| Scope | the root conversation only. A switch inside a subagent transcript is somebody else's log |
| On | `noticeSwitch: true` (or the settings-page toggle) |

The event type is deliberately **not** a private one. The persistence reader
refuses to interpret a session log containing a type it does not know
(`dsh-session`'s `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES`), so an invented event would make a
log carrying it fail to load. `user/message` is known, and `notice` is a form the
client already understands — the same pair the harness uses for its own
"model changed" line.

The vendor half of the label is the provider's own `displayName` when the host
publishes one (硅基流动 for `siliconflow`), falling back to the route id. The id
stays visible in the model list, because that is what `config.json`'s lists use.

## Asking before switching

A failover replaces the model the user picked, and it can do so silently. The
default is therefore to ask first: when the current model fails with no content,
the plugin raises a question in the conversation through the harness's own
human-interaction seam (`ctx.userQuestions.askTimed()`), offering **切换** and
**保持当前模型**.

| Reply | Outcome |
|-------|---------|
| 切换 (or any answer that is not a refusal) | the next candidate serves the turn |
| 保持当前模型 (or a typed refusal — 不/否/取消/拒绝/no/cancel/stop/…) | nothing further is dialed; the turn ends on the original error |
| no answer inside the window | the switch proceeds — the request was time-boxed, not vetoed |

The question is raised **once per turn**: approving the first switch covers the
rest of that walk, so a cascade of dead models does not become a cascade of
identical cards. The wait is 20 s by default and configurable.

**Two failures are no longer asked about.** An exhausted balance (`quota`) and a
request the provider refuses as unsupported (`unsupported`) are deterministic
dead ends: the money does not come back inside the window and the next dispatch is
refused identically. Declining there cannot keep the model working — it only ends
the turn, after a card and a wait — so those switch on their own, and the tab
still records why. **Auth keeps its question**: a 403 is often a burst-rate proxy
that clears, so "keep my model and let me retry" is a real choice there.

Failover is deliberately fail-open. If the seam is missing, the ask throws, the
turn has no live root agent (a delegated sub-agent has nobody to answer), or the
timeout is reached, the walk continues unconfirmed. An unattended harness must
not stall on a card nobody is watching.

## Route chains: naming the order yourself

Everything above is the plugin deciding for you. When you already know which order to try, declare a route in `model-rotator/config.json` (borrowed from [dsh-xdpool](https://github.com/XDTrees/dsh-xdpool)'s routing page):

```json
{
  "routes": [
    { "name": "writing", "members": ["modelscope/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", "trae/deepseek-v4.1-flash"], "strategy": "fallback" },
    { "name": "spread", "members": ["provA/x", "provB/x"], "strategy": "round-robin", "stickyLimit": 3 }
  ],
  "activeRoute": "writing"
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `strategy: "fallback"` | Restarts from the head every turn. The first member is the one you put first; the next is tried only when it fails |
| `strategy: "round-robin"` | Starts from a cursor and advances it every `stickyLimit` turns. For several equivalent upstreams of one model: a rate limit moves the turn on, while a multi-turn exchange stays together |
| `activeRoute` | Which route is in force. A name the file does not declare is reported as `ignored` rather than pretended to work |

Three boundaries are what make it trustworthy:

- **The model the turn started on always stays first.** A route decides what comes after it, never what replaces it - that only happens on a failure you approved (or a quota wall).
- **Members are resolved against the live roster.** A hand-typed typo, or a member blocked by `disabledProviders` / `disabledModels`, is never dispatched and is named under `not dispatched: …`. A chain that silently shrinks is the worst outcome available: you believe your order was obeyed while a different model answered.
- **Cursors are not persisted.** After a restart round-robin begins at the head again, on purpose: restoring a stale cursor would continue a rotation you can no longer see.

Above the model list on the settings page sits the **route editor**: create, rename and delete; move a route or a member up and down; switch `fallback`/`round-robin` (with its `stickyLimit`); enable or disable; and mark which one is in force. Two ways to add members: a single box that autocompletes from the live roster (an id the roster does not know is still accepted, but marked in place as *not a candidate* rather than silently dropped), and **multi-select** - open a filtered list, tick several, add them in one action. Ticked models are appended in roster order rather than tick order, so the same roster produces the same chain for everyone. Edits accumulate in a local draft and only reach the file on *Save routes* - a route's content is its order, order takes several steps to arrange, and a half-arranged table written to disk is the next turn pointed at the wrong model.

## The failure kind decides the rest

A failure is not just a string: it is classified, and the class decides how long
the model sits out.

**A quota wall is not a rate limit.** `429 insufficient balance` and `429 too many
requests` are the same HTTP status, yet one clears in seconds and the other does
not until the allowance resets. The plugin reads the kind out of the message -
`insufficient quota`, `out of credits, please top up`, `余额不足，请充值`, `额度已用尽`,
`402 Payment Required` and similar - and treats a balance problem differently:

| Kind | Rest | Retry first? |
|------|------|--------------|
| `quota` | until the next day at `quotaCooldownHour` (00:00 local by default), and never less than `quotaCooldownMs` | no - the balance does not refill between two dispatches |
| `auth` | ordinary exponential backoff | yes - a 403 from a burst-rate proxy does recover |
| `unsupported` | ordinary exponential backoff | no - the same provider returns the same refusal to the same request |
| `rate-limit` | ordinary exponential backoff | yes |
| `server` / `network` | ordinary exponential backoff | yes |
| unclassified | ordinary exponential backoff | yes |

`unsupported` is the request-shape refusal — *"provider X model Y does not
support reasoning effort high"*, *"unsupported model"*. It is decided before the
request is read, so the retry dispatches would repeat it verbatim; skipping them
is what turns a session-level mismatch into one switch instead of three.

An authentication failure is classified *before* a bare `429`, because waiting
never repairs a key: for `429 invalid api key` the honest name is `auth`, not
`rate-limit`. The distinction is recorded, not acted on - both take the same
backoff; only `quota` changes the policy.

The rest is at least "the following day at `quotaCooldownHour`". A wall hit at
23:50 still pays the full `quotaCooldownMs` floor, so it returns at 11:50 the
next day rather than ten minutes later at midnight.

`model_rotator_status` shows it: the ranking marks such a row `QUOTA-REST` (with
the remaining hours) rather than `COOLDOWN`, the `type` column names the class,
and a `last failure seen` line lists each model's last error with its kind.

Measured state - counters, the last error and kind, the cooldown horizon -
**outlives the process**, because the restart a user performs right after being
told their balance is gone must not undo the rest. It is written to
`%DSH_HOME%\model-rotator\stats.json` (or `dirname(config.json)`), debounced, and
read back once on first use. Latency samples deliberately stay in memory: they
are a 20-sample sliding window, and a stale window is worse than a short one.
`statsPersistTtlMs` bounds the age of a restored file (24 h by default; 0
disables the file entirely).

## What it does NOT do

It never reads, writes or rewrites model/provider configuration. It does not
touch `cordis.patch.yml`, `agent-default-model`, `llm-pi-ai` or any provider
registration. It only observes the stream waterfall at runtime.

## Non-chat filtering

The harness adapter strips the catalog's own `wire: 'chat'` marker before
handing rows to `listModels()`, so capability cannot be read off the row.
Name matching is the available signal, and it is deliberately narrow — a
pattern must not touch a chat model that merely mentions a modality
(`Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct` is chat; `Z-Image-Turbo` is not).

The filter denies families across vectors/ranking, speech, image generation,
document parsing and safety classifiers — in both the plain and the `-vision`
provider variants. It runs during discovery, so the count the plugin reports
(`discovered`) is already the post-filter pool, and a machine's numbers depend
entirely on which providers are configured. Ask a live install rather than
quoting a figure from here:

```
model_rotator_status      # "discovered" = candidates after this filter
```

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `model_rotator_status` | Read-only: enabled state, config path, discovered pool, measured ranking. |
| `model_rotator_benchmark` | Probe candidates with a minimal live request to refresh TTFT/throughput and cooldowns (bounded, spends a little quota). |
| `model_rotator_select` | Pin/unpin the head of the failover order; the ranking still decides the tail. |

The status tool also reports the two manual lists and the vision rule, so a model
the user can see in the directory but not in the ranking can be explained without
reading the code:

```
  disabled models  : workbuddy/hy3
  vision twins     : never a candidate (the dsh-vision-router mode wraps a model, it is not a second one)
  model list route : /_dsh/model-rotator/models (GET the grouped list; POST {key, enabled} to switch one off or on)
```

### Asking for less when the ranking is large

The ranking is **one row per discovered route**. On a machine with many providers (488 pairs
measured here) that single table dominated the whole tool result — and a tool result is
context that rides along in the conversation.

So the status tool takes two optional controls:

| Control | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `maxRows` | `0` | Keep only the N highest-scoring rows; **0 = every row** (the default: nothing is clipped). The withheld count is always stated. |
| `summary` | `false` | Collapse the long `disabled models` / `disabled channels` lists to a few names plus a count. |

Not clipping by default is deliberate: a ranking that was silently cut reads as "these
are all the routes", which is precisely the wrong conclusion for someone hunting a model
that is missing. When a cut does happen, a `… N more row(s) withheld` line is appended.

If you only want to know the state rather than audit every row, `maxRows: 20` with
`summary: true` cuts the output to a fraction of its size.

## Configuration

Optional, at `%DSH_HOME%\model-rotator\config.json` (hot-reloaded on change).
Every field has a safe default, so the plugin works with no file at all.

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "allowImageFailover": false,
  "maxCandidates": 4,
  "cooldownBaseMs": 60000,
  "maxCooldownMs": 1800000,
  "quotaCooldownMs": 43200000,
  "quotaCooldownHour": 0,
  "statsPersistTtlMs": 86400000,
  "confirmSwitch": true,
  "confirmTimeoutMs": 20000,
  "adoptSwitchedModel": true,
  "retriesPerModel": 2,
  "retryBackoffMs": 300,
  "preferSameModel": true,
  "weights": { "connectivity": 0.5, "speed": 0.3 },
  "excludeProviders": [],
  "excludeModels": [],
  "excludePatterns": [],
  "disabledModels": [],
  "enabledModels": [],
  "pinned": "",
  "breakerFailures": 5,
  "breakerRestMs": 21600000,
  "routes": [
    { "name": "writing", "members": ["modelscope/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", "trae/deepseek-v4.1-flash"], "strategy": "fallback" }
  ],
  "activeRoute": ""
}
```

- `enabled` — master switch.
- `allowImageFailover` — image turns are skipped by default: a text-only
  fallback cannot read an image, so failing over there would produce a wrong
  answer rather than a missing one.
- `maxCandidates` — cap per turn (hard ceiling 8).
- `cooldownBaseMs` / `maxCooldownMs` — exponential backoff bounds
  (`base * 2^(n-1)`, clamped to `max`).
- `quotaCooldownMs` — minimum rest after a quota wall (default 12 h, ceiling
  26 h). Counted from the failure, not rounded to the hour.
- `quotaCooldownHour` — local hour (0–23) at which an exhausted model may be
  tried again (default 0 = next midnight). The rest always reaches that hour of
  the *following* day, so a wall hit at 00:05 does not revive the same evening.
- `statsPersistTtlMs` — how long measured state survives a restart (default
  24 h, ceiling 30 d; 0 = do not persist).
- `confirmSwitch` — ask in the conversation before leaving a failed model
  (default `true`; see above).
- `confirmTimeoutMs` — how long that question waits before switching anyway
  (default 20000; clamped to 1 s … 10 min).
- `adoptSwitchedModel` — after a switch, make the model that actually
  answered the model of *this session*, so the conversation header shows what is
  really in use (default `true`). Session-local only: no provider configuration
  and no saved default is touched, and the harness's own "model changed" notice
  then names the right pair.
- `retriesPerModel` — extra tries the same model gets before its failure is
  believed (default 2, hard ceiling 5). A retry needs no confirmation because it
  does not change the model.
- `retryBackoffMs` — pause before each retry (default 300; the nth retry waits
  n times this, capped at 10 s).
- `preferSameModel` — rank the same model on another provider first, then close
  relatives, then the measured ranking (default `true`).
- `windowGuard` — skip a failover candidate whose context window cannot hold
  this conversation plus a reply (default `true`). The window comes from the
  adapter that owns the route (`resolveModelInfo`), not from the catalog: a
  profile may declare a window, but only the buyer fits the request. A route
  whose adapter publishes no window is never skipped, a harness that cannot
  report the conversation's pressure gets no guard at all, and a route on the
  same window as the current one is exempt - the guard decides about *moving*.
  A held-back candidate is reported as `window` in the model list, and the
  status tool states the pressure it measured.
- `noticeSwitch` — *also* post the one-line switch notice in the conversation
  (default `false`; the switch record is on the Model switches tab either way —
  see "Announcing a switch" above).
- `weights` — connectivity vs speed in the score.
- `excludeProviders` / `excludeModels` — keep specific routes out of the pool.
- `excludePatterns` — extra regex sources appended to the non-chat deny list.
  An invalid pattern is skipped, never fatal.
- `disabledModels` — models switched off from the model list on the settings
  page. Each entry is `"provider/model"` or a bare model id (which matches every
  channel serving that model). A per-row entry outranks the channel rule.
- `disabledProviders` — whole channels switched off from a channel header's
  button. One entry per provider id. Closing a channel also clears the per-row
  `enabledModels` entries inside it, so the switch cannot be silently undone;
  enabling a row afterwards writes a new entry that does take effect.
- `enabledModels` — the opposite, and the only way to put a vision twin back into
  rotation when its wrapper name does not follow the `<provider>-vision`
  convention. Written by the same switch.
- `pinned` — preferred head of the failover order.
- `routes` / `activeRoute` — name the order yourself; see the route chains section. One route is `{name, members, strategy, stickyLimit, enabled}`; `fallback` restarts from the head every turn, `round-robin` rotates every `stickyLimit` turns. Members are resolved against the live roster: one that cannot be resolved is never dispatched and never silently shortens the chain.
- `breakerFailures` / `breakerRestMs` — a route that fails `breakerFailures` times in a row (default 5) rests for `breakerRestMs` (default 6 hours, never less than `maxCooldownMs`). Counted rather than read out of the message: classification is best effort, the counter is measured.

## Settings page

The plugin ships both halves of a real settings page: the server-side `Config`
schema the Harness serves for the `model-rotator` namespace, and a browser
bundle (`client.js`, declared through `dsh.client` plus `exports["./client"]`)
that renders the form in two host cells from one component:

- **Settings → Model failover**, its own entry in the Settings navigation
  (`settings.section`, id `model-rotator`, order 20). The Harness renders the
  plugin settings pages this way; the shell hands the cell `{ close }` and
  filters by the registration id.
- the **model-rotator** card in the Plugins panel (`plugins.item`), which
  renders the same form as its card body.

The page is sorted into five tabs - **Master**, **Switch policy**, **Cooldown &
breaker**, **Model list**, **Routes** - and it opens on Master. Two rules hold
the design together: a field's tab is data on its spec (a field nobody assigned
throws at render rather than silently leaving the page), and the tabs answer by
*visibility only* - the roster, its fetches and folds, and the route editor with
its unsaved drafts stay mounted under every tab, so switching never loses the
chain being arranged. Save and Discard are scoped to the tab that owns them: a
tab's Save commits only that tab's fields and leaves the other tabs' drafts
untouched.

Both cells only appear while the host actually serves the namespace. Only the
fields that are safe to personalize appear there:

| Field | |
|-------|--|
| `enabled` | master switch |
| `allowImageFailover` | also fail over image turns |
| `maxCandidates` | models one turn may try |
| `cooldownBaseMs` | backoff base |
| `maxCooldownMs` | backoff cap |
| `quotaCooldownMs` | minimum rest after a quota wall |
| `quotaCooldownHour` | hour at which an exhausted model returns |
| `statsPersistTtlMs` | how long measurements survive a restart |
| `confirmSwitch` | ask before switching |
| `confirmTimeoutMs` | how long that question waits |
| `adoptSwitchedModel` | show the switched model on this session |
| `retriesPerModel` | tries before a failure is believed |
| `retryBackoffMs` | pause between those tries |
| `preferSameModel` | same model on another channel first |

`weights.connectivity` / `weights.speed` are **not** on the page: the form
model stages one top-level key at a time, so nested values stay in
`config.json`. Long lists meant for editing by hand or by tool —
`excludeProviders`, `excludeModels`, `excludePatterns`, `pinned` — stay
there too.

### The model list

Below the settings form the same page renders **模型列表 / Models**: every
discovered `provider/model`, with its health and a switch — plus a switch on each
channel header that closes **every model behind that provider in one click**. The
pair of levels is deliberate: a channel switch is the useful action when a key or
an endpoint dies (everything behind it is unreachable at once), while a row switch
is what you reach for when one model is bad and its neighbours are fine.

The list is split into two sections, because they answer different questions:

| Section | Contents |
|---------|----------|
| **对话渠道** (chat channels) | the routes failover actually ranks — the candidates |
| **识图模式** (vision mode) | the `<provider>-vision` twins, each labelled with the channel it wraps (`amd-vision → amd`) |

**Three fold levels, all independent**: each section, each provider channel inside
it, and the roster as a whole. Chat channels start open and the vision section
starts **closed**: there are as many twins as everything else on this machine
(453 of 906 rows in the last live scan), and none of them is ever a candidate, so
leaving them folded is what makes the page readable at all. Two buttons —
**全部展开 / 全部收起** — open or close every section and channel at once.

Closing a channel writes a single `disabledProviders` entry rather than one entry
per model — the channel is the unit you are thinking in, and a list of a hundred
ids would be unreadable and impossible to undo honestly. Four rules keep the two
levels from fighting:

- the header button is labelled from the channel's own flag, not from whether its
  rows happen to be in rotation — a channel whose rows are all off for per-row
  reasons is still **open**, and one closed from the header must offer the action
  that reopens it;
- a closed channel offers **启用本渠道**, and the row switches underneath stay
  available for putting one model back without reopening the whole channel;
- closing a channel clears the stale per-row overrides inside it (so the button
  does what it says), and a row you switch on **afterwards** wins (a fresh,
  deliberate statement beats an older blanket one);
- a **vision** channel carries no channel switch at all. Its rows are kept out by
  the twin rule, which the channel flag cannot lift, so a button there would write
  an entry that changes nothing while reading like a promise. Use a row switch.

The channel label is the vendor name the host publishes on the registered route
(`硅基流动` for `siliconflow`), falling back to the route id when a route
publishes no label; the id is kept in parentheses when the two differ.

A folded line never hides what matters: every channel header (and every section
header) prints the same tally — derived from the rows, not from a host-supplied
counter, so the two layers cannot disagree. A collapsed provider still says
whether it is healthy. The page also rebuilds the sections from `channels` when
the host does not send `groups`, because the two halves are versioned together
but not *loaded* together.

```
▼ 对话渠道                    453 个 · 可用 447 · 冷却 6 · 关闭 0
    ▼ 硅基流动 (siliconflow)     65 个 · 可用 63 · 冷却 2 · 关闭 0   [关闭本渠道]
        ● deepseek-v4.1-flash   冷却中   retry in 511m · rate-limit      [关闭]
    ▶ cline                    55 个 · 可用 55 · 冷却 0 · 关闭 0   [关闭本渠道]
▶ 识图模式（vision-router 创建）  453 个 · 可用 0 · 冷却 0 · 关闭 453
```

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| dot + label | `可用` (nothing resting, no failure on record), `未测` (never tried), `冷却中`, `额度耗尽` (until the next-day boundary), `异常` (last attempt failed), `已关闭` |
| detail | TTFT and success/attempt counts, or the remaining rest, or why the row is out of rotation |
| switch | 关闭 / 启用 |

The reasons a row can be out of rotation are named rather than collapsed:
`manual` (switched off here), `vision` (the vision-router twin, a default the
switch can overrule), `provider` / `excluded` (from `config.json`),
`non-chat` (a family that cannot answer a chat turn), `combo` (a virtual
route). Only the first two are switchable from the page — the rest are
structural or owned by the file.

The roster reads its data over HTTP rather than through the settings form. Its
route is `/_dsh/model-rotator/models`: `GET` returns the grouped list
(`groups` = the two sections, `channels` = one entry per provider carrying its
`kind` and the `sourceChannel` a twin wraps, `models` = every row; a section and a
channel carry the same `models`/`ok`/`resting`/`off` counters, so one row shape

# dsh-do-harness — DeepSeek Harness bundle

Expose [do-harness](../../README.md) development signals to DeepSeek Harness
as one typed model-facing capability and, optionally, gate completion on
current verification evidence.

The bundle contains **no verification policy**. Signal sets, change-aware
applicability, evidence generation, freshness, and selection explanations all
live in the `do-harness` CLI; this package only translates DSH lifecycle and
model calls into fixed do-harness invocations through `ctx.subprocess` and
validates the JSON it receives.

## What it provides

- **`development_signals` tool** — one capability with four actions:
  - `run`: execute a signal set (`verify --set <set> [--changed]`), returning
    `{ state, set, failed, passed, duration_ms, vacuous }`.
  - `status`: cheap evidence freshness check
    (`status --set <set>`), returning the CLI's
    `green | red | stale | missing | running` document. Never runs sensors.
  - `explain`: change-aware selection report
    (`explain --set <set> [--changed] [--since <ref>]`). Never runs sensors.
  - `context`: bounded resume context for a task
    (`task context <task> --max-bytes 8192`). An unavailable outcome is
    preserved as `state: "unavailable"`, never reported as success.
- **`run` options**:
  - `since: "<ref>"` (run/explain) restricts to the committed range
    `merge-base(<ref>, HEAD)..HEAD`.
  - `task: <id>` (run) scopes recorded beats (`--record --task <id>`);
    required for `context`.
  - `reuse: true` (run, task-scoped only) maps to `--unchanged=skip`:
    recorded passing beats for unchanged declared inputs are reused and
    reported visibly (`execution: "reused"`, `reused_beat_id`), never as a
    fresh process pass. Source, policy, or declared-environment changes
    invalidate reuse; unresolved identity forces execution. The completion
    set rejects `changed`/`since`/`reuse`.
- **Strict completion gate** (opt-in) — on `agent/turn-stopping` the bundle
  runs only the cheap `status` operation. `green` permits the stop; `stale`,
  `red`, `running`, or `missing` steers the agent with a computational, specific
  reason and the exact next command (a `running` state asks for `status`, never
  a second overlapping verification launch), then lets the loop continue. When
  the bounded repair budget is spent, the gate rejects the next step so the host
  ends the turn as `blocked` instead of reporting a successful completion. For
  the completion set, `run` executes `verify --strict --record --unchanged=run`
  followed by `status`; only current green, non-vacuous evidence is `complete`.

The model never passes raw CLI argv: the tool schema exposes only
`action`, `set`, `changed`, `since`, `task`, and `reuse`.

## Supported agent sequence

1. During edits: `development_signals(action="explain", set="feedback",
   changed=true)` to see which sensors apply, then `action="run"` to execute
   them. Pass `task: <id>` (+ `reuse: true`) for task-scoped recorded beats.
2. Resume: `development_signals(action="context", task=<id>)` for bounded
   context; full diagnostics remain available through the local
   `do-harness` CLI.
3. Before completion: `development_signals(action="run", set="verification")`
   (strict, non-reused) then `action="status"`. The completion gate enforces
   the same evidence at the stop boundary.

Compatibility/version assumptions: the bundle pins the conformance client to
`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2`; other client versions are unverified. Node
`>=22.19` is required.

## Install

From a checkout of this repository (prebuilt plain JavaScript; a Git install
needs no TypeScript prepare step):

<!-- example: id=dsh_plugin_add classification=illustrative reason="DSH plugin add command" -->
```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add ./integrations/deepseek-harness
dsh --profile demo --dump-config   # verify the do-harness-signals layer
dsh --profile demo
```

From a Git host (pin a commit for reproducibility):

<!-- example: id=dsh_plugin_add_git classification=illustrative reason="DSH plugin add git command" -->
```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add github:your-org/do-harness#<sha>
```

Remove it at any time; the repository and the `do-harness` CLI keep working
exactly as before:

<!-- example: id=dsh_plugin_remove classification=illustrative reason="DSH plugin remove command" -->
```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo remove dsh-do-harness
```

No `.deepseek/` files are required. The repository keeps its normal
`AGENTS.md`, `do-harness.toml`, and `.agents/skills/`, which DSH's own
instruction and skill infrastructure consumes independently.

## Configuration

The bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` declares defaults; a profile can override the
row by restating every key it needs (patches replace the whole `config`
value):

<!-- example: id=dsh_config_yaml classification=parser-check-only reason="DSH configuration YAML snippet" -->
```yaml
- id: do-harness-signals
  config:
    binary: /abs/path/to/do-harness   # default: $DO_HARNESS_BIN or `do-harness` on PATH
    workspace: /abs/path/to/repo      # default: the harness process working directory
                                      # (a relative value resolves against it)
    defaultSignalSet: feedback
    completionSignalSet: verification
    strictCompletion: true
    maxContinuations: 3
```

Binary discovery fails loudly at plugin load: if `do-harness` cannot run, the
plugin refuses to mount with an actionable message. It never compiles or
installs Rust binaries.

## Loop safety

The completion gate counts every non-green evaluation against one budget per
agent, so alternating states, reasons, or failed-sensor lists cannot extend the
loop:

- While the budget remains, the gate steers a computational message naming the
  next command and lets the loop continue.
- When the budget is spent, the gate steers one final message naming the
  underlying failure and rejects the next `agent/pre-step`. The host records
  the turn as `blocked` and the headless runner exits non-zero; the gate never
  reports a successful completion the evidence does not support.
- The rejection applies to that turn only. A later turn starts with a fresh
  budget, so a blocked agent is not permanently unable to run.
- Infrastructure or configuration errors (missing binary, unknown signal set,
  unreadable evidence) are surfaced with the underlying message and bounded
  the same way.

Steering messages name their producer directly (`source.kind: "do-harness"`).
Session format v4 refuses the retired `{ kind: "plugin", plugin: … }` wrapper,
and on a real host that shape made every steer throw and turned the stop
boundary into an agent error. The unit suite pins the accepted shape.

## Completion gating conformance

Mounting successfully is not evidence that a client distinguishes blocked work
from successful completion, and a fake context cannot prove it. The real-host
runner drives the whole lifecycle through a version-pinned client and records
what the host actually did in the versioned
[completion-integration v1 result](../../schemas/completion-integration-v1.schema.json).

<!-- example: id=dsh_conformance_run classification=illustrative reason="real-host conformance command" -->
```sh
node integrations/deepseek-harness/conformance/run.mjs \
  --host /path/to/install/with/@deepseek-ai/dsh \
  --binary "$PWD/target/debug/do-harness" \
  --json completion-conformance.json
```

The runner:

- pins the client (`deepseek-harness` `0.1.7-rc.2`) and refuses another version
  unless `--allow-version` records an explicitly unpinned observation;
- creates a disposable Git repository with a one-sensor `do-harness.toml` and
  runs the real `do-harness` binary for every evidence state;
- replaces the model with a scripted, offline provider and drives real tool
  calls (`conformance_probe` for shape edits, `development_signals` for
  sensors), so plugin loading, the tool runtime, subprocess execution, the
  agent loop, and the stop boundary are the client's own code;
- records 14 scenarios: the lifecycle cases `fresh-pass`, `green-then-edit`,
  `repair-and-reverify`, `failing-sensor`, `missing-or-malformed-evidence`,
  `infrastructure-error`, `retry-exhaustion`, `plugin-load-failure`, and
  `user-cancellation`; plus `edit-explain-run-same-scope`, `eligible-reuse`,
  `missing-dependency-forces-execution`, `bounded-resume-context`, and
  `strict-completion-then-status` for the development-signals sequence.

It launches no paid model, contacts no network service, and writes only fixed
outcomes with a synthetic model identity. No prompts, tool arguments,
credentials, or child streams are recorded. Ordinary CI never runs it: it needs
a pinned client install.

Exit codes are 0 unless `--required` is passed; `--required` exits 1 for a
blocked result and 2 for an unsupported/unknown one, so a required integration
fails closed. `--negative` runs the stale-evidence scenario with
`strictCompletion: false` and asserts the suite reports a failure: a
conformance run that passes without the stop integration proves nothing.

The result is deliberately separate from the client-boundary (privacy)
conformance result: sanitization evidence says nothing about completion.

### What the host owns

The adapter interprets the client's lifecycle; it does not verify anything.
`do-harness` owns sensors, evidence, freshness, and status. The client owns
continuation, cancellation, permissions, process lifecycle, and transport.
Red, stale, missing, malformed, and infrastructure-error outcomes must remain
unverified, and only an explicitly enabled protected job may use a real model.

## Tests

The adapter-level tests exercise the subprocess seam with scripted outcomes;
their e2e fixtures drive the real `do-harness` binary in disposable
repositories, but do not substitute for the separate real-client conformance
run above:

<!-- example: id=dsh_tests_cmd classification=illustrative reason="DSH tests execution command" -->
```sh
cargo build -p do-harness
DO_HARNESS_BIN="$PWD/target/debug/do-harness" \
  node --test integrations/deepseek-harness/test/*.test.mjs
```

E2E coverage includes `green -> edit -> stale -> verify -> green`, task-scoped
reuse and invalidation after source, policy, or declared-environment changes,
a newer failure shadowing an older pass, missing dependencies, bounded resume
context, strict non-vacuous completion, red evidence blocking, and docs-only
selection.

## Validation

Adapter-level checks, validated against DeepSeek Harness `0.1.5-rc.1`
(Node 24, pnpm 10):

- `dsh plugin --profile web add ./integrations/deepseek-harness` links the
  bundle and appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles`; `dsh --profile web
  --dump-config` shows the composed layer and profile row overrides.
- A real `dsh web --no-open` boot mounts the plugin and probes the configured
  binary through `ctx.subprocess` (verified with an argv-recording wrapper).
- A minimal real Cordis context (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` →
  `dsh-tools` → `dsh-subprocess-local` → this bundle) lists
  `development_signals` via `ctx.tools.schemas()` with its exact parameter
  schema, and `ctx.tools.execute()` returns the parsed `status`/`explain`
  values produced by the real CLI.
- With a missing binary, `apply` rejects and `development_signals` is not
  registered; Cordis contains the plugin error and the host keeps running.

Real-host completion conformance against DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.2` passed
all 14 scenarios on 2026-11-08 using Node `v24.19.0`, do-harness `0.4.2`
(`affbb06`), and evidence schema 5. The adapter content digest was
`sha256:c82e3212a772ed44516ad673d9c08ae2be4afa2c3979035ae9bc9db652a99b8d`.
`fresh-pass`, `repair-and-reverify`, `edit-explain-run-same-scope`,
`eligible-reuse`, `bounded-resume-context`, and `strict-completion-then-status`
ended `verified`; `green-then-edit`, `failing-sensor`,
`missing-or-malformed-evidence`, `infrastructure-error`, `retry-exhaustion`,
and `missing-dependency-forces-execution` ended `blocked`; `plugin-load-failure`
ended `unsupported`; and `user-cancellation` ended `cancelled`. The result had
`terminal_result: verified`, `verdict: pass`, and `--required` exited 0.
`green-then-edit` edits a source file and `repair-and-reverify` edits the
policy, exercising both evidence fingerprints. These scripted turns prove the
pinned host lifecycle and tool boundary, not model judgment or reduced model
usage.

The blocked outcomes come from the host's own `agent/pre-step` rejection, not
from a cancelled or aborted session: the client records the turn as `blocked`
and the headless runner exits 1. The real-client `--negative` control detected
the missing stop integration (`terminal=verified`, `continuations=0`). The
adapter-level suite passed 50/50 tests and remains separate from these
real-host observations.


# do-harness

A compiled agent-execution harness CLI: feedforward guides (AGENTS.md, `.agents/skills/`) plus feedback sensors (computational checks) that agents and CI must pass.

Optional [client boundary conformance](https://github.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/blob/main/docs/client-conformance.md) distinguishes
installed guidance, sanitizer fixture capability, and instrumented client
observations. A passing fixture alone never proves client mediation.

## Install

Zero-install with npx on Linux and macOS (Node 18+; resolves the prebuilt
platform binary). **Windows is not available through npm** — use the release
zip below:

<!-- example: id=npx_quickstart classification=illustrative reason="npx runner invocation" -->
```bash
npx do-harness init
npx do-harness verify --set verification --changed --strict
```

Prebuilt binaries for Linux (x86_64/aarch64, static musl), macOS
(x86_64/arm64), and Windows (x86_64, zip; included starting with `v0.1.1`;
`v0.1.0` shipped Linux/macOS only) are published as GitHub Releases
with SHA-256 checksums. The Windows zip is the only supported Windows
install path, because npm rejects the `do-harness-win32-x64` package name
(HTTP 403, "Package name triggered spam detection"); see
[docs/adoption.md](https://github.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/blob/main/docs/adoption.md#windows) for details.

<!-- example: id=install_script classification=executable fixture=installer_local_artifact -->
```bash
# latest release (resolved from the releases/latest redirect)
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/main/scripts/install.sh | sh

# pinned, reproducible install
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/main/scripts/install.sh \
  | sh -s -- --version v0.4.7
```

The installer verifies the artifact against the release `checksums.txt` before
installing to `$HOME/.local/bin` (override with `--bin-dir` /
`DO_HARNESS_INSTALL_DIR`). Checksums share the release origin, so they detect
corruption and truncated downloads, not a compromised origin. See
[docs/provenance-trust-model.md](https://github.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/blob/main/docs/provenance-trust-model.md) for the complete
provenance trust boundary and verification model.

Rust users can fetch the prebuilt release through `cargo-binstall`:

<!-- example: id=cargo_binstall classification=illustrative reason="cargo binstall tool" -->
```bash
cargo binstall do-harness
```

Registry source installs through 0.2.1 do not include the checkout's libSQL
teardown fix; `--locked` does not restore that missing code. That fix ships from
0.3.0 on — published with registry validation on musl and Windows — so source
installs use the maintained `do-harness-libsql` fork. Install the current
release, or pin the oldest version that carries the fix:

<!-- example: id=cargo_install_registry classification=illustrative reason="Registry source install commands; the pinned version documents the libSQL fix boundary." -->
```bash
cargo install do-harness --locked                  # current release
cargo install do-harness --version 0.3.0 --locked  # oldest version with the fix
```

Every release is validated from the registry on musl and Windows before the
GitHub Release and npm packages are published (see
[source-distribution validation](https://github.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#source-distribution-validation));
published versions are listed on the
[releases page](https://github.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/releases/latest).

Building from source requires Rust 1.85+:

<!-- example: id=cargo_build_release classification=illustrative reason="Cargo build command" -->
```bash
cargo build --release --locked -p do-harness
```

The binary lands at `target/release/do-harness`.

To install a source checkout on `PATH` (for use in other repositories):

<!-- example: id=cargo_install_crates classification=illustrative reason="Cargo install path command" -->
```bash
cargo install --path crates/do-harness --locked
```

## Use in another repo

The harness is designed to be adopted by any codebase, Rust or not:

1. Install the CLI onto `PATH` as the primary adoption flow — the prebuilt
   installer for any stack, or `cargo install --path` for a vendored or
   air-gapped checkout:

   <!-- example: id=use_another_repo_install classification=illustrative reason="Alternative adoption installation flows" -->
   ```bash
   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/main/scripts/install.sh \
     | sh -s -- --version v0.4.7
   # or, from a vendored checkout:
   cargo install --path vendor/do-harness/crates/do-harness
   ```

   > **Warning**: Do NOT build `do-harness` into the adopting repository's shared `target/` directory (e.g. `cargo build --manifest-path vendor/do-harness/Cargo.toml -p do-harness --target-dir target`). Running `cargo clean` in the adopting workspace will delete the binary and silently break installed git hooks!

   Then from the target repository root run:

   <!-- example: id=init_language_packs classification=executable fixture=generic_adoption -->
   ```bash
   do-harness init                      # detect the pack from the repository
   do-harness init --language rust      # Rust sensor pack, explicit
   do-harness init --language generic   # no built-in sensors
   do-harness init --language web       # web UI audit pack (viewport, a11y, console, perf, visual, i18n)
   do-harness init --language node      # Node/JS/TS pack (typecheck, lint, test, build)
   ```

   Plain `init` detects the target instead of assuming Rust: an explicit
   `--language` wins, an existing `do-harness.toml` keeps its declared pack, a
   `Cargo.toml` selects rust, any other non-empty project selects the generic
   pack, and an empty directory bootstraps rust.

   The web pack's sensors require the `WEB_AUDIT_*` environment plus the
   `playwright`, `@axe-core/playwright`, and `lighthouse` peer dependencies
   before they run: an unconfigured web pack SKIPs, and `--strict` treats a
   SKIP as a failure. See [docs/adoption.md web pack
   configuration](https://github.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/blob/main/docs/adoption.md#web-pack-configuration).

   This writes `do-harness.toml`, `AGENTS.md`, `USE_RESTRICTIONS.md` (standalone
   policy for high-risk operations and human approval boundaries), `plans/invariants.json`,
   `.agents/skills/` (the `harness` skill plus `skill-creator` for building
   project-specific skills), and `.gitignore` entries, then initializes the
   local libSQL state and seeds the invariants. Existing files are left
   untouched unless you pass `--force`. When no `Cargo.toml` exists, the rust
   pack also scaffolds a minimal crate (`Cargo.toml` + `src/lib.rs`) so
   `init && verify` is green on a truly empty tree; existing crates are never
   touched, not even with `--force`. Every pack also gets an inert, commented
   recipe for the optional context-sanitization check
   (`scripts/check-context-sanitization.py`): the sensor is off unless you
   declare it and set `DO_HARNESS_CONTEXT_SANITIZATION=enabled`, and it never
   captures prompts, tool arguments, or vault contents. `init` then runs the
   generated contract once and reports
   `Initial verification: GREEN | INCOMPLETE | RED | VACUOUS`, exiting non-zero
   on RED instead of claiming a verified workspace.
   Every pack also gets `scripts/check-commitlint.sh`, because the managed
   `commit-msg` hook runs it and blocks the commit when it is missing.

   The generated `AGENTS.md` is a routing/completion contract only. This
   repository's own `AGENTS.md` and `.agents/skills/` describe how to develop
   do-harness itself (HTN planning, spikes, event modeling, ATDD, skill
   distillation); those development-methodology skills are intentionally not
   scaffolded into adopting projects.

2. Configure sensors for your stack in `do-harness.toml`. Language packs:
   `rust` (fmt/check/clippy/test/loc/deps/audit/commitlint), `generic`
   (ships no sensors — add your own `[[sensors]]` entries), `web` (web UI
   audit pack: viewport text, axe accessibility, console noise, performance, visual
   diffs, i18n), and `node` (Node/JS/TS pack: typecheck, lint, test, build).
   With zero sensors `verify` exits 0 without running any command: a vacuous
   pass, not evidence. Define real sensors before treating verify output as proof.
   Language packs are presets over the stack-neutral `[[sensors]]` contract;
   Python and Go use the generic pack with the recipes in
   [the adoption contract](docs/adoption.md#cross-stack-command-recipes).
   For soft, project-specific facts checks (status-document drift, tracker
   counts) declare `kind = "project-check"`: warn-only unless `severity` says
   otherwise, with an optional `fix` hint printed on failure. `init` scaffolds
   the `scripts/check-tracker-drift.sh` reference implementation.

3. Wire the git hooks:

   <!-- example: id=readme_hook_install classification=illustrative reason="Hook install command snippet" -->
   ```bash
   do-harness hook install
   ```

   Hooks locate the binary at runtime: `$DO_HARNESS_BIN`, then `do-harness`
   on `PATH`, then `<repo>/target/release/do-harness`.

4. Run diagnostics and the suite:

   <!-- example: id=readme_doctor_verify classification=illustrative reason="Diagnostics and verify snippet" -->
   ```bash
   do-harness doctor               # verify binary resolution, git hooks & state-db migration skew
   do-harness verify               # run sensor suite
   ```

### Dev setup & CI snippet

For local developer setup scripts or CI workflows in adopting repositories:

<!-- example: id=dev_setup_script classification=illustrative reason="Multi-step developer setup script" -->
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Prebuilt binary (pinned):
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/main/scripts/install.sh \
  | sh -s -- --version v0.4.7
# ...or a vendored checkout (installs outside the workspace target/):
# cargo install --path vendor/do-harness/crates/do-harness

# Initialize and verify harness setup
do-harness hook install
do-harness doctor
do-harness verify
```

See [docs/adoption.md](https://github.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/blob/main/docs/adoption.md) for per-ecosystem quickstarts,
air-gapped mirrors, and the agent evidence loop. See [docs/fast-builds.md](https://github.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/blob/main/docs/fast-builds.md)
for opt-in `sccache` + `mold` build performance notes and measurements.

The green path is dogfooded, not assumed: `crates/do-harness/tests/dogfood.rs`
runs the real binary on fresh temp workspaces and asserts the rust pack goes
green after `init`, goes red once the crate is removed, and that the generic
pack's pass is vacuous. CI repeats `init && verify` on every push (see
`.github/workflows/verify.yml`).

For CI, install the pinned binary first, then invoke `do-harness verify --format json --evidence .do-harness/evidence.json --strict` (exit 0/1/2) — no build step required.

<!-- example: id=ci_path_export classification=illustrative reason="CI environment path export snippet" -->
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/d-o-hub/do-harness/main/scripts/install.sh \
  | sh -s -- --version v0.4.7
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
```

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
dsh-connect-qoder

把 Qoder（通义灵码国内版 / 国际版）的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供账号池、每日签到、积分读数与模型管理。

English · 安装 · 工作原理 · 配置 · 账号池 · 更新日志 · 问题反馈

一个独立的 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle 插件。它把 Qoder 账号的模型接到 DSH 的模型选择器，同时提供模型管理与只读的用量概览。**国内版与国际版是两个并行的供应商（`qoder` / `qoder-global`），可同时使用**；插件的设置页以 tab 区分两者，方便统一管理。 > Qoder 官方不提供 OpenAI 兼容端点（其官方 SDK 只是 agent 启动器），因此本插件直连 Qoder 的 cosy 网关，实现了协议的最小客户端，无需在 Qoder 桌面端登录——只需一个 PAT（Personal Access Token）。 ## 功能特性 - **双供应商并行接入（国内版 + 国际版）** —— 国内版注册为 `qoder` provider（`gateway.qoder.com.cn`），国际版注册为 `qoder-global` provider（`api1.qoder.sh`）。**配置了 PAT 的区域其模型会出现在 DSH 模型选择器里**：两个区域都有 PAT 时两组同时可选，不同会话可以各选一边，互不干扰。**没有 PAT 的区域不列出任何模型**（一个请求也发不出去，列出来只会点到就失败）；配置 PAT 后「刷新模型」即可让模型自动出现——provider 本身始终注册着，配置入口在「设置 → Qoder」。模型名内嵌上游积分倍率（如 `Qwen3.8-Flash · x0.00`），与 Qoder 自身模型菜单一致。 - **设置页自成一处** —— 配置界面是 DSH 设置面板左侧导航里的独立一页（**设置 → Qoder**），与「账号与余额 / 通用设置 / 模型 / 插件」并列，不再藏在插件市场的插件详情页里。页面自上而下是：标题 → 一句话总述 → 三条核心用途 → 正文。 - **双 tab 切换** —— 页面顶部为「国内版 / 国际版」两个 tab，各含独立的 PAT、模型管理与用量概览；每个 tab 的目录、勾选与状态完全隔离。 - **正文按「账号 / 模型 / 诊断」分栏** —— 每个区域 tab 之下再把正文分成三栏。账号栏是账号池、积分读数开关与关于凭据的每一条说明（点一下即生效）；模型栏是勾选、上下文档位、思考强度与逐模型测试（草稿，点「保存」才落地）——两者的提交语义本来就不同，分开之后保存按钮就挨着它保存的东西。**切栏不重新拉取、不丢未保存的草稿**（非活动栏仍挂载）。诊断栏是一张只读的事实表：区域、**上游域名**（与真正发请求的主机名同一处事实）、服务账号、凭据来源、积分读取时刻、目录模型数、已启用数、账号池开关，以及上游最近一次错误的**原文**——它存在的唯一理由是被整段贴进问题反馈，所以里面没有任何会改设置的控件。 - **可单独关闭任一版本供应商** —— 每个 tab 右侧有一个勾选框（默认都勾选）。**取消勾选即把该供应商从 DSH 模型选择器里彻底撤掉**（不是只藏起 tab）：它的路由与「设置 → 模型」页的目录条目一并摘除。PAT、用量与勾选**全部保留**，重新勾选即完整恢复。注意：若某会话此前选中的正是被关闭供应商的模型，该会话再调用会报 `NO_ADAPTER`。 - **模型管理** —— 从上游刷新完整模型目录，逐项勾选启用或禁用；模型行显示倍率（`(0.50x)`）、上下文/输出上限、思考强度档位与免费标记，行右有「图片」「可关闭思考」开关、上下文档位选择器与「测试」按钮。勾选状态写入本地配置，立即同步到模型选择器。**目录里有几个模型就排几行，列表自己不设高度上限、不出内滚动条**——这条列表的用途是「看见并勾选模型」，只露七八行、把其余的藏进第二条滚动条（面板本身已经在滚）会让「有这个模型吗」变成一个需要先发现、再去拖的动作；要看全就滚页面。**上游的 `auto` 不列出来**：它是该区的默认**路由**，网关在请求时才决定把它解析成哪个模型，所以价格与上下文都由别人临时决定，插件无法如实描述——它不是模型，不该占一行让你勾选。同样不列的还有 `Fast` / `Ultimate` / `Efficient`（只有一个抽象形容词，看不出背后是哪家的哪个模型）；但 `Sonus`（`smodel`，x8）与 `Cantus`（`cmodel`，x4）**照常列出**——它们是产品名、上游给 `is_new`，且是全目录最贵的两条（issue #37）。另有一条判据方向相反：上游只在国际版下发的那两条（`Sonus` / `Cantus`）**不会**被摆到国内版面前，因为国内版上游根本不提供它们，选了只会得到一次失败。 - **活动优惠徽标** —— 上游在模型目录里自带活动规则（`promotion`：文案、时段、时区），模型行就在名字旁画一枚小胶囊，如「错峰 4 折」。**文案原样来自上游**（中文界面取 `badge.zh`，英文界面取 `badge.en`），插件不翻译也不改写；悬停给出上游的说明、时段与时区，以及活动文档链接原文。什么时候画由**渲染时刻**决定：有上游声明的墙钟时段（支持跨零点、按上游时区算）就按时段现算，没有时段才退回上游的 `active`——所以夜里读到的目录不会把徽标冻结到第二天早上，早上启动的进程也不会因此整晚不显示；没有活动字段的模型什么都不画。同一枚徽标也出现在宿主的**模型选择器**里——选择器才是做选择的地方，与卡片共用同一套判定与文案。选择器那条路走的是**目录数据**：适配器在 `listModels()` 里给每个模型挂上 `LlmModelInfo.badge`（宿主 0.2.2 起支持，形状 `{ text, tone }`），由宿主自己画在模型名旁。这条路与「谁赢了标签槽」无关，所以同族插件各家的胶囊能同时存在；文案上限是 **16 个 grapheme**（按用户看到的字数，不是 `length`），超了**整枚不画**——不截断，因为截一半的上游文案会被读成一个完整结论。没有促销时字段是 `undefined`（不是 `null`：后者会让整个 provider 从目录里消失）。**别家 provider 的行**同样会复现该模型自带的 `badge`：`trigger` 位（当前选中）胶囊在前，菜单行在后，与宿主 fallback 的顺序一致。取证与判定规则见 [docs/PROMO_BADGE.md](docs/PROMO_BADGE.md) 与同族的 `docs/MODEL-LABEL-SPEC.md`。 - **自动刷新间隔可选（能力栏）** —— 设置页与输入框积分读数都会定时向上游重读用量。这个节奏是一个**全局**配置（`pollMinutes`，能力栏里的下拉框）：**1 / 5 / 10 / 30 / 60 分钟**五档，默认 **5 分钟**，两个区域、两个表面共用同一条节奏（它们问的是同一个路由，几乎同时到达的读会被合流成一次上游请求）。改完立即生效，不用保存，也不必重开页面。想要更及时的读数选 1 分钟，想少打上游选 30 / 60。 - **模型可用性测试** —— 每个模型行有一个「测试」按钮，直达上游确认该模型此刻能否使用：限流（429）报「被限流」、凭据无效报「凭据无效」、内容审核拒绝报「内容被审核拒绝」、额度耗尽报「额度已耗尽」，其余上游瞬时故障如实分类。探测在后台发起，**凭据不会传到页面**；结果不写入设置，也不改变你已保存的勾选。**它发的是真实请求**（会消耗少量上游额度），因此只能按单个模型手工点，没有「测试已勾选」这类批量按钮。 - **每日签到** —— Qoder 有官方每日签到活动（个人用户每天可领 100 Credits，30 天有效）。账号池提供「一键签到所有账号」：逐账号领取、已领过的按幂等处理（不重复领取、不算失败），签到后积分自动刷新。国内版与国际版都已接通（国际版需要本机 Qoder 客户端的设备风控组件，取不到时如实报错而不是假装「今天没有活动」）。 - **每天自动签到（可选，默认关）** —— 模式条上有一个「每天自动签到」开关（`regions..pool.autoCheckin`）。勾上之后，插件在后台**替你点那一次按钮**：一天一次，只作用于勾进池的账号。判据与手动按钮逐字相同 —— **先读活动状态，已领过的只标「已领」而不发领取请求**，所以重启、重试、重复的定时器都不可能领两次。它按上游自己给的窗口时刻（活动行的 `endAt`）翻页，所以翻页点就是官方那个 10:00（UTC+8），不是本地零点；失败按 30 秒 → 1 → 2 → 5 → 15 分钟逐级退避，之后每 30 分钟慢试一次直到这一窗结束。开关旁边那一行写着今天的进度（「今日：已签 N / M」「待重试 K 个」「上次尝试失败：…」），所以后台动作从来不是不可见的。**默认关闭**：领取是一次真实的奖励领取，这个决定留给用户。 - **活动（只读，可关）** —— 卡片在区域作用域内、额度读数之下是一组**活动瓦片**，逐条列出上游当前下发的活动：每日 100 Credits 签到行（带额度与「可领取 / 已领取」状态）与「1024 创造力集结」「首月订阅 Credits 翻倍」这类 banner（`VIEW_DETAILS`）。瓦片按栏宽自动排两列（`auto-fill` + 260px 下限），描述限两行、全文在悬停里，状态与「查看详情」贴底对齐；上游下发的活动条数不多时它们并排而不是各占一行，`612px` 的正文栏里三条活动约占 180px。**每个区域可以单独关掉**（设置页的「显示活动」，默认开，`regions..showCampaigns`；关掉后这一页直接从 tab 栏开始，不发那条 `/campaigns` 请求）。**标题与描述原样来自上游**（按界面语言取 `zh` / `en`，缺哪边用另一边），「查看详情」是真正的链接（上游的 `detailUrl`，缺失时退回活动落地页）；**只读**，不签到、不改账号。上游没下发就显示「当前没有活动」，读不到则显示原因（不是装作没有）。此前本插件只读签到用的那一小片活动数据，banner 行被整行跳过（用户实拍 2026-10-25），现已整份读取。 - **积分（只读）** —— 账号池逐账号显示剩余积分、**积分何时作废**与**套餐何时到期**（来自 Qoder 的 `sash/api/v2/me/usage`，凭 `jt-` jobToken 查询）；3 天内到期的积分金额会高亮。查询是**只读**的、不消耗积分；读不到时（凭据被拒 / 上游未响应）如实说明原因并给出路，不留一片空白。 - **两个到期日是两件事**（issue #31）：`qoderUsage.expiresAt` 是**账号级套餐 / 14 天试用**到期（实测它等于 `userId` 前缀 + 14 天），不是任何一个积分包的到期 —— 它现在单独显示为「套餐 {at} 到期」，不参与「临期积分」高亮，也不参与池排序。 - **积分到期来自签到批次**：上游只在签到活动里给过 `validity.days`（30 天），所以插件在领到的那一刻记下 `claimAtMs` 与数额并落盘（`$DSH_HOME/.qoder-pool..json` 的 `credits`），按 FIFO 记账、**按悲观上界显示**（取最早一批还没过期的）。上游不告诉我们「已花掉的是哪一批」，报晚了等于没有提醒，所以宁可早报几天。`claimAtMs` 缺席（旧记录 / 只见过「已领取」）时**不显示**，宁缺勿错；文案写明「最早一批签到积分约 {at} 到期」，不冒充上游的确定时刻。 - **安全 loopback shim** —— 每区域一个随机端口 + 进程内随机 secret，真实 Qoder PAT **不交给 pi-ai**：pi-ai 只与本地 shim 对话，shim 用 cosy 会话（jobToken）做上游请求。 - **多账号池（PAT）** —— 每区域一个本地 vault `$DSH_HOME/.qoder-accounts..json`（0600），把设置 PAT、环境变量与 vault 账号三源去重合并；卡片可新增（粘贴 `pt-…`，经 `JobToken` 交换校验并取显示名，也可自填备注名）/ 改名账号，也可显式选择某一账号服务（`regions..accountId`，留空自动按 settings → env → vault 选取）。**移出池**与**删除**是两件事：移出池 = 在池表格里取消勾选并保存（凭据留着，随时勾回）；删除 = 池表格行内的「删除」按钮，二次确认后抹掉 vault 里的 PAT 并自动退出池与区域选择（不可恢复；设置/环境变量里的 PAT 不归本插件管，不提供删除按钮）。 - **按实测排序与自动换号** —— 「一键测试所有账号」对池内每个成员发真实请求（目标模型默认自动挑本区域倍率为 0 的免费模型），结果落 `$DSH_HOME/.qoder-pool..json`；开启账号池后，聊天流在首字节前按 `rankPool`（可用性 → 快过期的积分优先 → 积分到期最近 → 积分高 → id）选出服务账号，失败时依次换下一个可用账号重试，失败回写 `live-request` 探测。关掉开关则插件不替你选、也不替你换，失败如实报错。**上游报额度耗尽必显示**：对话路径上一旦上游的业务码命中配额族（110 当日用量 / 113 配额 / 118 Credits 耗尽等），该区域卡片就出现一条「上游报额度耗尽」通知（最近一次时刻 + 业务码，悬停是脱敏后的上游原文）——与账号池开关无关，因为逐账号的 `out-of-credit` 明细只活在池视图里，池关着时这条通知是那次失败**唯一**可见的出口（0.7.x 的「今日额度疑似已用尽」胶囊拆掉后留下的缺口）。限流（HTTP 429 短窗）**不会**被标成耗尽——那是冷却，不是没额度。 - **账号转移（导入 / 导出）** —— 按区域把 vault 账号导出为传输文件，预览后按索引导入；跨区域域名（`qoder.com.cn` / `qoder.sh`）正向匹配，不匹配的记录计入 `skipped`。 - **思考强度与上下文预算** —— 上游按模型声明 `thinking_config.efforts`，卡片只列出**真实存在**的档位（Qwen 系 `low/medium/xhigh`、DeepSeek/GLM 系 `low/high/max`），选定即保存、每个请求自动带上（与 Qoder 客户端同一发送字段，双写顶层与 `parameters`）；上下文档位同样只来自上游 `context_config` 声明的档位，未声明时不渲染控件、不编造选项。**上游声明的默认档就是默认档**：DSH 的模型选择器里直接落在那一档上（如 Qwen3.8-Max 的 `medium`），而不是显示成「Default」——那正是卡片那一行写着「medium（上游默认）」时，选择器本该跟随的答案。你在卡片里为某个模型选过档位，那一次选择就是该模型的默认档。 - **诚实的模型能力** —— 上游的 `is_vl` 是**平台**的图片输入声明而非模型原生能力，且它对几乎每个模型都是 `true`，所以本插件**不拿它当能力答案**，只认一张按精确 model id 键控的核对表：核对过的才预勾选，没核实的（含全新模型）一律不勾，并在开关 tooltip 里说明「为什么没勾」。表的依据是**厂商文档 + 真机实测**：2026-10-29 用「发一张画着数字 `7` 的图、问是哪个数字」逐个测了**两个区域目录并集里的全部 14 个模型**，**全部读图成功**，因此当前目录里没有纯文本模型（此前按命名推断的「code 系模型应是纯文本」被实测推翻）。「关闭思考」同样只对上游显式声明、且不在已知拒绝集里的模型提供。宁可少给一个选项，也不要让用户按下去就失败。 - **缓存命中如实上报，且真的命中** —— 上游的 `usage` 带 `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`，插件把它一路透传到宿主，所以 GUI 轮次统计里的「缓存命中」是真实比例（修复前这里恒显 0%：字段在归一路径上被丢掉了，那个 0% 是不可信的读数，不是缓存没生效的证据）。**命中数是 `prompt_tokens` 的子集，不是额外增量**——所以它不会被加进总数（那会把命中的前缀算两遍）。上游没报这个字段时就不写，不会用 0 顶替「不知道」。**同一会话的 `session_id` 保持稳定**（issue #42）：Qoder 的 prompt cache 按它分桶，此前每轮换一个随机值让缓存 100% 失效；现在每轮复用 DSH 会话的稳定 id（从宿主传来的 session-affinity 头读取，老宿主自动退回旧行为），长对话的对话内容也能跨轮命中缓存，而不是只有系统提示那一段命中。 - **composer 积分读数（位置可选）** —— 会话输入区按区域显示 `QD CN` / `QD AI` 与**当前计费账号**的余额（如 `QD CN · 92`；池接管时是接管者的余额，悬停写明归属），点开是逐账号的余额表，点某一行即切换到该账号（国际版有「专属积分包」时，表格会在「积分」列**左边**多出一列 SOTA 专属积分：它是「选了与之绑定的模型才优先抵扣」的另一笔钱，所以**不计入**普通积分；多个用途不同的包的**余额不相加** —— 主列显示第一个包的真实余额加 `+N` 溢出标记，逐包明细在悬停里，因为相加出来的数不对应任何能花出去的额度（issue #43）；没有专属包的账号那一格画「—」，整列在没有专属包时连表头都不出现），页头的「设置」按钮直接跳到「设置 → Qoder」（先走设置外壳自己的状态句柄，一次调用就把面板开在本插件这一页；没有那个入口的老宿主才退回「点侧边栏设置 → 点导航行」，最后再退回插件市场本插件页）；受每区域「在对话框显示积分」开关控制（默认开，opt-out）。**读数可放在两个位置之一**（设置页里的二选一下拉，每区域独立，默认不变）：**输入框工具栏**（`conversation.input.right`，紧挨模型选择器左侧、与权限切换器隔开）或**输入框下方**（`conversation.composer.dock`，即 shell 渲染轮次 / tok/s / token / 缓存命中那一行的常驻栏，读数是追加在自带统计之后）。之所以可选：输入框工具栏是**共享的 list 插槽**，另一个把东西停在那里的插件可能把读数挤到看不见——此时切到「输入框下方」即可（对齐 workbuddy issue #62）。 - **命令行诊断与现场验证** —— `dsh-connect-qoder doctor|status|logout [--json] [--region cn|global]`：`doctor` 报 PAT 来源、cosy 指纹派生、pi-ai 代际、宿主心跳存活与 vault 账号计数；`status` 报凭据来源、上游可达性与当前剩余积分；`logout` 清除指定区域的 vault 账号与账号池测量副本。另有 `pnpm run probe:cosy`（不依赖宿主直连 cosy 链路验证）与 `pnpm run probe:vault`（只读 dump vault / 账号池测量，PAT 只显示掩码）。 ## 工作原理 ```text DSH PiAiAdapter（每个 provider 一套） -> 安全 loopback shim（每区域一个随机端口 + 进程内随机 secret） -> QoderUpstreamClient（cosy 协议最小客户端） -> 国内版 https://gateway.qoder.com.cn/algo/api/v2/... -> 国际版 https://api1.qoder.sh/algo/api/v2/... -> Qoder SSE（OpenAI 形状增量） -> DSH 本地执行工具并回传结果 ``` 国内版与国际版各持一套完整的运行时栈——上游客户端、模型 catalog、回环 shim、adapter——按区域配置（网关 / openapi / 目录路径）隔离，所以**两个区域的模型可以同时可选、被不同会话使用**。 凭据是 PAT（设置页 `regions..pat` 或环境变量，见[配置](#配置)），设置项优先。每次会话按需惰性交换 **jobToken**：PAT 只在这个交换请求里使用一次，之后的对外请求全部携带 cosy bearer（自定义 Base64 载荷 + MD5 签名）与「机器指纹」会话头。**PAT 从不进入 pi-ai，也从不外发到网关之外；本插件不读不写 Qoder 桌面端的本地登录文件。** 模型的 cosy 编码与签名细节（自定义字母表、`n/3` 重排、`cosy&&` 签名、RSA/AES 会话封装）见 `src/cosy.ts` 的头部注释；错误分类（内容审核 / 限流 / 额度耗尽 / 瞬时故障）与 DSH 重试语义的对应见 `src/upstream.ts`。 ## 安装 ### 从发布包安装（推荐） ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add @dmh2002/dsh-connect-qoder # Desktop dsh plugin true`：缺席、`false`、以及被手工改成字符串 `"true"` 的垃圾值，一律读作关闭。 ### 多账号池与凭据来源 除设置 PAT 与环境变量外，每区域还有一个本地 vault（`$DSH_HOME/.qoder-accounts..json`，权限 0600）保存多个 PAT 账号。三源按 **settings → env → vault** 的优先级去重合并（同一个 PAT jobToken 交换与后续 cosy 请求，从不进入 pi-ai 或页面。 - `logout [--region cn|global]` 会清除指定区域的 vault 账号与账号池测量副本（`$DSH_HOME/.qoder-accounts..json` 与 `.qoder-pool..json`）。 - 勾选成员、一键签到、一键测试与自动换号的规则见[账号池](#账号池)。 ## 账号池 一台机器上往往有多个 Qoder 账号（多个 PAT）。**账号池**把这些账号收成一次点击：勾进池子，然后「一键签到所有账号」或「一键测试所有账号」；再打开**启用账号池**，插件就会在请求失败时自动换号接着跑。 **每个区域（国内版 / 国际版）各有独立的一池**：成员、目标模型、积分与签到状态互不影响——两边的账号本来就属于不同的供应商。**两个区域都有每日签到**：国际版的签到活动只下发给带设备风控头的请求，插件按区域读取本机 Qoder 客户端自带的设备身份组件；取不到时如实报错，不会把「拿不到设备身份」伪装成「今天没有活动」。 ### 自动换号（开启账号池即生效） - **谁来服务由排序决定**：开启后**每一次请求**都发给池内排序最靠前的可用账号，所以「当前使用」显示的是排序的结果，不一定是你手动选的那个。 - **失败时继续往下试**：某个请求在上游失败时，插件**依次**用池内其他可用账号重试，直到有一个接手、或全部不可用为止才把错误报出来。 - **哪些失败会换号**：429 限流、额度耗尽、401/403 凭据被拒、5xx 网关与网络故障——这些都是**某个账号**的状态，换一个很可能就过了。 - **哪些不会**：请求本身不合法（HTTP 400）——同一个请求体换谁都是同样的 400，重试只是让你多等几轮；**流已开始之后**也不会重放（字节已经发出去了）。 - **已知不可用的账号会被跳过**：处于限流冷却期内、或凭据已被上游拒绝的成员不参与选择。**从没测过的账号按「默认可用」参与**——刚添加的账号不该因为「还没测」就被排除。 - **手动选择从不被改写**：池子通过运行时覆盖决定「谁服务」，**不写回你保存的选择**；关掉开关，你选定的账号立刻完全生效。 - **失败会被记下来**：一次失败会写成该账号的测量（含上游报文中给出的恢复时间），下一个请求直接从可用账号开始，不必每次先撞一遍同一个限流账号。 - **换号会告诉你**：换号是插件替你做的决定，所以它会说出来——回答开头带一条引用块提示，例如 `> [dsh-connect-qoder] 「450702134816」被限流，已改用池中另一个账号回答。`。提示说的是**失败的那个账号**（你选中的那个），不点名接管者；连换多次只写一条，说的是紧邻换号的那次失败。没换号就一个字都不写。 ### 这个开关到底控制什么 **它只控制「插件要不要自己决定」，不控制「你能不能操作」。** | | 账号池 **开启** | 账号池 **关闭** | | --- | --- | --- | | 谁服务 | 由排序**自动**选出（可用优先 → 积分快过期 → 积分到期最近 → 积分高 → id） | **你**在设置区的「使用哪个账号」里选定 | | 请求失败 | **自动**换下一个可用账号重试 | 不换号，如实报错 | | 一键签到 / 一键测试 | 可用 | **仍然可用** | | 目标测试模型 | 可改 | **仍然可改** | 最后两行是刻意的：签到与测试是**手动动作**，作用于你勾选的成员，与「插件是否自动路由」是两件事。 **唯一的硬约束**：池里一个成员都没勾选时，批量动作一律拒绝。空的池**绝不**退化成「那就对全部账号执行」——那是唯一会花掉你没授权过的积分的解读。 ### 重试预算可以调（`regions..retry`） 宿主有一个「原地重试」环：一次请求失败但值得再试时，它等一小段时间再发一次。等待阶梯由插件声明、宿主执行，默认跟随宿主（不填就是宿主的默认值，升级不会改变你现在的行为）。 Qoder 上游偶尔会回 `RESOURCE_LIMIT`（业务码 `10605`）并**自己申报**「请等 N 秒再来」。插件现在会把这个值写进给宿主的失败文案（形如 `[upstream retry-after 5s]`），你能直接看出上游只要求等多久，而不是只看到「上游报了个 4xx」。 想改预算就配这三个数字（都在区域级，两个区域各配各的）： ```yaml regions: cn: retry: maxRetries: 4 # 最多重试几次（0 = 跟随宿主默认） initialDelayMs: 5000 # 首次退避毫秒（0 = 跟随宿主默认） maxDelayMs: 30000 # 退避上限毫秒（0 = 跟随宿主默认） queueWaitMs: 60000 # 排队时插件自己等的上限（0 = 关掉，默认 60000） ``` 上面的 `5000 → 30000` 兼顾了上游两种常见形态：瞬时限流（申报 5 秒）与 `queueType:p2` 排队（约 30 秒）。**前三个 0 表示跟随宿主默认**，所以留空与不写这个配置等价；第四个 `queueWaitMs` 的 0 则是**关掉**（见下节）。 > 此前这一项只能是宿主的默认值，想调就得改 `node_modules` 里的构建产物 —— 而那会在升级时静默还原。 #### 排队时插件自己等（`queueWaitMs`，issue #29） **重试预算管不到「上游明确要求等 30 秒」的情形。** 宿主的阶梯是递增的（5s → 10s → 20s → 30s，带抖动），前两次**一定**短于上游申报的 30 秒；实测一轮 28 次重试、纯等待 296 秒，其中 11 次是在上游说「等 30 秒」之后 5 秒内就重发的。 插件无法让宿主精确等待：`pi-ai` 那条路由没有 `providerRetryAfterMs` 通道（issue #24 已复核，`retry-after` 在该模块与底层 vendor 里都不解析）。所以在转发层自己等掉，是唯一能让「等 30 秒」真的等于 30 秒、又不必消耗宿主重试预算的办法： - 上游回 `isQueued: true` 并申报了等待秒数，且该值 **≤ `queueWaitMs`** ⇒ 插件等满这个时长再重发一次，这次失败**不交给宿主**； - 申报值超过上限、或重发后仍排队 ⇒ 原样交回宿主，此时它至少还有剩余预算； - 每个请求**只等一次**，等待可中断（你点停止就立刻停）； - 配 `queueWaitMs: 0` 关掉，行为回到「全靠宿主的阶梯」。 #### 两种「排队」要分清（issue #29） 同一个 `isQueued: true` 有两种形态，插件的措辞与账号池的处理不同： | 上游字段 | 含义 | 插件怎么处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | `isQueued:true` + `serviceAvailable:true` | 服务是好的，你排在队里（`queueCount` 通常 > 0） | 记为 **排队中**，按上游申报的时长冷却，换号有意义 | | `isQueued:true` + `serviceAvailable:false` | 上游**整体**在拒服务（实测 `queueCount: 0`，队列里一个人都没有） | 记为 **上游整体不可用**，换号提示明说「不是该账号的问题」 | 区别很重要：前者「等一会儿/换个账号」有效；后者换号、**换 PAT 都没用** —— 现场 14 个模型同时不可用。此前两种情况都被压成「排队中」，用户会以为自己的凭据坏了而去重配。 ### 排序规则（开启账号池后决定谁服务） 1. **可用优先** —— 被测量判定为不可用（限流未到恢复时间、凭据被拒等）的排到最后； 2. **有临期积分的优先** —— 3 天内到期的先花，过期即作废（临期判定优先于下面第 3 条的用户手排顺序，见 `rankPool` 的注释）； 3. **用户手排的顺序优先**（`orderAccountIds`）—— 拖出来的顺序要真的生效，否则拖了也没用； 4. **积分到期最近 → 临期金额大 → 积分高** —— 只在有**新鲜读数**时参与（卡片轮询、批量测试或保存时读到的那份，10 分钟内有效）：请求路径**不会**为了排序去打上游，否则一页对话就变成 N 个额外请求； 5. 最后按账号 id 收尾，保证顺序是**全序**、可复现。 ⚠️ **套餐到期不参与排序**（issue #31）：那个日期说的是「账号还能用多久」，与「手上的分会不会作废」是两件事。把它当临期紧急度会让一个刚过试用期的号永远排在最前面 —— 而它的分一分都不会过期。 ### 两个批量动作 - **一键签到所有账号** —— 逐个账号领取当日的官方签到活动。**先查状态再领取**，已领过的直接标「已签到」而**不发写入请求**（幂等，不重复领取）；任何单个账号失败只标记该行，**不中断整批**。签到会改变余额，因此批次结束后作废该区域的积分缓存，卡片不会继续显示领取前的数字。 - **一键测试所有账号** —— 对每个成员发一次真实请求，得出「这个账号此刻能不能用这个模型」。目标模型默认由「自动」挑本区域**倍率为 0 的免费模型**（多个候选取上下文窗口最大的），你也可以显式指定——但**在免费模型出现之前测试保持关闭**，避免在你不知情的情况下花掉积分。测试走的是与模型行同一套探测，因此**有真实成本**。 **「测试用模型」不受「已启用模型」影响**（issue #33）：勾选管的是 DSH 的模型选择器里列哪些模型，不是「允许测哪些」。卡片上写着哪个模型、测试就测哪个——哪怕它没有被勾进「已启用模型」，哪怕「自动」档唯一的免费模型没勾。这两份目录曾经分开过（卡片读完整目录、测试路由读裁剪过的运行时目录），结果就是按钮点了没反应：卡片写着「测试用模型 qfmodel」，点下去却是空结果。现在全插件只有一份目录。 真的**解不出**目标时（目录里一个免费模型都没有，或你手选的那个已下架），接口回 `409` + 原因（`no-free-model` / `target-model-stale`），卡片会直说「没有可测的目标模型」，而不是回一句像是账号坏了的「Host 未返回该账号的结果」。 两种批量动作都**不锁住界面**：按钮自己变成「签到中… / 测试中…」，每处理完一个账号，那一行立刻落位、活动日志也**逐条**写下（时间戳是各自完成的那一刻，不是整批结束的那一秒）；其余界面照常可用。只有**保存配置**与**删除账号**会挡一道——前者在写盘、后者不可逆。 设置页的排布：顶部是**两格独立的供应商卡片**（国内版 / 国际版），每格自带边框与底色、右端有自己的开关，选中的那格描品牌色边——**一格就是一个单位**，点名字切 tab、点开关启用该供应商。再往下是「在对话框显示积分」与「显示位置」两行（整行可点，主标题下一行是说明），第三行是**可选的「在侧边栏显示 Qoder」**，然后是账号池、模型管理。这三行都是**立即生效，不需要点保存**：前两行管积分读数显不显示、显示在哪里，第三行管侧边栏那一行（以及它打开的整页）在不在。 默认**不**自动签到：签到会真实领取奖励，只在你点按钮时执行。 > 1.24.0 起这条改成了**可选**（issue #36）：模式条上的「每天自动签到」勾上之后，插件在后台替你点那一次按钮。理由是代价不对称 —— 漏一窗就是白丢一份（个人用户 100 Credits、30 天有效），连签还会断；而签到本身**不消耗任何积分**，且上游是幂等的（先读状态，`CLAIMED` 就不再发领取请求）。所以诚实的说法不是「插件该不该做这件事」，而是「用户可以决定一次，让它自己做」—— 开关就是那个决定，默认仍然是关。 ### 上游没说「什么时候恢复」时，插件在做什么（issue #32） 有两件事长得很像，其实完全不同： | | 意思 | 谁决定的 | | --- | --- | --- | | `retryAtMs` 有值 | 「上游说这个时刻之后可以再用」 | 上游的字段、报文里的重置句，或按签到快照的当日窗口**推算**（`retrySource` 区分这几种） | | `retrySource: 'unknown-cooldown'` | 「上游没说、快照也没有；我们在**按 30 分钟**自己重试」 | 插件 | 这两个状态以前在数据里分不开：`retryAtMs` 缺席时，卡片沉默，看起来与「上游没说、系统也不打算再试」一模一样 —— 而实际上池子每 30 分钟就会拿**一次真实聊天请求**再去撞一次。现在兜底分支会写下 `retrySource: 'unknown-cooldown'`，卡片那一格说「上游未给出何时恢复 · 每 30 分钟自动重试一次」。**它只写来源，不写 `retryAtMs`** —— 那个字段继续只放上游/推算给出的时刻，把本地节奏写进去会让下一处读者以为上游承诺过某个时间点。 **30 分钟这个数刻意不动**：官方只说了「当日用量用尽后次日可继续」，没给具体时刻，编 6 小时与编 30 分钟性质相同。真正降低代价的是下面这条。 #### 签到窗口时刻会落盘，重启后不再必然走兜底 `110`（当日用量限制）的恢复时刻来自签到活动行的 `endAt`。这份快照以前只在进程内 —— 而兜底冷却恰恰只在「窗口时刻不知道」时生效，于是**每次重启都让兜底必然生效**，一个要等次日窗口的号就被每 30 分钟试探一次。 现在签到成功的窗口时刻会写进 `$DSH_HOME/.qoder-pool..json` 的 `windows` 键，重启后照常读回（进程内快照优先，磁盘其次；**已经过去的时刻不采用** —— 拿旧日期当「下次恢复时刻」会把号判到很久以后才解禁）。这条改动让兜底从「经常生效」变成「几乎不生效」，比调那个 30 分钟有用得多。 #### 自动签到为什么按「窗口」而不是按「日历日」记账（issue #36） 这一条是移植参考实现时最容易照抄错的地方。 Qoder 的每日窗口是一个**固定的绝对时刻**：当天 10:00 → 次日 09:59（UTC+8）。而「每天签到一次」要回答的是「这一窗是不是已经签过了」，所以记账单位必须是**窗口**，不是用户的本地日历日： - 本地日历日对**非 UTC+8** 的用户根本对不上：本地零点落在窗口中间，于是「今天」的边界把一个窗口劈成两半； - 即使在 UTC+8，本地零点也在窗口中间。照抄日历日会让 00:05 被判定成「新的一天」去领一次（幂等，报「已领」并记成完成），而 10:00 真正开窗时状态仍写着「这一天已完成」——**新窗口的那一份要等到第二天 00:05 才会被领**，晚 14 小时，而卡片上的倒计时会一直写着「现在可以签到」却没人去签。 所以窗口身份 =「(当前时刻 − 2 小时) 的 UTC 日期」（10:00 UTC+8 那一刻翻页）；并且优先用**上游说过的那一个时刻**（活动行的 `endAt`）当身份 —— 它还在未来就说明窗口没翻页。两种来源的键前缀不同（`upstream:` / `boundary:`），从一条切到另一条必然重置状态：那次重置只多一轮幂等重跑，换来的是「窗口一旦翻页就一定会重新看一眼」。 进度只活在**当前窗口**里：一个做完的窗口在下一拍之前可能还留在内存中，把它当成今天汇报，卡片就会在新窗刚开的头几分钟写着「今日：N 个全部已签」而下面每行都是「未签到」。`summaryForWindow` 就是挡这件事的。 自动签到的进度**单独落盘**（`$DSH_HOME/.qoder-auto-checkin..json`，`0600`），不进 settings：卡片对用户偏好用的是「草稿 → 保存」模式，把运行状态塞进 `regions..pool` 会让用户手点一次保存、用几分钟前的草稿把它覆盖回去。文件里只有账号 id、计数与一句失败原因 —— 没有令牌，也没有账号显示名。 ## 命令行诊断 在**已装本插件的 profile 目录里**跑（推荐，无需全局安装）： ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
