**🔀 Smart dispatch** **The right agent and model for each job.** - Pick a harness for each step and switch mid-conversation - Routine steps on cheap or local models, strong models where it matters - Long tasks go to your own cloud runner **🛡️ Built-in governance** **Your organization decides which AI does what, and where.** - Plugins are reviewed before they are shared, granted to teams or people, and can be revoked - Roles, usage, cost and an audit log - Self-hosted **✅ Verified delivery** **Set the bar first. Done means the requester signed off.** - Every request carries its acceptance criteria - A separate AI review checks each one - A person makes the final call
## Quick start > SoduWork is in public beta. Try it and tell us what you think, and evaluate it before using it in production. You need Python 3.12+, Node.js 22.19+ and Git. From the cloned repository, run `sh start.sh --desktop` on macOS/Linux, `.\start.cmd --desktop` in Windows PowerShell, or `start.cmd --desktop` in Command Prompt. The first run installs dependencies, then starts the Hub, the admin console and the desktop client on this computer. Set a password for the `admin` account (12–128 characters) when asked. Then add a model provider under **Model catalog** in the admin console, start a chat in the client and try a small task. Pi is built in. ### Already added an API key? Start here 1. **Add a chat model as well.** Under **Capabilities → Model catalog**, find the service you connected, choose **Add model**, enter the provider's exact model ID, select **Chat model**, and save. Saving a service credential alone does not create a selectable model. 2. **Open the desktop client and sign in to the same Hub.** Use `--desktop` when starting from source. The browser admin console configures the service; check that **Connection** on the desktop sign-in screen points to that same Hub. 3. **Choose New conversation, Pi, and the model you added.** Pi uses the SoduWork model catalog. Codex uses its own account and needs its own sign-in; it does not automatically use this API key. 4. **Try a small task.** For example: “Turn these fictional meeting notes into an action table with owner and due date. Mark missing information as unconfirmed: Alex will organize the requirements by Friday; Sam will check the quotation.” Check the returned table against the notes. 5. **Create a requirement when you need assignment and acceptance.** Describe the goal, inputs and acceptance criteria, open **Arrange execution**, choose an Agent and model, and inspect the delivery before accepting it. A normal conversation does not require a project, plugin or automation first. For the first message, use an **OpenAI-compatible chat model with Pi**. A successful connection probe does not guarantee a successful inference: balance, model permissions and protocol support still matter. If the Agent list is empty, check **Agent management** and the Runner connection. If the model list is empty, check that the model exists, is enabled, and both interfaces use the same Hub. See [Run from source: send your first AI message](docs/getting-started.en.md#send-your-first-ai-message) for field-by-field setup and troubleshooting.
Try the live demo Download the client from [Releases](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases/latest), enter `https://service.soduwork.ai` under **Connection** on the sign-in screen, then sign up and sign in. > The demo is for evaluation only. Don't upload real business data or anything sensitive.
Install the desktop client Follow the illustrated [desktop installation and first conversation guide](docs/desktop-quickstart.en.md). | OS | Package | | --- | --- | | Windows | `SoduWork--Setup.exe` | | macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel) | `SoduWork--mac-.dmg` | | Linux | `SoduWork--linux.deb` / `.rpm` / `.tar.gz` | Download from [Releases](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases). On first launch, enter your Hub address under **Connection**, then sign in. On macOS, if you see "cannot verify the developer", open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway**.
Deploy for a team with Docker With Docker installed and running, from the repository root: ```bash python3 ops/self-host/deploy.py up python3 ops/self-host/deploy.py credentials # show the initial admin password ``` This starts the Hub, the admin console and PostgreSQL on one server. Put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front of it to open it to your team. See [Deploy with Docker](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/get-started/docker) and [Deploy for a team](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/deploy).
Ports, data folders and troubleshooting are in [Run from source](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/get-started/run-from-source) and the [FAQ](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/get-started/faq). ## Why SoduWork AI agents give everyone fast output. What no one gets for free is trust in that output — or a way to keep what worked. That's where individuals and teams get stuck alike: | The problem | What SoduWork does | | --- | --- | | **Fast output, slow trust** — whether you work alone or in a team, the time AI saves goes back into checking what it produced | **The request is the spec.** Criteria set before work starts; a separate AI review checks each one; a person signs off | | **What worked dies in a chat thread** — for one person, it's last month's perfect run you can't reproduce; for a team, it's one person's method nobody else can use | **Get it right once, keep it as a plugin.** Reuse it yourself or publish it for everyone — every improvement reaches everyone | | **A drawer full of AI tools** — three subscriptions and no standard for which one does what | **One workbench, your playbook.** Your plugins run on every harness. Switch mid-conversation, keep your history and files | | **Results that never enter the workflow** — output gets copy-pasted around, and every handoff re-explains the background | **Issues that carry the context.** People and agents pick up where it left off, with a full record of who did what | ## How it works Requests, execution, review and reuse all happen in one shared issue pool: ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Raise a request] --> B[AI refines it
adds acceptance criteria] B --> C[Assign
yourself · a colleague · an agent] C --> D[Agent runs it
with a team plugin] D --> E[AI review
assignee confirms] E --> F[Requester signs off] F --> G[Save as a plugin] G -.reused by the team.-> D ``` | Role | Where they join | | --- | --- | | **Solo developer** | Puts requests in the pool, lets agents work through them, and only signs off | | **Specialist** | Gets a task right with AI, saves the method as a plugin, and publishes it to the team | | **Manager** | Drops in a request; AI fills in the criteria and routes it to a person or an agent; signs off at the end | | **New team member** | Uses the plugins the organization has built up to do the work to team standards, and improves them when they find a gap | Who asked, who did the work, which plugin ran and who approved it is always on record. ## Multi-harness · Multi-agent A harness is the agent runtime that does the work. It is not the model. SoduWork connects every harness through one adapter interface, so issues, plugins and review don't depend on any single harness. Switch harnesses mid-conversation and keep the history and the working folder. Programs that support the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) can be added with a catalog declaration.
Supported harnesses (9) | Harness | Models | How it connects | | --- | --- | --- | | Pi | Your SoduWork models | Built in | | OpenCode | Your SoduWork models | Native adapter, installed on demand | | DeepSeek Harness | Your SoduWork models, or your own DeepSeek key | ACP, installed on demand | | Qwen Code | Your SoduWork models | ACP, installed on demand | | Kimi Code | Your SoduWork models | ACP, installed on demand | | Codex Harness | Your SoduWork models | ACP, installed on demand | | Codex | Its own OpenAI account | Native adapter, installed on demand |
Agents work together at several levels: | Level | Who decides | Example | | --- | --- | --- | | Harness | The harness itself | OpenCode or Qwen Code starts its own subagents to explore the code or split a task | | Single method | A Skill or plugin sets the method, process, rules and what counts as done | A review plugin tells the agent which checks to run and what evidence to attach | | Combined methods | A plugin workflow picks the harness, Skill and model for each step | Pi drafts, Qwen Code checks the sources, and the run stops if the check fails | | People and agents | The requester and the assignee or their agent | A request goes to a colleague, their agent does the work, the requester signs off | | In parallel | The Hub | Different issues run on different agents at the same time, including on cloud runners | Between steps and between people, work moves the way the plugin and the assignee say. Agents don't hand work to other agents on their own. ## Plugins and apps A skill tells AI how to do something. An agent wraps AI into an assistant. SoduWork plugins and apps turn the way your team works into something that **runs, gets verified, improves and stays governed**. | | Skill | Agent | SoduWork plugin | SoduWork app | | --- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **What it is** | A method doc that AI reads and follows | Prompts, knowledge, tools or a platform flow | A versioned package: method, inputs, acceptance criteria, workflow | A plugin with its own UI
and an AI chat panel | | **Best for** | A single technique | One type of task | Standard team work, run by AI | Repeated work in a dedicated UI | | **How you use it** | AI picks it up | Inside its platform | `/` in chat · on issues · in automations | Its own window + AI sidebar | | **Step-by-step process** | ✗ | ◐ | ✓ | ✓ | | **Choose and switch harness** | ✗ | ◐ | ✓ | ✓ | | **Criteria, AI review, sign-off** | ✗ | ◐ | ✓ | ✓ | | **Versioning** | ✗ | ◐ | ✓ | ✓ | | **UI and interaction** | ✗ | ◐ Chat | ◐ Chat | ✓ | | **Review, grant, revoke** | ◐ Configurable | ◐ Configurable | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ Supported　◐ Partial　✗ Not supported. "Agent" means an assistant built on a typical agent platform; capabilities vary by platform. **From your chat to your playbook — yours or the team's**: create or save a plugin in chat → pre-check and try it locally → keep it for yourself, or submit it for review and publish it to the team catalog. Solo use stays light; team sharing adds review, grants and versioning.
Example: a weekly brief checked against its sources ```json { "schemaVersion": 1, "key": "weekly-brief", "version": "1.0.0", "name": "Weekly brief", "workflow": { "nodes": [ { "key": "draft", "type": "ai", "config": { "agentKind": "local:pi", "prompt": "Write deliverables/brief.md from this week's tasks." } }, { "key": "check", "type": "ai_review", "dependsOn": ["draft"], "config": { "agentKind": "local:qwen", "prompt": "Check each claim against the sources. Block if any claim has no source." } }, { "key": "done", "type": "publish", "dependsOn": ["check"] } ] } } ```
You don't have to write this by hand: describe the work to Plugin Developer in a chat and it produces the file. See the [plugin guide](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/plugins) and [apps](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/apps). ## How SoduWork compares - **vs. low-code agent builders**: no canvas, no wiring nodes. Finish a real task and save it as a plugin. Agents work directly on real files and projects, locally or in the cloud. - **vs. coding agent harnesses**: SoduWork doesn't replace them. It runs them as harnesses inside a team workspace and adds what they don't have: issues that flow from request to execution to sign-off, independent AI review, plugin review and distribution, and access control with audit. - **vs. multi-agent orchestrators**: people set the steps and checkpoints, and the requester accepts the delivery on evidence. Work moves between steps and people the way the plugin and the assignee say. - **vs. AI office assistants**: know-how doesn't stay in one person's chat history. It becomes a reviewed, versioned plugin — reused by future you tomorrow, and by the whole team next month.
Comparison table | | Low-code agent builders | Coding agent harnesses | Multi-agent orchestrators | AI office assistants | SoduWork | | --- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | Domain experts build and refine agents in chat | ◐ | — | — | ◐ | ✓ | | Engineering and non-engineering work | ✓ | ◐ | ◐ | ✓ | ✓ | | Mix harnesses and models as needed | ◐ | — | ✓ | — | ✓ | | Acceptance criteria built into requests, sign-off on evidence | — | — | ◐ | — | ✓ | | Plugin review, publishing and scoped access | ◐ | — | — | ◐ | ✓ | | Enterprise-grade production and team collaboration | ◐ | ✓ | ◐ | ◐ | ✓ | | Ready to use without building a business layer | — | ✓ | — | ✓ | ✓ | | Hosted service | ✓ | ◐ | ◐ | ✓ | ◐ Self-hosted | ✓ Supported　◐ Partial or varies by product　— Not supported. Based on how each category typically works.
## Architecture **The hard parts, handled:** | Hard part | How SoduWork handles it | | --- | --- | | Clients disagreeing about facts | The Hub is the single source of truth: issues, workflows, approvals and evidence live in the Hub, so every client sees the same facts | | Agents getting access they shouldn't have | Access is granted, not assumed: organization policy, runtime availability and the user's choices together decide what a session can use. Installing something doesn't authorize it | | Lock-in to one harness | One adapter interface for every harness: higher layers never depend on a particular harness. Switch harnesses mid-conversation and keep the history and working folder | | Methods that can't move | Method and environment are separate: plugins define the method; harness, model, runner and secrets are chosen when the plugin is bound. Plugin versions are immutable and portable | | Work nobody can trace | Interaction and execution are separate: the client handles chat and approvals; the runtime and runners do the work — locally or remotely — and every run lands in the audit record |

Inside the runner

The runner connects to the Hub over a WebSocket. Every dispatch has an ID, so the same task is never taken twice. Each harness runs in its own subprocess. Events are saved on the execution host before they are sent, and are sent again after a disconnect.
Known limits - **Cloud handoff moves context, not processes**: the working files, conversation and goal move to the cloud runner. Running processes and browser sessions don't, and you bring your own server. - **A plugin isn't always a workflow**: a plugin can just provide a method or a tool. Workflows are for multi-step work, approval points and resuming after failures. - **Runners and skills are not a general-purpose sandbox**: actual isolation depends on the harness and your environment. Only connect runners to a Hub you trust.
## Where does my data go? - When you self-host, issues, plugins and chat history are stored in your own Hub, and tasks run in the folder you choose. - Model requests go from the runner to the model provider you configure. Each run gets a short-lived credential; keys are not written to the harness's config files in plain text. - Prompts and files sent to a model provider or connector you configure are visible to that service. With self-hosted models, inference can stay in your environment. **Telemetry and updates.** This public source does not include a separate analytics or crash-reporting upload to MDiRi. The client defaults to `https://service.soduwork.ai`; its operational requests go to the Hub selected under **Connection** on the sign-in screen. You can change this address, and your saved selection is kept across restarts and upgrades. Using the hosted service sends those requests to its operator. Selecting your own Hub keeps this traffic with your deployment. - The selected Hub receives device/account authentication and the data required by the features you use. Usage accounting includes the conversation ID and title, Agent/model/provider identifiers, token and cost counters, and timestamps. Update attempts report version, progress, status and errors. These are operational records, not an optional analytics subscription. - Installed clients check the selected Hub for updates at startup and periodically (every six hours). Checks include the current version, platform, CPU architecture and update channel, authenticated with the device session. Source-launched clients skip installer update checks. There is currently no separate setting to disable Hub accounting or installed-client update polling; use your own Hub to avoid sending this traffic to the hosted service. Release-note requests also use the selected Hub. - Hub request/database performance statistics are maintained within the Hub process; they are not automatically exported to MDiRi. Dependencies and optional Agent downloads contact their configured package registries or mirrors, and models/connectors contact the services you configure. Those services have their own data policies. ## FAQ
I work alone. Is SoduWork overkill for me? Not if any of these hold: you re-check AI output yourself, you can't reproduce last month's perfect workflow, or you just want your AI tools to share one standard. Solo use needs no team setup — run it locally with SQLite in one command, and the organization features simply stay unused until you need them. Same plugins, same workbench, more people when you want them.
Is this just another agent platform or orchestrator? SoduWork doesn't replace agent harnesses — it runs them inside a team workspace and adds the layer they don't have: one shared issue pool from request to sign-off, acceptance criteria built into every issue, an independent AI review step, plugin review with scoped grants, and an audit trail. People set the steps, checkpoints and approvals.
Is this actively maintained, or is it a demo? It's an active public beta. Every release has release notes, and the release pipeline runs repository checks and test suites before a version is published. See the [Roadmap](#roadmap) for what's next, and [Contributing](#contributing) if you want to join.
Why do I need to sign in, and where is my data? Accounts underpin organizations, permissions, collaboration and audit. When you self-host, you sign in to your own Hub and your data is stored there. See [Where does my data go?](#where-does-my-data-go)
More answers are in the [FAQ on the developer site](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/get-started/faq). ## Roadmap | Status | Item | | --- | --- | | ✅ Shipped | Cloud runner (Personal Agent) support | | In progress | Development kits for plugins and apps | | In progress | Sandbox management for cloud runners | | In progress | Web and mobile apps | | Planned | Marketplace support for apps and plugins in enterprise and private deployments | Ideas are welcome in [Discussions](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/discussions). ## Community - **Chat**: [Discord](https://discord.gg/AXYNrAYHy) - **Bugs and feature requests**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/issues) - **Questions and ideas**: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/discussions) - **Enterprise**: private deployment, integration and support. Email [soduwork@outlook.com](mailto:soduwork@outlook.com). ## Contributing Issues, ideas, plugins, docs and code are all welcome. 1. Read the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) for local setup and the checks to run before a pull request. 2. Fork, create a branch and commit your changes. 3. Open a pull request with a description of the change and how you tested it.
Developer guides | Goal | Read | | --- | --- | | Build a plugin | [Plugin guide](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/plugins) | | Build an app | [Apps](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/apps) | | Add a harness | [Add an ACP harness](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/harnesses/add-acp-harness) | | Deploy and operate | [Deploy for a team](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/deploy) | | Commands and configuration | [Reference](https://dev.soduwork.ai/docs/reference/commands) |
### Contributors ## Security Please don't report security issues in public issues. Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) to report them privately. ## License and acknowledgements SoduWork's own code is copyright MDiRi and released under the [MIT License](LICENSE). # dsh-free-web-search

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40natgurlain%2Fdsh-free-web-search?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@natgurlain/dsh-free-web-search)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

A free web-search provider for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
web capability seam (`ctx.web`). It registers the search provider id **`free`**,
so the built-in `web_search` tool works without paying for a search API.

- **General web first:** Tavily answers out of the box in its keyless mode, and
  reliably once you add a free Tavily API key (1,000 credits/month, no card).
- **Free upgrades:** Brave Search API ($5 of free credits per month) and a
  self-hosted SearXNG instance slot into the same chain when configured.
- **X posts through Grok Build:** a query that targets X (`site:x.com`,
  "tweets about …") is answered by the `grok` CLI's X search when Grok Build is
  installed and signed in.
- **Keyless floor:** the Wikipedia Action API and Hacker News Algolia API keep
  `web_search` returning something when every general backend is unavailable.
- **Bounded and cancellable:** one search never runs past its time budget,
  Stop interrupts it at once, a rate-limited backend is skipped until its
  `Retry-After` passes, and a repeated query is answered from memory.
- **No dependencies:** Node's global `fetch` is the only network client.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` up to (but excluding) `0.3.0`.
- No other runtime dependencies.
- Optional: [Grok Build](https://x.ai/cli) (`grok`), signed in, for X search.

## Install

In DeepSeek Harness open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter:

```text
@natgurlain/dsh-free-web-search
```

and install. Enabling the bundle is enough: its patch inserts the provider row
and pins the web service to it, so the model-facing `web_search` tool starts
using it. From a terminal the same install is:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @natgurlain/dsh-free-web-search
```

To install a local checkout instead, pass its path:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-free-web-search
```

### First run: add the free Tavily key

Keyless Tavily is shared evaluation traffic: it stops after roughly ten
searches a day and then answers `429` until the next day. For everyday use,
create a free key at [tavily.com](https://tavily.com) (1,000 credits a month,
no credit card) and store it as `TAVILY_API_KEY` — in DeepSeek Harness's
credential settings, or as an environment variable. The plugin reads the
harness credential store first, so no restart is needed.

Without a key the plugin still works; once the daily cap is hit, results come
from Wikipedia and Hacker News only, and the tool result says so in one line.

## Backends

The provider tries backends in configuration order and returns the first
non-empty general-web answer. Keyless domain sources are merged and interleaved
only when no general-web backend answers.

| Backend id    | Service                     | Credential | Cost / limits |
| ------------- | --------------------------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| `x`           | X posts through Grok Build (`grok` CLI) | a signed-in Grok Build install | only used for X-targeted queries; uses your Grok plan; about 10 s per search |
| `tavily`      | Tavily Search (`api.tavily.com/search`) | none — keyless access mode; free key (`TAVILY_API_KEY`) recommended | keyless is capped at about ten searches a day; a free key gives 1,000 credits/month with no card |
| `brave`       | Brave Search API (`/res/v1/web/search`) | `BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY` or `braveApiKey` | no free plan; each plan includes $5/month free credits ≈ 1,000 queries; a card is required to activate |
| `searxng`     | A SearXNG instance with JSON enabled | `searxngBaseURL` | free and keyless when self-hosted; public instances usually disable JSON; can include the DuckDuckGo engine |
| `duckduckgo`  | DuckDuckGo consumer HTML endpoint (`html.duckduckgo.com/html/`) | none | best-effort fallback; **not an official API**, automated access is not authorized and is often answered with a CAPTCHA; see below |
| `wikipedia`   | Wikipedia Action API        | none       | keyless, encyclopedic results only |
| `hackernews`  | Hacker News (Algolia)       | none       | keyless, tech/community results only |

## Default behavior

- `tavily` answers first. `brave` and `searxng` are skipped until their key or
  base URL is configured; `duckduckgo` is the last general-web attempt.
- As soon as one general backend fails, `wikipedia` and `hackernews` start in
  the background. Their results are used only when no general backend answers,
  and the tool result then opens with one sentence naming what failed, for
  example: *General web search was unavailable (Tavily keyless mode daily limit
  reached); these results come only from Wikipedia and Hacker News.* The full
  per-backend diagnostics go to the harness log.
- **Rate limits:** a backend that answers `429` is not asked again until its
  `Retry-After` has passed (one hour for a daily cap without the header, one
  minute otherwise). A DuckDuckGo CAPTCHA pauses that backend for 15 minutes.
- **Cache:** an answer is reused for the same query for five minutes
  (`cacheTtlSeconds`); a fallback-only answer for one minute. The cache lives
  in memory and is gone when the plugin reloads.
- **Time budget:** each request gets at most `timeoutMs` (8 s), and one whole
  search at most `totalTimeoutMs` (25 s) — below the web tool's own
  `searchTimeoutMs` (30 s), so a stalled backend cannot get the tool call
  killed before the fallback answers.
- **Cancellation:** the caller's abort signal reaches every request and the
  Grok process, so Stop and tool timeouts interrupt a search immediately.

## X search through Grok Build

DeepSeek Harness has no way to search X on its own, and X has no free search
API. If [Grok Build](https://x.ai/cli) is installed and signed in
(`grok login`), this plugin uses it:

- A query is sent to Grok only when it targets X: it contains `site:x.com` or
  `site:twitter.com`, or mentions `x.com`, Twitter, tweets, or "on X" /
  "X posts". Every other query skips Grok entirely.
- The plugin runs `grok` in headless mode, in an empty temporary folder, with
  the read-only sandbox and every tool except X search removed (no shell, no
  files, no web, no MCP). Post text is untrusted input to that agent.
- An answer is accepted only if the run really called an X search tool, and
  only `x.com/<handle>/status/<id>` URLs are kept, so posts answered from the
  model's memory are discarded rather than cited.
- If Grok is missing, signed out, slow, or finds nothing, the normal chain
  answers and the result says the posts are general web results, not X posts.

The search uses your Grok account and plan. `grok` is looked up on `PATH`, then
in `~/.local/bin`, `~/.grok/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, and `/usr/local/bin`
(a desktop app does not inherit your shell's `PATH`); set `grokPath` if it
lives elsewhere. Remove `x` from `backends` to turn the feature off.

## DuckDuckGo caveat (read before relying on it)

DuckDuckGo has **no official API that returns web results**. Its only documented
machine endpoint is the deprecated Instant Answer API, which returns entity
cards, not search results. The consumer HTML endpoints are not a sanctioned
search API: DuckDuckGo's acceptable-use policy does not authorize automated
access, and the service responds to many automated clients with an HTTP 202
"anomaly" CAPTCHA page.

The `duckduckgo` backend is in the default chain anyway, as the last
general-web attempt, because it works from some networks. It is fragile: which
clients get the CAPTCHA changes over time and by network (on 2026-11-11 Node's
`fetch` got results where `curl` did not; on 2026-11-17 it was the reverse).
Consequences:

- The backend stays **after** the sanctioned backends in the default order.
- A CAPTCHA is reported as an error and the backend is paused for 15 minutes,
  so a blocked network pays for one failed request, not one per search.
- If you need a compliant, stable DuckDuckGo-backed path, run **SearXNG with
  its DuckDuckGo engine enabled** and use the `searxng` backend.
- To keep the plugin to sanctioned APIs only, remove `"duckduckgo"` from
  `backends`. You are responsible for how the endpoint is used.

## Configuration

The plugin exports a configuration schema, so the fields below are validated
when the plugin loads (a wrong type or an unknown backend id fails the load
with a message) and appear in the plugin's settings form, with API keys
masked. To set them by hand, override the plugin row in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: free-web-search
  name: '@natgurlain/dsh-free-web-search'
  config:
    backends: ['x', 'tavily', 'brave', 'searxng', 'duckduckgo', 'wikipedia', 'hackernews']
    tavilyApiKeyEnv: TAVILY_API_KEY
    braveApiKeyEnv: BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
    searxngBaseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8888
    wikipediaLanguage: en
    timeoutMs: 8000
    totalTimeoutMs: 25000
    cacheTtlSeconds: 300
```

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| ----- | ------- | ------- |
| `backends` | all seven, in the order above | Which backends to use and in what order |
| `tavilyApiKeyEnv` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference holding the Tavily key |
| `tavilyApiKey` | (unset) | Literal Tavily key; prefer the reference so no secret enters configuration |
| `braveApiKeyEnv` | `BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY` | Credential reference holding the Brave key |
| `braveApiKey` | (unset) | Literal Brave key; prefer the reference |
| `searxngBaseURL` | (unset) | Base URL of a SearXNG instance with JSON enabled |
| `wikipediaLanguage` | `en` | Wikipedia language edition |
| `timeoutMs` | `8000` | Upper bound for one request |
| `totalTimeoutMs` | `25000` | Upper bound for one whole search; keep it below the web tool's `searchTimeoutMs` |
| `cacheTtlSeconds` | `300` | How long an answer is reused for the same query; `0` disables the cache |
| `grokPath` | (found automatically) | Path of the Grok Build CLI |
| `grokModel` | (Grok Build's default) | Grok model used for X searches |
| `xTimeoutMs` | `20000` | Upper bound for one X search |

Keys are resolved for every search: first the literal value, then the harness
credential store (which also covers environment variables and `.env` files),
then the process environment.

To use `brave` first, move it before `tavily` in `backends`. To disable a
backend, remove it from the list; an empty list makes the provider unavailable.

### SearXNG setup

Self-hosted SearXNG serves JSON once `settings.yml` includes it:

```yaml
search:
  formats:
    - html
    - json
```

Public instances commonly disable JSON and answer 403, so point
`searxngBaseURL` at an instance you control or trust. SearXNG's default engine
set includes DuckDuckGo, which makes this the recommended way to get
DuckDuckGo results without direct scraping.

## Wiring

`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the provider row and pins the web service:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: free-web-search
      name: '@natgurlain/dsh-free-web-search'
      config: {}
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: free
    fetchProvider: http
```

The profile layer applies after this bundle, so a selection saved from the Web
search settings page (or a profile-level `web` row) wins over this pin. In that
page the provider is listed as **Free web search**. `web_fetch` keeps using the
shipped anonymous HTTP fetch provider, whose id is `http`.

## Notes and limits

- **Vendor fragility is expected.** Free tiers, keyless modes, and consumer
  endpoints change; the fallback chain and per-backend error messages exist so
  one vendor cannot break the tool completely.
- **Bounded output.** Snippets are whitespace-collapsed and capped at 480
  characters. Results are de-duplicated by URL, ignoring tracking parameters
  such as `utm_source`. The web service enforces the tool's final source cap.
- **User agent.** All requests send a descriptive `User-Agent` identifying the
  plugin; the DuckDuckGo backend sends a browser User-Agent instead because
  the endpoint answers anything else with a CAPTCHA.
- **Not included:** You.com/Exa remote MCP backends (they speak MCP rather than
  plain REST and can be mounted through DSH's MCP client).

## Development

There is no build step and nothing to install; the package ships plain ESM.

- Run the tests (they mock the network and Grok Build):

  ```bash
  npm test
  ```

- Run one live search with Node:

  ```bash
  node --input-type=module -e "
    const mod = await import('./index.js')
    let provider
    mod.apply({ web: { registerSearchProvider: (p) => { provider = p } } }, {})
    console.log(await provider.search({ query: 'deepseek harness', maxResults: 3 }))
  "
  ```

- License and publication: MIT, published as
  `@natgurlain/dsh-free-web-search`.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 Nat Gurlain

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DSH Image Slider

A left-sidebar image comparison panel for **DeepSeek Harness**. Load two images, overlay them, and move the pointer left/right to wipe between A and B with a smooth, eased reveal.

> Renamed from `dsh-image-compare` to avoid a package-name collision with another community plugin.

![Image Slider demo](docs/demo.png)

> 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个「图片对比」侧栏页面：两张图重叠，鼠标左右移动即可丝滑擦除对比。

## Features

- **Native left-sidebar entry** — registers through `sidebar.panellist` plus the matching `main` panel key. No iframe, no separate app.
- **Load images three ways** — click a card, drag & drop, or paste from the clipboard with `Ctrl/⌘ + V`.
- **Smooth pointer reveal** — the split follows the pointer and is eased with `requestAnimationFrame`, so hover and drag both feel fluid.
- **Clean divider by default** — just a thin line, with no handle or number; toggle **百分比** in the toolbar to show the draggable handle and live split percentage.
- **Draggable divider** — grab the split line at any time; double-click the canvas to reset to 50%.
- **Keyboard support** — `←` / `→` for 2% steps, `Shift` for 10%, `Home` / `End` for the extremes.
- **Fit or fill** — toggle between `contain` and `cover` without reloading either image.
- **Swap and reset** — exchange A/B or restore the default view from the toolbar.
- **Theme aware** — uses DSH theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`) and a neutral checkerboard stage.
- **Remembers the last comparison** — switch to the conversation and back; both images and the split position are still there.
- **Local only** — images are read from the file picker or clipboard into object URLs. Nothing is uploaded or sent to a model.

## Install

### From GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin --profile your-profile add github:PaleLand/dsh-image-slider
```

Then restart DeepSeek Harness and click **图片对比** in the left sidebar.

### From a local folder

1. Clone or download this repository.
2. Open DSH → **Plugins** → **Add plugin** and choose the repository folder (it contains `package.json`).
3. Restart DSH if the sidebar does not refresh.

The package is a plain local bundle: no build step, no server, no extra runtime dependencies.

## Usage

1. Open **图片对比** from the left sidebar.
2. Add an image to **图 A** and another to **图 B** — click the cards, drop files on them, or paste an image.
3. Move the pointer across the canvas to compare. Drag the divider to pin a position, or use the keyboard for precise steps.
4. Use **适配 / 填充** to switch between contain and cover, **交换** to swap the layers, and **复位** to return to 50%.

## How it works

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest; declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and the Web client entry. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `image-slider` plugin row. |
| `index.js` | Host half — intentionally empty. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: slot registrations, the panel UI, pointer/keyboard handling, and styles. |
| `icon.svg` | Sidebar icon. |

The client registers `sidebar.panellist` with `id: image-slider` and the matching `main` panel key. The panel keeps two object URLs, draws both images in the same stage, and clips the top layer with `inset(0 0 0 P%)`. A small `requestAnimationFrame` loop eases the displayed position toward the pointer target.

## Compatibility

Built and tested against **DSH 0.2.2-rc.3** on Windows. The plugin relies on the client slot contract from that release; older DSH versions may not expose the same sidebar and main-panel slots.

## Privacy

The plugin has no network calls. Images are opened locally through the browser file picker or clipboard and kept as in-memory object URLs for the current page session.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-chat-embed 在 **DeepSeek Harness（dsh）桌面版**里开一个**多标签 AI 聊天面板**。 左侧导航有「聊天」入口，点开后**中央主面板就是聊天页**：顶部一排标签 —— DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT、MiniMax、Kimi、Gemini、Grok —— 每个标签是一个真实的桌面 webview，**各自独立登录**；切标签不重载页面。同一个服务也能在**右栏**再开一页（会话头「⧉」按钮 / 右栏启动器）。左右是两份页面，不互相刷新；登录共用同一个分区，一侧登入，另一侧再打开就是已登入。 ![左栏「聊天」入口，中央主面板里是 DeepSeek 聊天页](assets/screenshots/01-deepseek-left-panel.png) --- ## 项目名称与组成 | 名称 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `dsh-chat-embed` | 本插件的包名，也是 dsh 插件管理器里的条目名 | | `index.js` | **Host 半侧**（Node）：只读探针 + 开关用的执行路由（起停补丁进程，自己不写文件） | | `client.js` | **Client 半侧**（浏览器）：多标签、租约握手、内联席位、全部 UI。手写产物，无构建 | | `locale/{en,zh}.json` | 插件管理器里显示的标题与简介 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 组合补丁：向 profile 插入 `id: chat-embed` 的 loader 行 | | `scripts/verify-bundle.mjs` | 门禁：语法 / 清单 / loader 契约 / 服务注册表 / 显示资源 | | `test/` | 纯 Node 契约测试（伪造 DOM + 伪造桌面桥 + 伪造 asar） | | [`docs/architecture.md`](https://github.com/poluce/dsh-chat-embed/blob/master/docs/architecture.md) | 内嵌契约、席位架构、壳补丁、升级复验清单（**接到项目先读这份**） | | `tools/shell-patch/` | 可选的桌面壳补丁：一个脚本管开启 / 关闭 / 清缓存 | **没有第三方运行时依赖**：`client.js` 直接由 dsh 的模块加载器执行，React 用壳共享的那一份。 > npm 包里**只有 README 一份文档**。`docs/` 与 `AGENTS.md` 是仓库内的维护者材料，不随包发布；下面凡是链到它们的都指向 GitHub。 ### 文档入口 | 想了解 | 读哪里 | | --- | --- | | 怎么装、怎么用 | 本文件（README） | | 为什么这样实现、内嵌契约、升级外壳时的复验清单 | [`docs/architecture.md`](https://github.com/poluce/dsh-chat-embed/blob/master/docs/architecture.md)（仓库内） | | 壳补丁（持久分区 / 关缓存）与回滚 | `tools/shell-patch/shell-patch.cmd`（macOS 用 `.command`） | | 门禁与测试覆盖了什么 | `scripts/verify-bundle.mjs`、`test/client.test.mjs` | --- ## 软件定位与功能 **定位**：给 dsh 桌面版补上一个"多服务 AI 聊天"的常驻界面。不代理请求、不保存聊天内容，只是把各站点装进独立登录态的桌面 webview。 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 左栏「聊天」→ 中央主面板直接是聊天页 | 顶部多标签切换，每个服务独立 webview、独立分区 | | 右栏聊天 tab（`keepMounted`）+ 会话头「⧉」 | 切标签不卸载，页面状态保留 | | 左右独立 | 各有一份页面，不互相刷新；登录共用分区，一侧登入另一侧再打开即已登入 | | 7 个内置服务 | DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT、MiniMax、Kimi、Gemini、Grok；改 `PROVIDERS` 一行即可扩展 | | 标签常驻 | 切标签只切 `data-active`（`display:none`），草稿与滚动位置保留 | | 失败隔离 | 单个标签失败不影响其它；「重新加载」只换该标签的租约 | | 拖动排序 | 按住标签横向拖动（>6px 才算拖动），顺序写 `localStorage`；溢出时滚轮横向滚动 | | ⚙ 设置 | 逐个启用/禁用服务，至少保留一个，状态持久化 | | 诊断（⚙ 菜单） | URL / 分区 / 阶段 / 右栏注册 / 席位 / 自检，一键复制 | | 调试日志（⚙ 菜单） | 默认关闭；开启后控制台输出插件事件，菜单里可「复制日志」 | | 原生布局跟随 | 聊天页放在席位布局盒里，宽高由 CSS 决定；拖分隔条零 JS、零重渲染 | | Google 登录死路 / 非桌面环境 | 自动退回入口并给出说明卡片；Web GUI 下显示说明 + 外开链接 | --- ## 截图 | 左栏：中央面板多标签 | 右栏：聊天 tab | | --- | --- | | ![ChatGPT 标签](assets/screenshots/02-chatgpt-left-panel.png) | ![右栏标签里的 DeepSeek](assets/screenshots/05-deepseek-right-tab.png) | | ![Gemini 标签](assets/screenshots/03-gemini-left-panel.png) | ![右栏标签里的 Gemini](assets/screenshots/06-gemini-right-tab.png) | ## 快速开始 ### 环境要求 | 项 | 要求 | | --- | --- | | 桌面端 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.2-rc.1`（实测；Windows 10/11） | | Node.js | `>= 22`（仅开发/测试需要，插件运行时不依赖 Node） | | 浏览器/壳 | Electron（`webviewTag` 开启）—— Web GUI 只能用降级卡片 | ### 安装（5 行） > 仅桌面版可用（需要 Electron 的 `` 和 `window.dshDesktop.browser`）。 > 当前实测版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.2-rc.1`；包声明了 `engines.dsh`，版本不符时插件管理器会拒绝安装。 **方式一：npm（已发布 `0.5.4`）** ```jsonc // 在 dsh 会话里交给插件管理器执行 plugin_manager { "action": "install_bundle", "target": "dsh-chat-embed" } // 然后刷新页面；左侧栏出现气泡图标即安装成功 ``` ```powershell # 命令行等价写法 dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-chat-embed ``` **方式二：git 仓库或本地 tarball** ```powershell # 从 Releases 下载 dsh-chat-embed-<版本>.tgz 后： dsh plugin --profile desktop add .\dsh-chat-embed-0.5.0.tgz # 或直接从公开仓库安装 dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/poluce/dsh-chat-embed.git ``` **方式三：在本仓库开发（link 方式，改完即生效）** ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本仓库克隆路径> ``` > 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-chat-embed`（或 `plugin_manager { "action": "remove_bundle", "target": "dsh-chat-embed" }`）。 ### 启动与打开 1. 打开 dsh 桌面版，左侧栏点「聊天」图标 → 中央主面板加载聊天页； 2. 或在任意会话的标题栏点「⧉」→ 右栏打开聊天 tab； 3. 标签切换 / 拖动排序 / 右上角工具行（重新加载、外开、设置）即可使用；诊断与调试日志在「⚙」菜单里。 --- ## 简要使用说明 | 场景 | 操作 | | --- | --- | | 打开聊天 | 左栏「聊天」图标（中央）或会话头「⧉」/ 右栏启动器（右栏） | | 切换服务 | 点标签；标签会记住上次激活项（`localStorage`） | | 拖动排序 | 按住标签横向拖到目标位置松手；溢出时用滚轮横向滚动 | | 隐藏某个服务 | 工具行「⚙」→ 关闭对应开关（至少保留一个） | | 页面卡住/白屏 | 工具行「重新加载」（换新租约）或「外开」到系统浏览器 | | 排查问题 | 工具行「⚙」→「标签页诊断…」→ 看地址 / 分区 / 状态 / 席位 / 自检，点「复制诊断信息」发给维护者 | | 打开调试日志 | 工具行「⚙」→「调试日志」开关（默认关闭）；开启后控制台输出插件事件，「复制日志」导出最近 200 条 | | 开启跨重启登录 | 工具行「⚙」→ 点「重启保持登录」开关：插件自己启动补丁脚本，面板提示你从托盘退出 DSH，退出后自动替换并重开；自动执行不可用时才弹出可复制的命令 | | 换到另一处显示 | 直接点另一处的入口（左栏图标或右栏 tab），聊天会接管过去并回到上次会话 | **登录**：每个服务在自己的 webview 里用站点自己的方式登录（验证码/扫码/邮箱）。登录态在同一次运行内有效；跨重启需要打桌面壳补丁（见 [已知限制](#已知限制)）。 --- ## 配置 ### 增删服务 服务清单只有一处：`client.js` 的 `PROVIDERS`。追加一条即可： ```js { id: 'gemini', label: 'Gemini', url: 'https://gemini.google.com/', origin: 'https://gemini.google.com', workspace: 'dsh-chat-embed:gemini:v1' }, ``` | 字段 | 作用 | 约束 | | --- | --- | --- | | `id` | 标签 id，也参与分区命名 | 小写、唯一 | | `label` | 标签文字 | 非空 | | `url` | 首次打开导航到哪里 | `https://` | | `origin` | 站点基址（诊断/策略用） | `url` 的前缀 | | `workspace` | 壳的存储身份 = 分区键 | 唯一；**发布后不可改**（改了就退出登录） | 改完执行 `npm run check` → 重装插件 → 刷新页面。门禁会校验 https、workspace 唯一、无未声明站点。 ### 运行时开关 - `⚙` 设置的启用状态存在 `localStorage['dsh-chat-embed:enabled']`； - 标签顺序存在 `localStorage['dsh-chat-embed:tab-order']`； - 上次激活标签存在 `localStorage['dsh-chat-embed:active-tab']`； - 调试日志开关存在 `localStorage['dsh-chat-embed:log']`（`1` 开 / `0` 关，默认关）； - 最近一次检测到的持久化状态存在 `localStorage['dsh-chat-embed:persist']`，重启后无需等 guest 挂载即可显示。 ### 桌面壳补丁（可选，跨重启免登录） **点一下开关就行：脚本由插件自己启动，不用复制命令、不用 agent、不用装 Node。** 1. 齿轮 → 「重启保持登录」开关点一下； 2. 面板底部出现一行：**请从托盘退出 DSH**（右键托盘图标 →「退出」）； 3. 退出后脚本替换 `app.asar`，然后**自动重新打开 DSH**；回来时开关已是「已开启」。 补丁要替换的 `app.asar` 被运行中的 DSH 映射着，Windows 上改名必然失败，所以那一次退出必须由你来做——壳没有给插件（也没有给任何外部进程）留退出的接口：窗口的关闭按钮只是收进托盘，真正的退出在抽屉菜单里并带确认。除了这一步，全程自动。 脚本也可以直接双击，走同一个入口： | 平台 | 双击 | | --- | --- | | Windows | `tools/shell-patch/shell-patch.cmd` | | macOS | `tools/shell-patch/shell-patch.command` | 脚本打开一个菜单： ``` 1) 开启 2) 关闭 3) 只看状态 4) 清理本面板缓存 0) 退出 ``` 选完按提示操作。**改完会提示重新打开 DSH**——正在运行的 DSH 用的是启动时读到的旧代码。 也可以在终端里直接跑： ```powershell node tools/shell-patch/shell-patch.mjs status # 只报告，不改文件 node tools/shell-patch/shell-patch.mjs apply # 开启 node tools/shell-patch/shell-patch.mjs revert # 关闭 node tools/shell-patch/shell-patch.mjs cache # 清缓存 node tools/shell-patch/shell-patch.mjs apply --restart --pid --exe "" # 开关走的就是这条 ``` 脚本默认会自己找安装目录（Electron 的 `resourcesPath`、`$DSH_RESOURCES`、各平台常见位置）。装在别处就指一下： ```powershell $env:DSH_RESOURCES = '<安装目录>/resources' node tools/shell-patch/shell-patch.mjs apply ``` > 通过 npm 安装时脚本位于 `/node_modules/<包名>/tools/shell-patch/`；设置菜单里的开关也会告诉你它的确切位置。 **为什么要补丁**：桌面壳把内嵌浏览器的分区命名成 `dsh-sidebar-browser-<随机 uuid>`——没有 `persist:` 前缀（Chromium 只放内存），而且每次启动换一个新 uuid，一重启就全部退出登录。补丁改成按工作区身份 hash 出来的 `persist:` 分区，登录自然落盘。 | 改写 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | `persist:` 固定分区 | 登录态落盘，跨重启保留 | | `cache:false` | 不写 Chromium 的磁盘缓存（可用 `--no-cache-patch` 关掉这一项） | ### 脚本怎么保证不出事 - **先校验再替换**：新归档从原归档自己的字节重建，除 `lib/main.js` 外**每个文件必须逐字节一致**，否则不动手； - **命令幂等**：已经是目标状态就只报告，不重复改； - **关闭不依赖备份文件**：`revert` 把两处改写**反向写回去**，所以即使 `app.asar.orig` 已经被弄脏（旧版本就踩过这个坑）也能还原成原版； - **干净备份才留**：已存在的干净 `app.asar.orig` 不会被补丁版覆盖——这正是旧版本「点了关闭其实没关掉」的原因； - **DSH 在跑就等**：Windows 上运行中的 `app.asar` 被内存映射占用，脚本提示你退出 DSH，退出后自动继续并重新打开它（`--wait-minutes` 限时，命令行默认 10 分钟，面板开关传入 12 小时；超时**一个字节都不改**并删掉暂存文件）； - **需要提权会自动请求**：安装目录不可写时 Windows 弹 UAC、macOS 弹管理员授权，不用自己开管理员终端再敲一遍。 ### 补丁状态 设置菜单里「重启保持登录」这一行显示四种状态： | 状态 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | 已开启（`persist:` 分区） | 补丁生效，重启后仍登录 | | 未开启（内存分区） | 没打过补丁 | | **已失效**（升级覆盖） | 打过补丁，但桌面壳升级覆盖了 `app.asar`，再点一次开关即可 | | 尚未检测 | 还没打开过聊天页 | 开关直接执行：Host 端 `GET /dsh-chat-embed/patch`（带探针发的 token）会启动脚本。脚本最多等 12 小时，等你从托盘退出后再替换文件、重新打开 DSH。超时则删掉暂存文件，`app.asar` 一个字节都不改；原因写在安装目录的 `dsh-chat-embed-patch.log`。**只有自动执行不可用时**（安装目录要管理员权限、壳改了分区写法、找不到安装目录、Host 版本还没有这条路由）才会弹出确认框，里面给出该双击哪个脚本和可复制的命令。 设置菜单里「缓存」这一行显示即将清掉的大小。开启时只清这 7 个分区里的 Chromium 缓存，登录保留；关闭时整份删除这 7 个残留分区（会清掉留下的登录），并且先确认。其他分区和 DSH 自己的登录不动。 背后是 Host 侧只读探针 `GET /dsh-chat-embed/patch-check`：安装目录、`app.asar` 是否可写、是否已打补丁、补丁点是否还在（壳版本是否兼容）、备份**是否干净**、脚本与启动器的绝对路径、开启与关闭两条命令，以及开关要用的 token。它只读，不写任何文件。 ### 界面语言 面板文案**跟随 DSH 的语言设置**（设置 → 通用设置 → 语言：中文 / English 等）：插件注册 `zh` / `en` 两套词典，通过 DSH 的 locale 服务解析当前语言，**切换后立即生效，不需要刷新或重启**（监听 `locale/change` 事件重渲染）。 - 当前语言没有对应翻译时（例如日语、西班牙语），回落到**中文**； - 诊断卡片里的席位、状态、最近事件、自检读数也随语言切换； - 插件管理器里的标题与描述（`locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json`）同样是 DSH 系统界面的一部分，跟随系统语言。 --- ## 目录结构 ```text dsh-chat-embed/ ├── package.json # 都只存在于仓库，不进包；文档类只发 README 一份。门禁会拦住「又把 `docs` 加回白名单」这种事。 --- ## 工作原理（简要） 1. **五处 slot**：`main`（中央聊天页）、`sidebar.panellist`（左栏图标）、`sidebar.right.pane.tab`（右栏 tab body）、`sidebar.right.pane.tab.title`（右栏 chip 标题）、`conversation.session.header.utilities`（会话头「⧉」）。 2. **租约握手**：点标签 → `window.dshDesktop.browser.acquire(workspace)` → 拿到一次性 `lease` 与 `partition` → 建 ``。三个属性必须完全一致，否则壳在 `will-attach-webview` 拒绝。 3. **导航**：只能从 guest 文档内部导航（`executeJavaScript('location.href = …')`），`loadURL()` / 改 `src` 无效。 4. **内联席位**：聊天页渲染在席位布局盒里（`width/height:100%`），拖分隔条由浏览器布局，零 JS 测量；切标签只切 `display:none`，元素不移动。 5. **席位接管**：席位挂载即认领 guest；另一席位若仍挂载则显示移交卡片。宿主变化时丢弃旧 guest 并重建（Electron 无法搬移 webview），再用 `startUrlFor()` 回到上次会话地址。 6. **隔离**：每服务一个 workspace、一个分区、一个 guest、一条租约；一个标签失败不影响其它。 > 想看证据、契约细节与升级检查清单：**[docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/poluce/dsh-chat-embed/blob/master/docs/architecture.md)**（仓库内，不随 npm 包发布）。 --- ## 开发 ```powershell # 获取最新代码（当前仓库未配置远程地址，按你实际的 remote 替换） git clone dsh-chat-embed cd dsh-chat-embed # 无需安装依赖；直接跑门禁与测试 npm run check # 打包检查 + 全部契约测试，两条都绿才算过（CI 同样会跑；数量以输出为准） npm test # 只跑测试 ``` **没有构建步骤**：`client.js` 就是最终产物。改完后重装一次让浏览器拿到新 generation： ```jsonc plugin_manager { "action": "remove_bundle", "target": "dsh-chat-embed" } plugin_manager { "action": "install_bundle", "target": "<本仓库克隆路径>" } ``` 提交前约定：门禁必须绿；代码注释/提交信息英文，文档中文；同时改 `package.json` 的 `version` 与 `client.js` 的 `BUILD`。 动手前先读 **[AGENTS.md](https://github.com/poluce/dsh-chat-embed/blob/master/AGENTS.md)**（仓库内，不随 npm 包发布）：三个半侧的职责边界、`app.asar` 必须走 `original-fs`、启动器的编码限制、门禁拦什么、以及七个真实踩过的坑。 ### 发布与分发 一条命令发版（门禁 → 提交 → 推送 → 等 CI → 发布 npm → 打 tag → 建 Release，中途失败可重跑续做）： ```powershell node scripts/release.mjs 0.6.7 --summary "这次改了什么" node scripts/release.mjs 0.6.7 --summary "..." --dry-run # 只看计划 ``` 发版细节、CI 与 dependabot、插件列表投稿：见 **[docs/publishing.md](https://github.com/poluce/dsh-chat-embed/blob/master/docs/publishing.md)**（仓库内，不随 npm 包发布）。 --- ## 已知限制 1. **跨重启登录需要壳补丁**：壳默认给内存分区（`dsh-sidebar-browser-`，无 `persist:`，每次启动随机），登录态不落盘。`tools/shell-patch/` 可修；客户端升级会覆盖 `app.asar`，需要重打——菜单里的「重启保持登录」开关会告诉你现在是哪种情况，点一下就能重打。 2. **右栏属于会话**：中央打开聊天面板时，右栏的会话表面不在，`⧉` 打不开。左右页面各自独立，不会因为切到另一边就把这一边的页面搬过去。 3. **中心面板的外壳会卸掉，页面不会**：选另一个主面板时标签栏随 DOM 卸掉，但聊天页留在文档里只是隐藏，切回来是原来的那一页，不用重新打开。右栏 tab 仍带 `keepMounted`。 4. **内存**：每点亮一个标签 = 一个渲染进程；7 个全开会明显吃内存。 5. **Google / Apple 登录无法在内嵌面板完成**：GSI 依赖 `window.opener` 交回凭据，面板无弹窗上下文；插件识别死路后自动退回入口并提示用邮箱登录。 6. **人机校验**：ChatGPT 首次打开可能要求过一次。 7. **仅 Electron**：无 Tauri / 第三方壳适配；Web GUI 降级为说明卡片。 8. 聊天页宽度依赖席位布局盒（`.dce-inline` 100%）；若 dsh 改掉主面板 / tab body 结构需复核。 --- ## 常见问题 | 现象 | 处理 | | --- | --- | | 侧栏没有「聊天」图标 | 插件未启用 / 未加载：看 **设置 → 插件**，或重装一次 | | 左栏入口打开是空白/卡片 | 看「⚙ → 标签页诊断… → 席位 / evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# diwen-dsh 迪文（Diwen）DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Cordis 插件 —— **open-core，自包含（装上即用）**：开源 Cordis 壳（工具 + skill）+ **内置**闭源核心与加密概念数据（`vendor/diwen/`）。 装进 profile 的 `node_modules` 后**不需要相邻包、不需要完整 Diwen 仓库 checkout**：核心以包内相对路径 `./vendor/diwen/index.mjs` 引入。 许可：**允许商用、不可再分发、必须署名作者 Pondsi**（见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)）。 ## 自包含结构 ``` packages/diwen-dsh/ ├── index.js 开源 Cordis 壳：defineTool × 2 + 运行时 skill ├── cordis.patch.yml dsh 组合包 patch（insert id=diwen, name=diwen-dsh） ├── skills/diwen/SKILL.md 运行时 skill 内容（模型视角说明书） ├── selftest.mjs 自测（只 mock peer；核心走真实 vendor 制品） └── vendor/diwen/ 内置 open-core 制品（闭源，随包分发） ├── index.mjs 加载壳：import './env.cjs' → export * from './dist/core.mjs' ├── env.cjs 解密壳：以 __dirname 相对读 dist/data.enc → 临时目录 → DIWEN_DATA_DIR ├── package.json 制品元数据 ├── index.d.ts 类型声明 └── dist/ ├── core.mjs 闭源核心（minify bundle，约 198 KB） ├── data.enc 加密概念数据（AES-256-GCM，约 26.5 MB） └── diwen.schema.json 契约 JSON Schema ``` - `vendor/diwen/` 与 npm 包 `packages/diwen` 的运行时制品**逐字节一致**（同一构建产物，不含 `node_modules`）。 - `env.cjs` 用 `__dirname` 相对定位 `dist/data.enc`，`core.mjs` 用 `import.meta.url` 相对定位 `dist/diwen.schema.json`，数据目录经 `DIWEN_DATA_DIR` 注入 —— 全部包内自洽，无外部路径假设。 - **体积**：`vendor/` 共 7 个文件、25.5 MiB（26.76 MB），主要是 `data.enc`（25.3 MiB）。每个宿主进程首次加载时会解密到系统临时目录（389 个数据文件 / 14 个子目录，约 18.9 MiB）并设置 `DIWEN_DATA_DIR`。 - **运行时依赖仅 `@node-rs/jieba`**（中文分词，含平台原生二进制），已声明在本包 `dependencies`，安装时自动装上；核心以 bare `require('@node-rs/jieba')` / `require('@node-rs/jieba/dict.js')` 解析，无需任何相对路径。 ## 工具与 skill | 工具 | 参数 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `diwen_map` | `text`（必填）、`model?`（auto/deterministic/decision/off，默认 deterministic）、`enhance?` | 中文文本→迪文契约 `contract{status, words[span, slots S1..S7], uncovered, coverage}`；`semanticApproval` 恒 false | | `diwen_describe` | `id`（必填，number） | 概念详情：lemma_zh / coord / field / bfo_type / nsm / pinyin / definitions | 宿主提供 skills 服务（`ctx.get('skills')`）时，另注册运行时 skill `diwen`（内容读 `skills/diwen/SKILL.md`）：模型视角说明书，涵盖何时用工具、公理②（自然语→迪文需模型选义）、公理④（无概念→verbatim 不伪造）、`semanticApproval=false` 含义。 ## 安装 前提：已安装 dsh CLI。**无需** Diwen 仓库 checkout，无需手工装核心。 ```bash # GitHub 子目录安装（公开分发仓库；建议锁定 commit） dsh plugin --profile

add github:Pondsi/dsh-diwen#path:packages/diwen-dsh # 本地路径（在仓库根目录执行） dsh plugin --profile

add ./packages/diwen-dsh ``` 安装后验证层并启动： ```bash dsh --profile

--dump-config # 应看到 diwen-dsh 层（insert id=diwen） dsh --profile

``` 注意： - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 是 **peerDependency，由 dsh 宿主提供**，本包不捆绑、不安装。 - `@node-rs/jieba` 是 **dependencies，安装时自动安装**（含对应平台的原生可选包）。若安装环境拿不到原生二进制，核心会 catch 并降级（分词器为空），机械匹配仍可跑但切分质量下降。 - GitHub 子目录安装要求该仓库快照**已包含 `packages/diwen-dsh/vendor/`**（自包含版本）。若加载报 `Cannot find module '../diwen/index.mjs'`，说明快照仍是旧的「相邻包引用」版本：改用本地路径安装，或更新到含 `vendor/` 的 commit。 - `model:'decision'` 需本机可用的 ollama 与决策模型；`model:'auto'` 走云端 provider（见下方限制）；`deterministic`/`off` **完全离线**，装完即可用。 ## 自测 ```bash node --check packages/diwen-dsh/index.js node packages/diwen-dsh/selftest.mjs ``` `selftest.mjs` 用 Node 模块定制钩子（data-URL loader）**只 mock peer 依赖** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（恒等 `defineTool`），并**拦截任何 `../diwen/...` 解析**以证明自包含；**迪文核心不 mock**，直接加载 `./vendor/diwen/index.mjs` 真实制品（在仓库内自测时 `@node-rs/jieba` 由根 `node_modules` 向上解析提供）。断言： - `apply(mockCtx)` 注册 `diwen_map`/`diwen_describe`，`output.schema` 为 `{type:'object', additionalProperties:true}`； - `diwen_map.execute({text:'我吃饭',model:'deterministic'})` 返回 `contract`，`semanticApproval=false`；缺省 model 时 `modelUsed=false`； - **`diwen_describe.execute({id:1223}).lemma_zh === '折'`** —— 该词元只存在于加密数据中，断言成立即证明 `vendor/diwen/dist/data.enc` 解密加载成功； - 无此概念 → `ok=false`（不伪造）；`output.render` 产出 text；运行时 skill `diwen` 注册。 ## open-core 与许可 - **开源壳**：`index.js` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `skills/` / `README.md` / `selftest.mjs` / `vendor/diwen/env.cjs`（解密壳）。 - **闭源**：`vendor/diwen/dist/core.mjs` 与加密概念数据 `vendor/diwen/dist/data.enc`；不得试图解密、提取、绕过或再分发。 - **许可**（全文见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)）：个人与商业使用免费、无需另行授权；**不可再分发**本项目本身（源码、闭源核心、加密数据，含 `vendor/` 副本）；使用/集成须署名「Diwen / 迪文」、作者 **Pondsi**，并在程序文档/关于页附仓库链接 。 - 诚实说明：客户端加密/混淆只**提高提取成本**，并非不可破（解密密钥在开源壳内）。如需真正保密，须把核心与数据服务端化。 ## 共同约定 - 公理②：自然语→迪文需模型选义；deterministic 只是机械基线。 - 公理④：无对应概念→verbatim 如实保留（`contract.uncovered`），不伪造。 - `semanticApproval:false` 恒成立：机器规范通过 ≠ 语义正确 ≠ 人工批准。 - 当前仅支持中文。 ## 限制 - 覆盖率非 100%（公理④设计）：未收录义项如实 verbatim，不就近吞并。 - `vendor/` 内是**发布构建产物**，不含开发期可选增强料（如拼音豁免表、歧义句料）；核心对这些路径有存在性守卫，缺失时相应增强层不生效，`deterministic`/`off` 主路径不受影响。 - 云端选义（`model:'auto'`）在构建产物内读取**作者开发机上的密钥文件**（无环境变量覆盖），接收者环境不存在该文件 → 云端路径不可用；请改用本地 ollama 决策模型（`model:'decision'`）或离线路径。 - 每个宿主进程首次加载都会在系统临时目录新建一份解密数据（约 18.9 MiB），进程内复用；插件本身不做清理（由操作系统临时目录策略回收）。 # dsh-diwen — Diwen (迪文) Concept Coordinate System ## What Diwen is: a communication language for machines Diwen is designed for **machine-to-machine communication** — a **machine-verifiable concept coordinate system** for agent-to-agent exchange, the deterministic content in natural-language↔machine interaction, and machine-to-machine interaction. Natural language is ambiguous and drifts; Diwen anchors meaning to discrete concept coordinates (S3a semantic field × S3b construction), so machines can **align precisely**, and each concept renders back to a unique natural-language definition. Typical uses: - **Multi-agent collaboration** — agents exchange meaning via concept coordinates, avoiding misunderstandings caused by natural-language ambiguity. - **Sub-agent communication** — a lead agent and its sub-agents exchange tasks and results as deterministic concepts. - **Deterministic knowledge-base content** — knowledge anchored to machine-verifiable concepts rather than fuzzy text. - **Context summaries / prompts** — compressed meaning carried as concept coordinates, stable across turns and models. Diwen is **not a translator** and does not generate natural language; it is a verifiable semantic intermediate representation above natural language. > 中文概要见 [说明.md](说明.md)。 ## Status: Chinese is deliverable The Chinese part is **deliverable and usable**: | Path | Concept accuracy (measured, holdout / real domain) | |---|---| | Cloud deepseek (enhanced) | 0.9933 (enhanced holdout reaches 1.0) | | Local decision d3:4b (enhanced + calibrated) | 0.9636 → curated 0.9818 | | Local chat qwen3:8b (enhanced) | 0.9727 | | Cross-family ensemble | 0.9636 | | Deterministic mechanical (lower bound, not the production path) | 0.5173 | Axiom ① (Diwen → unique Chinese definition) is 100% deterministic. `semanticApproval=false` always holds: passing mechanical validation ≠ semantically correct ≠ human-approved. When no concept exists, the original text is preserved verbatim (Axiom ④) — nothing is fabricated. ## Roadmap 1. Continuously improve Chinese usability (coverage expansion, real-domain generalization). 2. Complete development of 27 languages, then support more. 3. Merge concepts and eliminate natural-language partitions; share concept coordinates across languages. 4. Machine-expand concepts and semantics for more natural languages. 5. Continuously refine humanity's existing concepts and semantics. 6. Machine-expand concepts that do not yet exist in natural language. 7. Machine-refine concepts describing the physical world. 8. Machine-refine abstract concepts describing the world. 9. Machine-abstract higher-density concepts, evolving structures better suited to each concept. 10. Continuously improve Diwen so it can clearly describe all things in the world. ## Quick start This repo is Diwen's **open-core public distribution**: open loader shell + closed core (minified bundle) + encrypted concept data (AES-256-GCM). Clone, then `npm install` to use offline. ### npm package Published on npm — install directly: ```bash npm install diwen ``` ```js import { mapChinese, describeConcept } from 'diwen'; // Natural language → Diwen fill contract (Axiom ②: model sense selection; Axiom ④: no concept → verbatim) const r = await mapChinese('我吃饭', { model: 'deterministic' }); // 'auto'|'decision'|'off' console.log(r.contract.status, r.contract.words, r.semanticApproval); // semanticApproval always false // Diwen → unique Chinese definition (Axiom ①) console.log(describeConcept(1223).lemma_zh); // 折 ``` Or use from this repo: `cd packages/diwen && npm install`, then `import ... from './index.mjs'`. - `model:'decision'` uses a local ollama decision model (d3:4b etc.) + calibrated abstention; `enhance:true` enables the enhancement layer. - The runtime segmentation dependency `@node-rs/jieba` is installed automatically. ### MCP server (zero-dependency stdio) ```bash node packages/diwen-mcp/server.mjs ``` Configure your MCP client with `command=node, args=[/packages/diwen-mcp/server.mjs]`; tools `diwen_map{text,model?,enhance?}`, `diwen_describe{id}`. Self-test: `node packages/diwen-mcp/selftest.mjs` (42/42). ### DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin **Self-contained**: open Cordis shell + bundled closed core/encrypted data (`vendor/diwen/`), works on install. `dsh plugin --profile

add github:Pondsi/dsh-diwen#path:packages/diwen-dsh` (or a local path); registers `diwen_map`/`diwen_describe` + skill `diwen`. Self-test: `node packages/diwen-dsh/selftest.mjs` (includes isolated-install verification). ## Manuals - [docs/USAGE-MANUAL.md](docs/USAGE-MANUAL.md): non-technical usage manual (install, call, license, attribution). - [docs/PACKAGE-USAGE.md](docs/PACKAGE-USAGE.md): npm / MCP / dsh integration guide. - [说明.md](说明.md): Chinese overview. ## Decision-model choice capacity (advice + error feedback) A decision model's `--choice` option limit **varies per model and is not fixed**. Measured hard limit is 255 for all (ollama interface); effective discrimination limits: tev1:0.8b=32 / d3:4b=128 / clef-flash=255 / clef=128. **You decide which models to use; Diwen does not forbid any**: `checkModelCapacity` gives advisory hints; on a runtime error `decisionSelect` uses `classifyModelError` to report "this is a model-capacity issue (e.g. too many options) — switch model or reduce candidates". ## Repository layout ``` packages/diwen/ npm package: index.mjs/env.cjs open shell + dist/core.mjs closed core + dist/data.enc encrypted data packages/diwen-mcp/ MCP server (open shell, reuses closed core) packages/diwen-dsh/ dsh plugin (self-contained: open Cordis shell + vendor closed core + skill) docs/USAGE-MANUAL.md non-technical usage manual docs/PACKAGE-USAGE.md integration guide 说明.md Chinese overview SPONSORS.md sponsor page sponsors/ donation QR images LICENSE license ``` ## License **Commercial use permitted (free, no separate authorization), no redistribution, attribution required**: credit Diwen / 迪文 + author **Pondsi** + repository link. Full terms in [LICENSE](LICENSE). ## Support If Diwen helps you, consider sponsoring — see [SPONSORS.md](SPONSORS.md). Donations buy no extra features; everything stays free. ## Limitations - Currently only Chinese is deliverable; other languages are on the roadmap (Axiom ⑤: language-independent mapping, no pivot). - Coverage is not 100% (by Axiom ④ design); words without a concept are preserved verbatim, never fabricated. evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-live-run

任务运行时的**实时运行面板**：一个侧栏 tab 里同时看到

1. **当前文件** — 模型此刻正在读/写/改的文件，正文带行号；编辑显示行级 diff（红删绿增）
2. **写入过程** — 每一次 read / write / edit，时间、类型、路径、行数变化；点一行钉住它
3. **命令输出** — 运行中的 pwsh/bash 任务，stdout/stderr **流式滚动**，可切换多个任务

## 数据从哪来（没有任何新采集）

| 面板 | 来源 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 当前文件 / 写入过程 | 会话的 Chat 快照（`uiSession` → `hooks.conversation`） | 模型工具调用与结果本来就在会话里，含**正在执行**的调用；工具从 `run_code`/`pwsh` 里直接调 `writeFileSync` / `Set-Content` 也会被识别 |
| 命令输出 | `ctx.jobs`（client jobs 服务） | job 注册表的环形输出缓冲，`observe(jobId)` 是**只读观察**，不移动模型自己的读取游标 |
| 面板位置 | `betterSidebar.registerTab` | 出现在侧栏「+」菜单里，单实例 |

不需要 host 路由、不需要 RPC、不需要构建步骤：`lib/client.js` 是手写的 CJS 工厂 bundle（`react` 是页面模块表的平台种子）。

## 用法

1. 右侧栏（better-sidebar）**+** → 选「实时运行」
2. 让 agent 干活：读写文件、跑命令，面板自动跟随
3. 想看某个历史文件 → 在「写入过程」里点它（钉住，不再跟随最新）；点「跟随最新」恢复
4. 有多个命令任务时，用标题栏右侧的小按钮切换
5. **长命令**：标题栏只显示一行摘要；面板里有完整的 `$ 命令` 块——默认折叠成一行（悬停可看全文），点「展开」自动换行并可滚动，点「折叠」收回去；旁边「复制」直接复制整条命令。标题栏本身禁止收缩，不会被长命令挤成竖排。
6. **展开状态会被记住**：按「会话 + 命令」记，不是全局开关——展开 A 命令不会让 B 也展开；关掉面板再打开、切换会话再回来、刷新页面（同一标签页）都保持你上次的选择。新命令默认折叠。

## 设置（设置 → 侧边卡 → 实时运行）

两个开关都是插件私有的（better-sidebar 的 `settings.pluginToggles`，存在侧边卡的 `pluginSettings['dsh-live-run:pane']` 里，不走宿主 schema，改完立即生效）：

| 开关 | 默认 | 开 | 关 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 记住展开/折叠状态 | 开 | 按会话 + 命令记忆，重挂载/刷新都不丢 | 只用组件状态；**关闭时立即折叠当前命令块并清空该会话已存记录**（再打开不会复活旧状态） |
| 复制为可粘贴的一行 | 关 | 安全时折成一行；不安全时按原样复制并说明原因 | 复制命令原文 |

「折成一行」的规则与边界：

- 语句之间用 `; ` 拼；续行符（`|` `,` `{` `(` `[` `&` `=` `+` `-` `*` `/` `%` 等）、行尾反引号后的续行用空格拼
- **拒绝折叠**（改为原样复制并提示）：here-string / heredoc、注释、跨行字符串——这三类拼起来要么报错，要么**静默改语义**（跨行字符串会把 `; ` 塞进字符串内容里）
- PowerShell 规则用本机真实解析器验证过：`node tools/feasibility-one-line.mjs` 产出候选，再用 `[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput` 判分（12 个样本：9 个可安全一行化且解析 0 错误，3 类拒绝）。bash 分支同一套形状，但只做了保守实现，未做同类实测。

## 能力边界（如实说明）

- **前台命令**同样会出现在面板里：`dsh-tool-pwsh` 每次调用（含前台）都会先在 jobs 注册表登记，再等待结果，所以面板能看到它**边跑边输出的过程**——对话里的工具卡片要等跑完才有结果，这里不用。
- **前台命令结束后**，它的 job 记录会被注册表 `remove()` 掉（给前台调用者的清理约定）。面板因此保留"结束前观测到的最后一段输出"，并在没有活动 job 时自动回落到**会话记录里的 shell 调用结果**（标「会话记录」）。三层来源：实时 job → 最后观测 → 会话历史。
- 「写入过程」按 **op 粒度**（一次 read/write/edit 一条），不是逐字符输入流；正在执行的那条显示 `…`，结束后补上正文与行数。
- 环形缓冲有上限：输出过长时最早的部分会被丢弃，面板会标出「输出被丢弃」。
- 面板依赖 better-sidebar 提供 tab 位；未安装时不会渲染任何东西（不会报错，也不影响 DSH 启动）。
- 展开状态存在两层：模块内存（页面生命周期，一次挂载到另一次挂载都有效）+ `sessionStorage`（按会话 id 存，刷新页面仍在）。关掉整个标签页会清掉 sessionStorage 那份；内存那份也不跨页面。默认折叠的命令不占存储（折叠即删除该条），每个会话最多记 200 条。
- 本部署若没有 `jobs` 客户端服务，命令区不会假装有实时流，而是直接用会话记录里的 shell 结果；一个 shell 调用都没有时明确提示。

## 文件构成

```
package.json                 dsh.client(platform:web) + dsh.bundle(patch)
cordis.patch.yml             一条 insert 层
lib/index.js                 host 半体：只保留插件身份（无路由、无服务）
lib/client.js                浏览器半体：数据钩子 + tab 注册 + UI（手写 CJS 工厂 bundle，无构建）
locale/zh.json               插件市场展示文案
tools/smoke.mjs              37 项离线测试（自写迷你 React 运行时，真跑数据通路）
tools/verify-install.mjs     校验 profile 解析到的就是我这份字节、且只请求 react
tools/feasibility-one-line.mjs  一行化规则的可行性实验（供 PowerShell 解析器判分）
LICENSE                      MIT
```

## 安装

前置：**dsh-better-sidebar**（本插件通过它的 `registerTab` 提供面板；没有它不会渲染任何东西，也不影响 DSH 启动）。

```bash
# 从 GitHub 源码安装（多数网络可用）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Prcjimmy1015/dsh-live-run

# 若 github: 装不上（codeload 被代理阻断等），改用预构建 tarball
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/Prcjimmy1015/dsh-live-run/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-live-run-0.1.0.tgz"
```

装完刷新页面，右侧栏 **+** → 「实时运行」。`--profile` 填你实际使用的 profile（`web` / `desktop` 等）。

> 本机 codeload.github.com 经代理不可用时，`github:` 形式会 fetch failed —— 这是网络限制，不是插件问题，换 tarball 即可。

## 作为插件索引源

本仓库带一份 [format-1 插件索引](index.json)。在 DSH 0.2.1+ 里打开 **插件 → 实验性插件 → 自定义插件索引**，添加索引地址即可在「发现」里看到并安装：

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Prcjimmy1015/dsh-live-run@main/index.json
```

（Discover 给每个索引源 15 秒超时，所以用 jsDelivr 而不是 raw.githubusercontent。）


## 验证

```bash
node tools/smoke.mjs          # 37 项，必须全绿
node tools/verify-install.mjs # 需要已装到某个 profile；用 DSH_LIVE_RUN_PROFILE 指定其它 profile 绝对路径
```

## 许可

MIT

# 小说助手 · dsh-novel


DSH（DeepSeekRuntime）插件：把「写长篇小说」变成一条模型能稳定接管的流水线——
章节结构、资料连续性、续写时的上下文装配、进度与字数反馈。

- 包名 / 目录：`dsh-novel` ｜ 插件短名（cordis row id）：`novel` ｜ 显示名：小说助手
- 两个半边：`index.js`（宿主 / Node 进程）、`client.js`（Web 壳 / 浏览器）
- **路线图与数据契约见 [docs/功能规划.md](docs/功能规划.md)**（写代码前先读它）
- 历史决策考古见 [docs/design.md](docs/design.md)

> 一句话定位：**一个工作区 = 一本书**。插件不存正文，正文永远是工作区里的 `chapters/NNNN.md`。

## 目标字数：book.json 说了算

每章目标字数的唯一真相是 `book.json` 的 `targetChars`。**没写**时插件用默认 3000，只在状态里标「默认值」，不会替你写进文件；要定下来就调 `novel_book({ targetChars })`。作者在大纲里写的「4 章 × 1000 字」只是散文，需要被翻译成 `targetChars: 1000` 才算数——否则会出现「大纲说 1000、自查按 3000 报偏短」的假警报。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-novel/
  package.json        # manifest：main + dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client.platform=web + exports "./client"
  cordis.patch.yml    # 插件层：insert 一行 { id: novel, name: dsh-novel }
  index.js            # 宿主半边：书模型 + 十八个工具 + /novel-api 路由（只读 + 十二个写接口）
  client.js           # 客户端半边：状态条 + 右栏一格「小说」，页内十个分区（章节 / 章纲 / 事件 / 人物 / 设定 / 伏笔 / 文风 / 版本 / 大纲）
  docs/功能规划.md     # 路线图 / 数据契约 / 技术红线（唯一真相）
  docs/design.md      # 最初的切面草案（保留作决策记录）
  README.md
```

## 它现在能干什么（v0.2 宿主 + 界面）

工作区里有一本书时（`book.json` + `chapters/*.md` + 可选 `outline.md`、`beats.md`、`events.md`、`characters/`、`threads.md`、`settings/`、`styles/`）：

> 没有 `book.json` 也能读：章 id 从文件名里认（`0003 第三章 湖心亭.md` → id `0003`、标题「第三章 湖心亭」），第一次 `novel_write` 时会自动补出 `book.json`。

- 输入框下方一条状态：`《雾港旧事》 2/3 章 · 597 字 · 伏笔 4`
- 右栏「小说章节」页：按**目标字数**的总进度条 + 章节行（`已写/目标`，`planned` 灰显「未写 +」，**点一下即建章并打开**）+ 点开读正文
- 右栏「小说人物」页：**列表 / 关系图**切换。列表是卡片（摘要 + 关系数），关系图是 SVG 环形布局，边取自人物卡 `## 关系` 小节的 `- 目标：说明` 行；没建卡的人物画成空心虚线点
- 关系图按时间回放：人物卡 `## 关系` 的行可以写 `- 老周 @0007：开始怀疑她`（自第 7 章起；不写就是从开篇就有，只记起点不记终点），图上选「关系截至 第 N 章」就能看关系网怎么长出来的网怎么长出来的；不写标记＝一直成立
- 人物生死时间线：人物卡加一节 ## 状态，写 - @0003 去世（雾港码头失足）、- @0004 现身（其实没死）；关系图把「截至第 N 章已死」的人画成灰色 + 名字带 †，跟死人相连的线变虚线，切章节能看到「死了又活」
- 新建一本书时，把 templates/AGENTS.md 拷到书目录根并改书名——它是给 AI 的作业规范（人物卡 ## 关系 / ## 状态 怎么写、设定首行 - 分类：、章纲 ## 0003 开头），DSH 会把它当项目指令自动注入，模型不用猜格式
- 右栏正文按 Markdown 渲染：标题、列表、粗体、行内码、引用、代码块、表格、分割线都能显示（渲染器是自带的 120 行实现，因为平台没把官方 Markdown 组件暴露给第三方插件）；**中文正文的单个换行当硬换行**（段落不粘连），行首全角缩进保留
- **手机返回键先退右栏一步**：章节正文 / 人物详情 / 展开的设定或文风 / 某一版历史，各占一格浏览器历史；按返回先回上一层（比如「正文 → 章节列表」），退到页面顶层才真的离开。实现在 `client.js` 的 `useBackStep` + `popstate`
- 右栏「小说大纲」页：按 `##` 分节显示，「编辑」可就地改并保存；底部「问 AI」把大纲全文 + 你的问题写进主对话输入框，回车即发
- 右栏「小说章纲」页：**单独一页**，按章节顺序列出每章要拍的场景清单（`beats.md` 每章一节），没写就「写章纲」，有就就地编辑保存；顶部显示覆盖进度，还有一行**节奏台账**（`爽点 N / 计划 M · 有爽点的章 X/Y · 钩子 K 章 · 最长断档 G 章`），每章标题右侧一个 `爽×2 钩` 徽标。台账是**从章纲标记现算的，不存盘**——所以不会和章纲打架
- 右栏「小说事件」页：**事件线台账**（`events.md`，一条线一节：`## 主线：远离与反扑` + `### 主线-1 真相落地（1–3）`，每个事件写 `- 因为：` / `- 所以：` / `- 不可替代：`）。一条线跨多章，一章也可以推好几条线；章纲里用 `- 事件：主线-1、感情-1` 锚定，区间只是默认值、锚点做修正。页面上按线分组，事件展开显示因果与覆盖章（`0001✓` 已写 / `0003○` 只有章纲）。**章纲页右缘还有一排窄泳道**，与每一章逐行对齐，一条线一列点，一眼看出「哪一章推了哪几条线、哪条线断了」
- 右栏「小说设定」页：世界观条目（`settings/` 一条一文件，地点/规矩/物品/术语），一行一条带分类徽标，点开读全文、可就地编辑保存
- 右栏「小说伏笔」页：未回收 / 已回收两段，每行「伏笔名 + 埋设章 · 计划回收章」，到期的标「到期」并给一条橙色提醒，「收回 / 重开」一键改状态（写回 `threads.md`）
- **每一页底部都有「问 AI」条**（章节列表 / 章节正文 / 章纲 / 人物列表 / 人物卡 / 设定 / 伏笔 / 大纲）：把这一屏的内容 + 你的问题写进主对话输入框，留空则问该页的默认问题；只填不发，回车由人按
- 右栏「小说文风」页：一套文风一行（名字 + 在用徽标 + 字数 + 一句话），点开读全卡，「编辑」就地改，「用这套」写进  book.json 的 style；底部可新建空卡。启用后 
ovel_context 会把文风卡一起装配给 AI，
ovel_check 会按卡里的 ## 禁忌 查禁用词（style-banned）。
ovel_check 命中后会提示「照着这套句子写」，不是靠形容词叮嘱。

- 对话里我可以用十八个工具替你写书：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `novel_status` | 看整体：书名、章数、总字数/目标、人物卡张数、未回收伏笔、每章 `字数/目标 · 状态` |
| `novel_book` | 书的元信息：书名 / 作者 / 类型 / 一句话简介 / **每章目标字数**；`targetChars` 是全书默认（每章可单独覆盖），写章自查按它判长短 |
| `novel_read` | 读某一章正文 |
| `novel_write` | 写正文（`mode: append` 默认 / `replace`，可带 `status`；省略 `chapter` 自动建下一章并登记进 `book.json`） |
| `novel_outline` | 读 / 写 `outline.md` |
| `novel_context` | **续写前的标准动作**：一次拿到本章大纲 + 上一章末 + 出场人物卡 + 该惦记的伏笔（默认 ≤ 2000 字） |
| `novel_card` | 人物卡：无参列清单 / 给 `name` 读 / 再加 `content` 写 |
| `novel_check` | 写完自检（只报告不改）：旧称残留 / 未登记说话人 / 重复句 / 半角标点 / 相对目标字数偏长偏短 / **章纲写的场次没落到正文（`beats-gap`）** / **这一章没有爽点（`no-payoff`，会带「已连续 N 章没有」）/ 章末没有钩子（`no-hook`）** |
| `novel_beats` | 章纲：无参看全书覆盖 / 给 `chapter` 读这一章的拍摄清单 / 给 `content` 覆盖写（只动这一节） |
| `novel_events` | 事件线：无参看全书事件线与推进情况 / 给 `line` 读那条线（含覆盖章、已写数）/ 给 `line` + `content` 整段替换这一条线（别的线不动） |
| `novel_threads` | 伏笔：无参看清单（未回收 / 已回收 / 到期未收）/ 给 `thread` + `planted`/`payoff`/`status` 登记或改状态 |
| `novel_style` | 文风：无参列卡 / **`clone: true` + `source`（原文路径）＝一键克隆**（读原文→算节奏→切 3–5 段连续锚点→写卡→存原文→设为当前，缺的只有「视角与时态」）/ 给 `source` 或 `text` 只做**量化分析**（句长、段长、对话占比、标点密度、高频词 + 均匀采样 5 段原文锚点）/ 给 `name` 读卡或写卡（`content`）/ `active: true` 顺手启用 |
| `novel_audit` | 全书巡检：`{ level?, limit? }`。把逐章检查横向扫一遍（空章 / 字数偏差 / 章纲漏写 / 伏笔到期 / 配角欠场 / 事件未锚 / 断爽），按严重度排序。**只报能算出来的事实，不给评语**；写完一批章跑一次，比逐章 `novel_check` 省事。 |
| `novel_export` | 导出正文：`{ from?, to?, format?, mode?, out? }`。全书或区间 → `export/` 下一个 txt/md，或按章拆开；返回章数、字数、落盘文件名。 |
| `novel_history` | 历史版本：`{ chapter }` 列这一章的时间线（时间 / 字数 / 来源 / 被什么替换 / 用的是哪套文风），`{ chapter, version }` 读那一版全文 |
| `novel_restore` | 恢复到某一版（`{ chapter, version }`）；**恢复前先把当前内容也留一版**，所以恢复本身能撤销 |

只读接口（供界面取数）：`/novel-api/state`、`/novel-api/chapter?id=`、`/novel-api/characters?chapter=`（含关系图 `graph`、人物 `states`）、`/novel-api/character?name=`、`/novel-api/threads`、`/novel-api/outline`、`/novel-api/beats?chapter=`、`/novel-api/settings`、`/novel-api/setting?name=`、`/novel-api/events?chapter=`、`/novel-api/event?line=`、`/novel-api/history?chapter=`、`/novel-api/history-all`、`/novel-api/version?chapter=&version=`、`/novel-api/styles`、`/novel-api/style?name=`、`/novel-api/style-sample?name=`、`/novel-api/audit`。
十二个写接口（都要求头 `x-novel-action: 1`，其余方法一律 405）：
`POST /novel-api/start-chapter`（`{ id }`，右栏点 `planned` 章节时建章）、`POST /novel-api/outline`（`{ content }`，大纲页保存）、`POST /novel-api/beats`（`{ chapter, content }`，章纲页保存）、`POST /novel-api/setting`（`{ name, content }`，设定页保存）、`POST /novel-api/thread`（`{ thread, planted?, payoff?, status? }`，伏笔页「收回 / 重开」与登记）、`POST /novel-api/style`（`{ name, content }`，文风页保存）、`POST /novel-api/style-active`（`{ name }`，切换在用文风，空名字＝取消）、`POST /novel-api/style-clone`（`{ source, name? }`，文风页「克隆文风」一键从原文起卡）、`POST /novel-api/style-delete`（`{ name }`，删一张文风卡：卡和参考原文一起挪进 `styles/.trash/`，删的正好是在用的那套就顺手取消启用）、`POST /novel-api/event`（`{ line, content }`，整段替换一条事件线）、`POST /novel-api/export`（`{ from?, to?, format?, mode? }`，把全书或区间导出到 `export/`）、`POST /novel-api/restore`（`{ chapter, version }`，恢复到某一版，先给当前内容留一版）。

**写入时会做格式校验，但只警告不拒绝**：`novel_card` / `novel_setting` / `novel_beats` / `novel_write` / `novel_threads` 的返回里都带 `warnings`，渲染成「⚠ 格式提醒（已写入，但下面这些位置读不到）」——比如关系小节写成了散文、状态小节没写 `@0003`、设定首行没写 `- 分类：`、章纲里手打了 `## 0003` 标题、正文里混进了 `## 关系`。写歪的内容照样落盘，只是不会被关系图/时间线读到。

书库根目录解析顺序：`config.root`（钉死）→ **会话自己的工作目录** → 环境变量 `DSH_NOVEL_ROOT` → 进程 `cwd`（兜底）。

## 安装（本机实测过的两条命令）

```powershell
# 装进试验 profile（独立进程，不碰桌面 App 里正在跑的会话）
dsh plugin --profile web add link:E:\workspace\idea-workspace\dsh-novel
# → 会自动往 web profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里追加 "dsh-novel"
```

`link:` 是跨盘符号链接，改源码 = 改已装包，不用重装。

> `desktop` profile **CLI 管不了**：`error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。
> 装进桌面版要走 设置 → 插件 → 添加插件（填本地绝对路径），或 agent 侧的 `plugin_manager` 工具。

## 踩过的坑（都写进 功能规划.md 第八节了）

1. 客户端 `exports.inject` 只认**字符串数组**；写 `{required, optional}` 会被当成两个服务名，插件永远 pending。
2. 可选服务不要写进 `inject` 数组，用 `ctx.inject(['sidebarRightTabs'], inner => ...)`。
3. 右栏 `guide` 卡片的 `title` / `description` 必须是**函数**。
4. 宿主侧不要 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（link: 装的插件解析不到），手写等价对象，但必须带 `output.render`。
5. 端口被占先查归属：`Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 18080`；**54081 是桌面 App，别杀**。

## 占位梗概不算正文

`chapters/0001.md` 里只写一行 `（待写）重生在 1998 年…` 时，它只是结构，不是章节：

- `novel_status` 把它标成「待写（占位）」，不计入「已写 N 章」，另起一行告诉你「有 N 章还是占位」；
- `novel_check` 只报一条 `[placeholder]`，不再拿字数和章纲去制造噪音；
- `novel_write` 写入这种内容也不会把章节状态转成 `draft`。

## 设定为 0 时会主动喊

`novel_status` 与 `novel_context` 在 `settings/` 为空时都会提醒：世界规则只写在 `outline.md` 里等于没建，先用 `novel_setting` 建 3–8 条（地点 / 规矩 / 物品 / 术语）。这不是提示词，是宿主代码里的判断，模型绕不过去。

## 爽点 / 钩子：写在章纲里，不另建表

章纲的每一场末尾可以标三种东西：

```markdown
- 场景：江野 → 把批条推过去 → 柜员脸色变了 → 爽点（信息压制）
- 落点：出门时有人叫住他。钩子：王厂长在车里等着。
```

- `→ 爽点（类型）`：这一场给了读者情绪回报（打脸 / 翻盘 / 揭秘 / 情感兑现 / 强强对话 / 信息压制）。
- `→ 钩子`：章末留翻页理由，每章至少一个。老写法 `钩子：…` 也认。
- `→ 转折`：这一场把方向拐了个弯。

**没有 `爽点.md`，也不需要。** 爽点只有一个端点（发生在哪一场），是场景属性；单独建表必然和章纲形成双份真相，而且模型写正文时装配的是章纲，表在写作路径上看不见。所以台账由宿主现算：

| 看哪里 | 显示什么 |
|---|---|
| 章纲页顶部 | `爽点 12 / 计划 15 · 有爽点的章 8/12 · 钩子 11 章 · 最长断档 3 章`，断档 ≥2 章时变红 |
| 章纲页每章 | `爽×2 钩` 徽标 |
| 输入框上方状态条 | `· ⚠ 断爽 3 章` |
| `novel_status` | 全书节奏一行 + 断档提醒 |
| `novel_check` | `no-payoff` / `no-hook` |
| `novel_context` | 装配包里一段「## 节奏（这一章怎么给读者回报）」 |

预算（`打脸×3` 这种）写在 `outline.md` 的 `## 爽点节奏` 里，属于计划层；实际有几处永远以章纲标记为准。

## 导入旧稿：读文件的能力归插件，判断边界归 AI

不另设「导入」工具 —— 它无非是现有工具的编排。插件只负责 AI 做不好的那件事：**编码和分页**。

```js
novel_read({ source: 'D:\\books\\旧稿.txt', limit: 4000 })            // 自动认 UTF-8 / GBK / UTF-16
novel_read({ source: 'D:\\books\\旧稿.txt', offset: 4000, limit: 4000 }) // 接着读
```

返回里带 `encoding` / `chars` / `nextOffset` / `done`，所以不分页也不会读漏。剩下的交给会话里的 AI：

1. `novel_read({ source })` 扫几屏，看清章节标题长什么样（有没有「第N章」、有没有目录页）
2. **它自己判断边界** —— 插件不猜，猜错一次要重导
3. 逐章 `novel_write({ chapter, title, content })` 落盘（自动留历史版本）
4. `novel_status` 核对章数与字数
5. 需要的话再逆向提炼：`novel_outline` / `novel_card` / `novel_setting` / `novel_style({ clone: true, source })`

长篇别让它一口气读完：每 8–10 章派一个 subagent 只读原文、只返回摘要，主上下文负责汇总。

## 去 AI 味与全文语义复核

去味由机械线索检测和会话语义审稿共同完成；插件不会自动改稿，也不会把检测通过当作自然度认证。

1. **写作前约束**：普通 `novel_context({ chapter })` 和改写装配包都包含场景审稿纪律与最新交付流程，已有小说无需重建规范文件。`pass: "deai"` 额外带上机械命中线索。
2. **阅读全文**：`novel_deai_pack({ chapter })` 返回全部非空正文段落、原文坐标、整章 `baseHash`、人物声口和完整文风卡。语义审稿覆盖时间压力、细节堆叠、过度解释、角色雷同和固定句段模板，不仅检查带标签的片段。
3. **按需修改**：`novel_write({ chapter, mode: "patch", baseHash, patches: [{ start, end, content }] })` 一次提交多个不重叠修改，所有坐标基于同一版原文。原有单片段写法仍可用；每次写入后需要重新取包，不能复用旧哈希和坐标。
4. **登记复核**：对最终审稿包全部段落提交 `{ index, reason }`，并填写 `checks` 的 `timing`、`voice`、`narration`、`rhythm`、`facts` 五项判断，再调用 `novel_deai_review({ chapter, baseHash, checks, paragraphs })`。有待改问题先修改；无须修改也应记录具体保留理由。记录保存在 `book.json` 对应章节的 `deaiReview` 中，仅对该正文版本有效。
5. **最后自查**：`novel_check({ chapter })` 默认开启机械线索检测；`aiTone: false` 仅关闭该检测，不跳过语义复核。当前版本未复核会报 `deai-review-pending`，也不能通过 `novel_write` 标记为 `final`。修改已复核正文会使记录失效。
6. **右栏入口与旧书**：「去AI味」按钮提示先读取完整审稿包并局部修改，不再截取 1200 字要求整章覆盖。`novel_book({ scaffold: true })` 可为旧书追加或更新插件管理的复核小节，保留原有自定义内容。

`ai-tone` 报零类不代表自然，出现线索也不必强改。正常重复、长句、对比和角色口癖可以保留；不通过统一粗口、抢话或短句来消除线索。当前版本已登记完整语义复核后，机械线索仍会展示，作为复核参考而不再单独判失败；正文变化后需重新复核。复核记录表示会话提交了审稿依据，不能证明其判断一定正确。

## 节奏与戏份：规格写在数据里，不是写死在代码里

- **爽点断档阈值**取 `outline.md` 里的「三章一爽点」/「每 3 章至少一次爽点」，中文数字也认；读不到才退回默认 2。状态条的「断爽 N 章」、章纲页红字、`novel_check` 的 `no-payoff` 都按这个数。
- **戏份承诺**写在人物卡：`- 戏份：每 8 章至少出场一次`。插件按正文统计出场（含卡里的「旧称」），超期报 `absent-role`，人物页挂「欠场」徽标，`/novel-api/characters` 的 `appearance` 字段带 `{last, gap, cadence, due}`。
- 出场统计按「书的内容指纹」缓存，轮询不会把几十章反复读一遍；只看「有正文的章」，占位梗概不算出场。
## 右栏只有一个 tab

平台 tab 条每个 chip 最小 80px、不换行、手机上还滑不动，十页放不下（试过合并、试过「更多」页、试过改 CSS 让条子能横滑，都被裁）。现在是**一格「小说」+ 页内九个分区**，分区按钮在页内自动换行，小屏也点得到。
## 文风闸门：写完当场比一次节奏（`style-fit`）

文风卡只在开头注入一次是不够的：实测一本 80 章的书，句均字数从 17 掉到 10.1、含对话段占比从 26% 涨到 64.5%、每千字句号从 46.8 涨到 89.7 —— **漂移是单调累积的**，写歪一章，下一章会照着歪掉的稿子继续歪。

所以插件在三个地方替他盯着（基准是文风卡的 `.sample.md` 原文，没有样本就退回卡里的 `## 锚点原文`）：

| 位置 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `novel_write` | 写完自动比一次节奏，偏离就在返回的 `warnings` 里点名 |
| `novel_check({ chapter, aiTone: true })` | 报 `style-drift`，写清「句均 10.5（卡上 17，偏少 0.62 倍）」 |
| 右栏章节列表 | 偏离的章挂一个「漂」红标（数据来自 `/novel-api/audit`） |
| `novel_audit` / `GET /novel-api/audit` | 全书一次扫，`style-drift` 与 `beats-gap` 一起列 |

比的都是**可数**的东西，不判断「写得好不好」——那是 AI 的活。但只有两个指标算硬判据：**句均字数（±30%）、每千字句号（0.7–1.5 倍）**；段均字数、含对话段占比、每千字逗号、破折号/省略号只是「参考值」，会显示在 `/novel-api/style-fit` 里但**不报警**——它们测的是排版习惯，读着顺就是顺。

正确用法：出现 `style-drift` 时先对照文风锚点和完整场景复核，确认问题后局部修订，再登记最终版本语义复核；不因统计偏差就直接整章重写。

## 文风上下文装配（2026-11-16）

- [x] 顶部视角与叙述权限优先注入；规则支持 `[必选]` 标记，不再只取每节前两条。
- [x] 按完整条目选择规则、锚点与正反例；预算不足时不截断句子。
- [x] `novel_context` 的 `style` 增加 `included`、`omitted`、`budget`、`used`；省略项带原因，并在文本结果中展示。文风额度按含空白及标题的 Unicode 字符计，总上下文预算改造仍见 `doc/优化规划.md` 第 3 项。

验证：`node --test tests/style-context.test.mjs`；`node --check index.js`。宿主联调及真实生成效果尚未验证。


### 禁忌解析与检查（第二项）

- [x] 模板一行一项：`禁用词：氤氲`、`整句：他拿起笔。`；兼容旧卡的斜杠、顿号词表，以及带空格斜杠分隔的整句列表。整句内部标点保留。
- [x] `## 少用词` 只提醒；`## 语义禁忌` 交给会话 AI 复核。未标类型的“不要 / 不得 / 避免”等自然语言要求转入待复核，并提供格式提醒。
- [x] `novel_check` 禁用项返回命中总数与前 20 处行列、原文片段；新增 `styleReview` 返回少用词命中、语义待复核项和格式提醒。这些提醒不单独导致 `ok: false`，`ok` 仅反映自动检查结果。

验证：`node --test tests/*.test.mjs`（7 项通过）。


### 上下文预算与局部改写（第三项）

- [x] `novel_context.budget` 约束最终 `prompt`，以含空白、标题和指令的 Unicode 字符计量，不是模型 token 上限；结构化元数据与宿主封装不在此额度内。
- [x] 必要内容放不下时返回 `ready: false`、`minimumBudget` 和后续操作，不再截取长章前 6000 字符后引导整章覆盖。
- [x] 新增 `rewriteStart` / `rewriteLimit`，返回 `rewriteScope`（start、end、total、nextStart、baseHash）。索引按 Unicode 字符，start 包含、end 不包含。
- [x] `novel_write` 支持 `mode: "patch"`，必须提供 chapter、start、end、baseHash，仅替换指定范围，保留其余正文并沿用整章历史备份。原文哈希不一致拒绝写入。`replace` 可提供 baseHash；旧调用保持兼容。

```js
novel_context({ chapter: '0001', mode: 'rewrite', rewriteStart: 0, rewriteLimit: 1000, budget: 6000 })
// 仅在 ready=true 后，根据返回的 start/end/baseHash 提交修改：
novel_write({ chapter: '0001', mode: 'patch', start: 0, end: 1000, baseHash: '<返回值>', content: '<修改后的片段>' })
```

每次保存后重新读取上下文，重新确定下一段起点：修改会改变长度，旧 nextStart 和旧哈希不能直接复用。先核对事实、动作、信息点，再调整文风；这部分仍需会话 AI 复核。

验证：`node --test tests/*.test.mjs`（11 项）、`node --check index.js`。宿主联调尚未完成。
