evidence.readmeExcerpt:
Answer me with HTML

## Sponsored by Zapply Explore Zapply's Chrome extension for autofilling job applications, dedicated job board featuring the latest openings, multiple profiles for different resumes and roles, and application tracking with streaks and commitment awards.

Answer me with HTML

An agent skill. Ask a hard question, get a page you can actually read instead of a wall of text.
The model writes about 1/8 of the tokens it would need to hand-write the HTML.

Website · Install · Examples · Videos · Always-on mode · Reference · 简体中文 · 日本語

Once installed, ask questions the way you always do: ``` > Explain the TCP three-way handshake > Map out how the modules in this repo fit together > Redis or Memcached for our cache? ``` The agent writes a short Markdown draft and hands it to the CLI that ships with the skill. About 50 ms later you have a page: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d3063a28-5dfd-4c44-a562-be901c49b249

24-second demo. Turn the sound on for the music.

## Why not just ask for HTML? You can. Models write decent HTML now. But most of what they write is not content. We counted the tokens in 9 pages the model wrote by hand, 4,893 tokens on average: | Part of the page | Share | With this skill | | :--- | ---: | :--- | | SVG diagrams: coordinates and paths | 47% | The CLI writes it | | CSS | 15% | The CLI writes it | | HTML tags | 17% | The CLI writes it | | Text | 21% | The model writes it, as Markdown | With this skill the model writes only a Markdown draft. For the same questions that was 612 tokens on average, **about 1/8 of the hand-written HTML**. Less to write means less to wait for (3 topics × 3 runs, medians, Claude Sonnet 5.5, a plain Claude Code setup): | | Ask for HTML directly | Answer me with HTML | | | :--- | ---: | ---: | :--- | | Tokens the model writes | 4,893 | **612** | **8× fewer** | | Time | 31 s | **12 s** | **2.6× faster** |

The same question, the same model, answered both ways. Both pages are usable.

The token counts are saved in [bench/corpus/tokens.json](bench/corpus/tokens.json), so `node bench/corpus.mjs` gives the same numbers every time. The pages themselves are a [download](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html/releases/download/v0.4.14/bench-corpus-2026-10-07.zip). The bill drops less than the writing, about 15% here, because every turn also reads the system prompt, your question and the conversation, with or without the skill. See [where the cost goes](bench/README.md#where-the-cost-goes). Explainer videos save even more: about 18× fewer output tokens and 12× faster in [a small test](bench/README.md#explainer-videos). ## Install You need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20 or newer. There is no `npm install` step. The CLI is bundled inside the skill. No Node.js yet? With the recommended install below, your agent asks you and then installs it. ### Let your agent install it (recommended) Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode or any other agent: > Install Answer me with HTML: read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html/main/INSTALL.md and follow it. [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) is written for agents. It installs the plugin in Claude Code and the skill in other agents, keeps an existing install, asks you nothing unless Node.js is missing or older than 20, and ends with one report after checking the result with the TCP three-way handshake page. If your agent cannot open links, use `npx -y skills add QingYunA/answer-me-with-html -g -y -a ` (for Claude Code, `-a claude-code`). ### Claude Code plugin Run this inside Claude Code: ``` /plugin marketplace add QingYunA/answer-me-with-html /plugin install answer-me-with-html@answer-me-with-html ``` ### DeepSeek Harness plugin Run this in a terminal, with the profile you run in (`web` is the shipped one): ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:QingYunA/answer-me-with-html ``` ### One command ```bash npx skills add QingYunA/answer-me-with-html ``` It asks which agents to install into. The installer, [vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills), supports more than 70 agents.
Manual install Copy the `skills/answer-me-with-html` folder into your agent's skill folder. For Claude Code: ```bash git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html.git /tmp/answer-me-with-html cp -R /tmp/answer-me-with-html/skills/answer-me-with-html ~/.claude/skills/answer-me-with-html ``` Skill folders for other agents: Codex `~/.codex/skills/`, Cursor `~/.cursor/skills/`, OpenCode `~/.config/opencode/skill/`.
No setup is needed after install. **We recommend turning on [always-on mode](#always-on-mode-recommended)**: the agent then adds a page to every conclusion, not only the hard ones. It takes one rule in your rules file. ## What you ask, what you get | You ask | You get | | :--- | :--- | | "Explain the TCP three-way handshake" | A sequence diagram, a state diagram and a flag table | | "How are the modules in this repo organized?" | A folder tree plus a call graph | | "Redis or Memcached?" | A comparison table with ✓ and ✗, then a verdict | | "What's wrong with this paragraph?" | Each sentence annotated, with the problem words and fixes | | "How did Kubernetes come about?" | A timeline with the key moments highlighted | | "Plan the cache change" | The real code from your files, and the open decisions as options you answer on the page | | "How do I show hidden files with `ls`?" | No page. A one-line question gets a one-line answer | The agent decides when a page is worth it: related concepts, multi-step flows, multi-way comparisons. You can also just say "explain it in HTML". Pages are saved in `~/.answer-me-with-html/pages/`. The buttons in the top-right corner switch the theme and light/dark mode, collect your reply, and copy the Markdown that produced the page. ## How is this different from Archify or GenUI plugins? [Archify](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify) makes one interactive diagram from a JSON spec. GenUI plugins such as [dsh-genui](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui) show components inside one chat app. This skill answers the whole question as one page: text, tables, code and diagrams, from a Markdown draft, in any agent that can run a shell command. See the [full comparison](docs/compare.md). ## Explainer videos Karpathy's ladder for understanding LLM output ends with explainer videos. Ask for one in 3Blue1Brown style: "make a 3b1b-style video on the TCP handshake".

The agent writes the same kind of draft as for a page, plus one line of narration per beat. Nothing else: ````markdown ## Both sides wait ```sequence Client -> Server: SYN Server -> Client: SYN-ACK ``` > The client sends a SYN to ask for a connection. > The [Server] answers with a SYN-ACK. ```` `am video` turns it into a player page. The diagram builds step by step with the narration, and the camera follows the node named in brackets. The voice is inside the page, so it plays offline. The player has a chapter strip to jump between scenes, a speed button, and an export button that encodes the video in the browser and downloads it (a local file or `localhost`, no ffmpeg). Add `--mp4` for an MP4 file (needs ffmpeg), or `--webm` for a WebM file the page encodes itself (no ffmpeg). The agent only makes videos when you ask. Details: [video guide](docs/video.md). ## Settings Change settings with a slash command. There are no config files to edit by hand. | Where | How | | :--- | :--- | | Claude Code (plugin install) | `/answer-me-with-html:config` asks what to change. `/answer-me-with-html:config open off` changes it directly | | Any agent | `/answer-me-with-html config open off`, or just say "stop opening the browser" | | Terminal | `am config` to view, `am config set open off` to change, `am config reset` to restore defaults | The settings are `open` (open pages in the browser), `theme`, `mode` (light or dark), `style` (writing check), `scale` (text size on the page; diagrams and charts grow with it), `pages_dir` (output folder for pages), `update_check`, `close_after_reply` (close the tab after the reply is copied) and `voice` (video narration). Defaults and values: [reference](docs/reference.md#settings). ## Always-on mode (recommended) With always-on mode, **every conclusion comes with a page**: whenever the agent gives a conclusion, summary, plan or comparison, even a short one, it adds a small page with 2 to 4 panels and puts the path at the end of the reply. These pages never pop open, so they don't interrupt you. Casual chat and replies with no conclusion stay as they are. Claude Code makes no pages in plan mode. It is off by default. We recommend it: you stop asking for pages, and short answers read as well as long ones. Pages pile up in `~/.answer-me-with-html/`; clear them with `am clean`. To turn it on, paste this to your agent so it writes the rule into its rules file, such as `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md`: > Turn on always-on mode for Answer me with HTML: add a global rule — "[answer-me-with-html always-on] Whenever a reply gives a conclusion, summary, plan, comparison, review or explanation, even a short one, also make a page with the answer-me-with-html skill (2 to 4 panels for routine answers), render it with --no-open before you write the reply, and end the reply with the page link in the format SKILL.md specifies for your host. Skip casual chat, one- or two-sentence replies with no conclusion, pure command output, and requests for plain text. An internal report to another agent is not a user reply: return the findings and evidence the parent asked for, and make no page unless the task explicitly asks for one." To turn it off, delete that rule. Want fewer pages instead? See [less proactive](docs/reference.md#less-proactive). ## Updating and cleaning up Updates are manual. When used, the CLI checks GitHub for a new version in the background at most once a day. If one is available, it prompts the agent at most once every three days; nothing about you is sent. To update, tell your agent "update answer-me-with-html". Pages pile up in `~/.answer-me-with-html/`. Say "clean up the pages", and the agent asks before it deletes anything. Other install methods and every option: [reference](docs/reference.md#updating-and-cleaning-up). ## Background Andrej Karpathy [posted](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2105819303471976479) that as LLMs do more of the work, keeping up with their output becomes the hard part. A diagram or a web page is far easier to take in than a long block of text. I tried asking agents to answer in HTML directly. The pages were good, but slow: a decent page took a minute or two, mostly hundreds of lines of CSS that were nearly the same every time. Diagrams were worse. The model had to compute SVG coordinates by hand, and arrows often pointed at nothing. So Answer me with HTML takes that work away from the model. The model writes content. The CLI handles layout, color and drawing. ## How it works This is all the model writes: ````markdown --- title: TCP three-way handshake --- ## A Three-way handshake {span=2} ```sequence num Client -> Server: SYN, seq=x Server -> Client: SYN+ACK, seq=y, ack=x+1 Client -> Server: ACK, ack=y+1 note Client, Server: ESTABLISHED ``` ## C State changes {span=2} ```flow LR (CLOSED) -> LISTEN: passive open LISTEN -> SYN_RCVD: get SYN / send SYN+ACK SYN_RCVD -> *ESTABLISHED: get ACK ``` ```` The CLI does the rest. It picks the template, places the panels, applies the theme, lays out the flow chart with [dagre](https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre) and spaces the sequence diagram by label width. The full draft, [examples/tcp.en.md](examples/tcp.en.md), becomes this page:

## Features - **Layout by code:** Panel placement and diagram coordinates are computed, not guessed. Labels don't get cut off, and there are no gaps in the grid. - **Fixes its own mistakes:** When a draft has an error, the CLI returns the line number, the component and a correct example. The agent fixes it in one try. - **Three themes:** `blueprint` looks like an engineering drawing, `shadcn` uses clean cards, and `paper` is set for long reading. By default the CLI picks paper for long text and blueprint for diagrams. All have light and dark modes, and you can add your own or take one from the [theme catalog](https://answer-me-with-html.com/themes/). - **One file, no dependencies:** Each page is a single `.html` with no CDN links or web fonts. It opens offline and is easy to share. - **Languages:** Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), English and Japanese get their own buttons and fonts. Other languages work with English buttons. See [languages](docs/reference.md#languages). - **Writing check:** Drafts are checked against rules adapted from ASD-STE100: long sentences, wordy phrases, passive voice. It only warns unless you ask for strict mode. - **Real code, not retyped:** A code block can quote lines from your files (`src=` `lines=`), so the code on the page is the real code. Files outside the folder and files that hold keys are refused. - **Answer on the page:** Comment on any panel, and pick options in the decisions the agent asks (`ask`). The Reply button turns your answers and comments into one message to paste back to the agent. - **Keeps its source:** Every page embeds the Markdown that made it. Click "Copy source" to get it back.
Blueprint theme (examples/ste100.md) shadcn theme, dark mode
## Components The agent picks a component by the shape of the information: | Component | Good for | | :--- | :--- | | `flow` | Architecture, call chains, decision branches. Auto layout, with groups, decisions and databases | | `state` | A state machine: states and the events that move between them, with an initial state, a final state and self-transitions | | `er` | A data model: entities with their columns (PK / FK / UK) and crow's-foot relationships | | `class` | UML classes, attributes, methods, interfaces and relationships | | `api` | HTTP / RPC contracts and multi-endpoint diffs: parameters, requests, responses and status codes | | `sequence` | Messages going back and forth between several parties over time | | `tree` | Folders, modules, taxonomies | | `timeline` | History, releases, phases | | `limits` | A value against its limit | | `chart` | Bars, lines or a pie from a table of numbers: several series, negative values, a highlighted row | | `annot` | Word-by-word notes on a sentence | | `kv` | Metadata, a drawing's title block | | `callout` | A conclusion, a tip, a warning | | `ask` | A decision you make on the page; the agent's suggestion has a tag; nothing starts selected | | Code block | Real code quoted from a file (`src=` `lines=`), or a sketch | | Table | Multi-way comparison. Write `ok` / `no` / `warn` in a cell to get ✓ ✗ !; add `{table sort filter}` after the table for interactive sorting and filtering | The draft format (frontmatter, `span`, `rows`, raw `html` / `svg` blocks) and how to call the CLI without an agent are in the [reference](docs/reference.md). Full syntax for a component: `am help `. ## The STE writing check [ASD-STE100](https://www.asd-ste100.org/) is a controlled form of English first used for aircraft maintenance manuals. Its rules are concrete: keep sentences short, give each word one meaning, write steps as commands. Karpathy noted that asking an LLM to follow these rules makes its writing much easier to read. Every render checks the parts a machine can check: sentence length, plain words, passive voice, and common Chinese typos and vague words. It only warns by default. Set `/answer-me-with-html:config style strict` to refuse drafts that fail, or `style:` in one draft. Please open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html/issues). ## Star History ## License [MIT](LICENSE). # Niubash for Windows

Adds a `niubash` tool to DeepSeek Harness that runs bash commands through
[Niubash](https://unixwin.dev) — a GNU bash-compatible shell implemented
natively for Windows — while the built-in `pwsh` tool stays untouched next to
it. A prompt section makes niubash the default shell; pwsh remains the choice
for PowerShell-specific work.

## What it does

- Registers `niubash` (never overrides `pwsh` or any other tool).
- Each call is a fresh `niu -c <command>` process in the session working
  directory; `workdir` overrides it per call. No rc files or plugins load.
- Foreground results mirror the pwsh marker contract: stdout, `[stderr]`
  section, `[output truncated; full output: <path>]`, `[timed out after Nms]`,
  `[stopped: <reason>]`, `[exit code: N]`. Non-zero exits are results, not
  tool errors.
- Per-stream output keeps the last 64,000 bytes in memory; overflow spills the
  complete stream to a temp file (cap 64 MiB) whose path is reported.
- With the job runtime composed (`dsh-jobs-local` + `dsh-tool-jobs`, part of
  the standard desktop profile):
  - `run_in_background: true` returns a job id immediately; collect with
    `job_output`, stop with `job_kill`.
  - Every foreground command is a job from its start; a command that outlives
    its timeout keeps running and the call returns
    `[still running after Nms; moved to background job <id>]`.
- Managed `DSH_*` environment: collected through `ctx.shellEnv` exactly like
  pwsh, layered over the harness environment with `NO_COLOR=1 PAGER=cat
  GIT_PAGER=cat`.
- Safety: niubash runs with the harness process authority and cannot enforce
  the DSH file sandbox. Under a confining session policy (`read-only` or
  `workspace-write`) the tool refuses to run and points at pwsh; it works in
  `danger-full-access` sessions.
- When `niu.exe` is missing, a same-schema stub is registered: every call
  fails with every checked path and how to fix it, and the prompt says
  "use pwsh" instead of advertising a preference that cannot be honored.
- Outside Windows the plugin is inert: no tool, no prompt section.

## Requirements

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.1.0-rc.2 … <0.3.0 (verified on 0.2.2-rc.3, desktop profile) |
| Niubash | 1.5.0 or later (`niu.exe`, MIT, <https://unixwin.dev>) |
| OS | Windows (verified on Windows 11; other builds untested) |

## Install

From this checkout, in a DSH session with plugin management:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target=D:\dsh-wsl-project\dsh-niubash-windows
```

or **Plugins → Add plugin → local directory**. The bundle inserts one row
(`id: niubash`) into the profile; no other profile file is edited by hand.

## Configuration

Row config (Plugins page) or the bundle patch:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `niuPath` | `''` | Explicit `niu.exe` file path; authoritative when set |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Default foreground timeout (ms) |
| `maxTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Cap for per-call `timeoutMs` overrides |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `64000` | Per-stream in-memory tail retention |
| `maxSpillBytes` | `67108864` | Per-stream full-output spill cap |
| `graceMs` | `3000` | Kill escalation / pipe-drain grace |
| `enableRunInBackground` | `true` | Expose `run_in_background` while jobs are composed |
| `promoteOnTimeout` | `true` | Timed-out foreground commands keep running as jobs |
| `preferPrompt` | `true` | Inject the "prefer niubash over pwsh" prompt section |
| `registerSkill` | `true` | Register the bundled `niubash` troubleshooting skill |

`niu.exe` resolution order: `niuPath` config → `DSH_NIUBASH_PATH` →
`PI_NIUBASH_PATH` (continuity with the Pi extension) → `PATH` →
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Niubash\niu.exe` → `%ProgramFiles%\Niubash\niu.exe`.
The lookup happens once at plugin activation; restart DSH after installing or
moving Niubash. An authoritative setting that points at a directory, a missing
file, or an unexpanded `%NAME%` is reported, not silently ignored.

## Shell choice

| Task | Tool |
|---|---|
| bash syntax, pipes, loops, heredocs, shell scripts | `niubash` |
| Unix tooling (`rg`, `sed`, `awk`, `tar`, …) | `niubash` |
| `git`, builds, test runners, language toolchains | `niubash` |
| .NET / COM, registry, services, event logs, CIM/WMI, remoting | `pwsh` |
| Reading, editing, searching files | `read` / `edit` / `grep` / `glob` |
| Interactive fullscreen TUI (`vim`, `ssh -t`, `tmux`) | neither — no PTY |

Inside niubash, `git`/`rg`/`ls`/`find`/`grep`/`awk`/`sed` resolve to Niubash's
bundled WinuxCmd builds (`tar` is Windows' bsdtar); call the full executable
path for the stock tool. `pwd` prints the `/c/...` dialect while native
children receive `C:\...`. A single command is limited to about 32K characters
by the Windows command line — write longer scripts to a file and run it.

## Bundled skill

The package ships a troubleshooting skill (`skill/SKILL.md` +
`skill/references/`) and registers it with the DSH skill registry as provider
`dsh-niubash-windows` (`source: bundled`, rank 600). It installs with the
package — no separate `~/.dsh/skills` entry — and appears in the skill catalog
of new sessions after a DSH restart. The skill is deliberately gated: it loads
for path anomalies, missing/surprising commands, wpm/doctor repair, niu
debugger questions, PTC serialization failures, and engine-vs-bash divergence,
not for ordinary command execution (the tool description owns that contract).

Adapted from the pi-niubash-windows skill: the Pi codemode payload section is
replaced by the DSH result contract (separate streams, exit-code markers,
timeout promotion, spill paths) and PTC `run_code` bridge rules (lossless-JSON
arguments and return values). `references/` are verbatim upstream Niubash
snapshots with SHA256 provenance in `ATTRIBUTION.md`. A user-level
`~/.dsh/skills/niubash` (rank 400) or project skill overrides the bundled copy;
set `registerSkill: false` to opt out entirely.

## Known limitations

- No file-sandbox enforcement (see Safety above); confining sessions must use
  pwsh.
- No PTY emulation; interactive fullscreen programs are out of scope.
- `niu -c` loads no rc and no plugins; use `NIU_ENV=<file>` when a command
  needs an initialization file.
- Niubash 1.5.0 pipeline argv defect (upstream rubash#3511): a double-quoted
  pipeline argument mixing a live command substitution with an apostrophe
  delivers U+0017 instead of `'`. Compute the substitution into a variable
  before the pipeline until the fixed engine ships. Not reproduced on rubash
  `29bbf52481c3` (verified 2026-11-17); check the pin with
  `"$NIU_SHELL" --version`.
- The child environment inherits the harness environment (minus ambient
  `DSH_*`, plus the managed snapshot); unlike the pwsh executor it does not
  scrub ambient credentials beyond that.

## Development

```bash
npm test           # unit tests: resolution, capture, render, helpers (no Niubash needed)
npm run test:smoke # end-to-end against the real niu.exe (skips when absent)
```

Layout:

```text
index.js          plugin entry: platform gate, resolve, prompt section, registration
lib/niu.js        pure niu.exe resolution (config → env → PATH → install dirs)
lib/prompt.js     tool name, description, prompt section, unavailable texts
lib/capture.js    bounded stream capture with spill file + offset readers
lib/process.js    niu -c process handles (deadline, tree kill, observed reads)
lib/render.js     model-facing result text (pwsh marker parity)
lib/util.js       pure helpers: workdir, env layering, startup-error guidance
lib/tool.js       defineTool + ctx.jobs adaptation (background, promotion)
lib/skill.js      bundled skill provider (frontmatter parse, list/get)
skill/            SKILL.md + verbatim upstream references (troubleshooting)
test/             unit tests and the opt-in smoke test
docs/DETAIL.md    plugin detail page
```

## License & attribution

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Ported from
[pi-niubash-windows](https://github.com/qwased/pi-niubash-windows) (MIT,
Copyright (c) 2026 qwased); the execution/job/marker contracts follow
DeepSeek Harness's `dsh-tool-pwsh` (MIT). The bundled skill adapts the
pi-niubash-windows skill (same upstream); `skill/references/` keeps verbatim
Niubash documentation snapshots under their upstream MIT license.

Shell command execution and host approval/sandbox interaction remain significant runtime boundaries. No lifecycle hooks. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# dsh-silent-model-switch

一个 Host 侧 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Cordis 插件。它在 `agent/pre-step` waterfall 阶段移除模型切换通知，避免这类内部通知进入模型请求。

## 行为

插件只检查结构化来源字段：

```ts
message.source?.kind === 'model-selection'
```

它不会进行文本匹配，也不会改写、重排或新增其他消息。若下游返回 `enter`，插件过滤其中的 `messages`；若没有匹配项，则原样返回同一个 decision 对象。插件自身不会创建 `reject` 决策，并保留下游已有的非 `enter` 决策。

### 实际通知与监听器顺序

当前 DSH 的 `installModelSelection()` 生成的通知包含以下字段（省略消息 id）：

```ts
{
  role: 'user',
  content: [{
    type: 'text',
    text: '[model changed: assistant turns above this point were generated by gpt-5.6-sol; the session continues with gpt-6.1-sol]'
  }],
  source: {
    kind: 'model-selection',
    form: 'notice',
    summary: 'gpt-5.6-sol → gpt-6.1-sol'
  }
}
```

这条消息不是必须预先出现在 `payload.messages` 中：DSH 的模型切换监听器以 `{ prepend: true }` 注册，在 `await next()` 返回后追加通知。因此过滤器必须包裹该监听器，在返回路径上最后过滤。

1.0.1 修复了 1.0.0 的顺序遗漏：过滤监听器同样前置注册；每次 `agent/created`（新建或恢复 Agent 的 setup 已完成、输入尚未放行）时，移除旧注册并重新前置，始终只保留一个插件拥有的过滤监听器。这样既覆盖安装前已存在的 Agent，也覆盖安装后新建或恢复的 Agent，且 `inject` 仍为空。

**范围限制：**只阻止新通知进入本步已接纳的消息，不回溯删除已写入历史的旧通知。用户自己输入完全相同的文本，只要 `source.kind` 不是 `model-selection`，就不会被删除。

## 开发

要求 Node.js 20 或更高版本，并使用 pnpm：

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run pack:check
```

构建产物输出到 `lib/`。

## 安装到 DSH

本包通过 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明了 Cordis bundle。完成构建后，可将包目录作为本地 bundle 安装到 DeepSeek Harness；补丁会挂载同名插件 `dsh-silent-model-switch`，无需配置项或强制注入依赖。

## 兼容性

当前代码针对以下公开 API 编译和验证：

- `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 4.1.x
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` 0.2.2-rc.4

## 手动升级检查

[迁移工作流](<.github/workflows/dsh-migrate.yml>) 固定使用 [QZLin/dsh-migrate-bot v3.0.1](https://github.com/QZLin/dsh-migrate-bot/releases/tag/v3.0.1) 对应的提交，仅保留 `workflow_dispatch`；没有定时、push、PR 或其他事件触发。

该版本不调用 LLM，也不自动修复插件源码：只更新 DSH 依赖范围和插件 patch 版本，并运行现有的 build、typecheck、test 及启动检查。检查失败时提交草稿 PR，由维护者手动处理。不需要 DeepSeek API key。v3 起 Action 为 composite 型，每次运行在 runner 上安装 Node 与 pnpm 后自源码构建，不再拉取容器镜像。

bot 本身只改 `package.json`。工作流在它之后追加两个确定性步骤，把提案补全为可直接合并的状态：`pnpm install --lockfile-only` 刷新 `pnpm-lock.yaml`，[scripts/sync-metadata.mjs](<scripts/sync-metadata.mjs>) 把 README 兼容性列表中的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 版本改成 manifest 声明的版本（`4.1.x` 这类只写到次版本的引用在次版本未变时保持原样）。两者都没有变化时不会产生多余提交。

检查全部通过的提案会被自动 squash 合并进默认分支，无需人工确认；这一步对合并结果没有复核环节，只有在你需要先看 diff 时才应关闭。若某个检查失败，bot 打开的是 **草稿** PR，自动合并会跳过它，留给你手动处理。手动运行时可用 `auto_merge=false` 只生成提案而不合并。

在仓库 Settings → Actions → General → Workflow permissions 中启用 **Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests**。工作流使用仓库自带的 `GITHUB_TOKEN`（`contents`、`issues`、`pull-requests` 写权限）推送提案分支、创建 issue 和 PR，因此不需要额外创建 PAT 或 Secret。缺少该开关时推送和建 issue 都会成功，只有建 PR 会返回 HTTP 403。

配置合并到默认分支后，在 Actions → dsh-migrate → Run workflow 手动运行，或使用 GitHub CLI：

```sh
# 目标为空时使用最新的 dsh release。
gh workflow run dsh-migrate.yml

# 指定目标 release；必要时重新处理已运行的版本。
gh workflow run dsh-migrate.yml -f dsh_release=dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1 -f bump_again=true
```

工作流固定 Action 提交以避免静默更新；升级 bot 时需显式更新固定提交。迁移结果和检查输出见运行摘要及提案 PR，`dsh-migrate/state` 分支用于保存记录，不要合并到默认分支。

## License

MIT

decision.reason: Static evidence chain reviewed. MIT; versioned DSH agent peer ^0.2.2-rc.4; documented local source bundle installation. Committed lib/index.js is present despite build instructions. Native agent/pre-step middleware removes only model-selection-source messages from enter decisions, preserving downstream rejects and other decision metadata. It re-registers on agent creation; no lifecycle hook or external process. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# dsh-whale-pet

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物插件。她在 Web 界面上漂浮、用气泡闲聊、被摸头会开心，还能拖到任意位置。

A whale-girl desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness. She floats over the Web UI, chats in bubbles, reacts happily to head pats, and can be dragged anywhere.

![whale-girl](whale-girl-small.png)

## 功能 / Features

- 待机漂浮动画，每 18 秒随机冒出闲聊气泡 / Idle float animation with random chat bubbles every 18 s
- 点击摸头：开心跳起、摇摆 + 星星闪烁 / Click to pat: happy wiggle with sparkles
- 按住拖拽，放到屏幕任意位置 / Drag to any position
- 气泡文案中英双语，跟随界面语言 / Bilingual copy (zh/en) following the UI locale
- 图片以 data URI 内嵌，无外部资源依赖 / The artwork is inlined as a data URI; no external asset fetches

## 安装 / Install

需要已登录 DSH Web 且本机装有 `gh`/`git`。克隆本仓库后，在 DSH 会话里让 Agent 执行：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/sendwealth/dsh-whale-pet.git
```

然后通过插件管理器以本地目录安装（Agent 工具调用）：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle target=<克隆目录绝对路径>
```

也可以把克隆目录里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 行手工合入你自己的 bundle。

## 文件结构 / Layout

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | bundle 清单 + `dsh.client` 注入声明（`shell.overlay` 由 `dsh-client-ui-layout` 声明） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入 `whale-pet` 插件行 |
| `index.js` | Host 侧入口（渲染全部在 Client） |
| `client.js` | Client 模块：宠物渲染、交互、闲聊文案；含内嵌 base64 图片 |
| `locale/*.json` | 插件管理器展示的标题与描述 |
| `whale-girl-small.png` | 图标用的原图（300×400，透明背景） |

## 开发说明 / Development notes

- 修改 `client.js` 里的文案或行为后，重新安装 bundle 即可生效（Module Loader 每次安装生成新模块）。
- `client.js` 中的 base64 图片由 `whale-girl-small.png` 生成；换图后用
  `node -e "…readFileSync('whale-girl-small.png').toString('base64')…"` 重新替换 `WHALE_GIRL_DATA_URI` 的 `data:image/png;base64,…` 前缀字符串。
- 客户端模块运行在 Module Loader 通道里：只有 `require('react')`、`ctx.*` 与声明注入的服务可用；不要使用 `styles.insert`（那是 `cordis-client-runner` 闭包的 API）。
- 主题颜色一律走 `--dsw-alias-*` token 并带字面量回退。

## 版权说明 / Artwork credit

`whale-girl-small.png` 来自 DeepSeek 官方鲸鱼娘形象，版权归 DeepSeek 所有，此处仅作为个人桌宠用途引用。插件代码部分按 MIT 发布（见 `LICENSE`）。

The whale-girl artwork is DeepSeek's official mascot image; all rights remain with DeepSeek. The plugin code itself is released under the MIT license (see `LICENSE`).

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# taskboard-workbench

> **Agent Team 任务工作台**：一个本地优先（local-first）的多项目任务看板，
> 零运行时依赖（`node:sqlite`），既可独立跑成 **CLI + 本地 Web 服务**，也能作为
> **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）内嵌插件**挂进会话里，派发任务、回流证据、独立复验。

---

## 界面

![看板 · 七列状态机](assets/readme/01-board.png)

*看板：`待办池 → 可开工 → 进行中 → 待验收 → 已完成 / 受阻 / 已取消` 七列同屏。
卡片上可见「未归属」「已记录验收标准」「诊断」徽标，以及按角色分派的执行入口。*

![需求条目](assets/readme/02-requirements.png)

*需求视图：左侧是需求文档与 AI 拆解入口，右侧是条目行式列表 ——
每条带**完成度胶囊**（如 `2/3 收口`）、**来源标签**（手工 / 资料索引 / AI / 规则 / MCP）与批量建卡入口。*

![配置 · 开局向导](assets/readme/03-config.png)

*配置页的「开局向导 7 步」是**真实判定**，不是装饰：第 4 步显示「本机无产物」待人确认（◐），
已确认的步骤才是 ✅。*

> 三张图均为**独立进程形态**（`node src/server/server.mjs`，无 DSH 宿主）下的虚构示例项目，
> 不含真实业务数据；独立进程下顶部会出现「无宿主会话通道」提示条，截图已省略。


## 它解决什么

把「需求条目 → 看板派发 → CLI/agent 实际开发 → 证据回流 → 独立复验 → 人工验收」
这条闭环固化成可查询的数据与可重放的流程，而不是散落在聊天记录里。

- **任务不是聊天**：任务卡有状态机（`backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done`）、
  乐观锁（`--if-version`）、认领锁与心跳、失败会计与熔断。
- **证据留在卡上**：评论、事件流、尝试记录、诊断信息都挂在任务上，可回溯。
- **人工守住最后一道门**：执行侧只能把卡推到「待验收」，`done` 必须由人确认。

## 功能概览

| 模块 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 存储核心 | 零依赖 SQLite（`node:sqlite`）；多项目 / 任务 / 需求条目；状态机、父任务、标签、负责人、版本号乐观锁 |
| 看板 | 七列状态看板（拖拽换列 + 列内排序）、多维筛选与搜索、卡片抽屉（下一步 / 概览 / 执行记录 / 关联） |
| 需求视图 | 条目行式列表 + 详情抽屉、引入文件按文件夹树呈现、来源标签（手工 / 索引 / AI / 规则 / MCP）、批量建卡 |
| 执行编排 | **按卡选执行者**（团队 / 宿主会话 / claude·codex·hermes）；CLI 执行者交**项目主会话**下发并跟踪；派发优先复用已绑定空闲会话；执行期心跳与在途尝试收口 |
| 交付与证据 | 四节证据 + 可核验引用（`commit` / `file`）双通道、WAL、ticket 阶段视图、抽屉「执行记录」聚合段 |
| 团队协作 | 团队任务 ↔ 看板卡**只读映射**、执行引擎（`instruction` / `agent-teams` / `official`）、诊断（评审死锁 / 停滞 / 假阳性收敛） |
| 双宿主 | web 与 desktop **共用同一份库**：写者租约 + 只读跟随条 + `dataDir` 自证 |
| CLI | `tb` 命令（项目 / 任务 / 评论的 CRUD，JSON 输出 + 稳定退出码） |
| MCP | **10 个工具**（只读 5 + 写 5）+ prompt `taskboard.flow`，stdio 传输 |
| DSH 插件 | `dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`（web 平台侧栏 / 布局 / 槽位注入），会话内「任务工作台」标签页 |

## 安装

### 作为 DSH 插件

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add taskboard-workbench
```

插件通过 `dsh.bundle.patch`（`cordis.patch.yml`）与 `dsh.client` 注入到宿主；
需要宿主支持的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-{layout,sidebar,slots}`（已声明为**可选 peer**）。

装好后在 DSH 里打开「任务工作台」面板（地址以 `/integrations/taskboard-workbench` 结尾）。
**只有这个形态拿得到宿主会话通道**：`GET /api/health` 的 `host.capabilities` 非空，
「投给主会话 / 打开会话 / 派发团队」才可用。

> 验收这条链路（从 `npm pack` 产物装进全新隔离 profile，真宿主起会话）：
> `node tools/bench-market-install.mjs` —— 11 项，含「独立进程无宿主通道」的反向对照。

### 从源码

```bash
git clone https://github.com/SilenZerOrz/taskboard-workbench.git
cd taskboard-workbench
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

### 独立跑（不用 DSH）

```bash
npm start                      # 启动本地 Web 服务（默认监听本机端口）
node cli/tb.mjs project list   # 或用 CLI 直接操作
```

> ⚠️ 独立进程**没有** DSH 宿主会话通道：`/api/health` 的 `host.capabilities` 恒为 `null`，
> 「投给主会话 / 打开会话 / 派发团队」不可用（界面按能力位置灰并常驻提示）。
> 看板、建卡、改状态、评审、人工收口照常可用。要投递或派发，请用上面的**插件形态**。

## 要求

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| Node.js | `>= 22.5.0`（依赖 `node:sqlite`） |
| DSH | `>=0.2.1-rc.3`（与 `package.json#engines.dsh` 一致）；`0.2.2-rc.3` 真机验证通过 |
| 运行时依赖 | 无（`dependencies` 为空） |

## 快速上手（CLI）

```bash
# 数据目录：--data-dir > $TB_DATA_DIR > 系统临时目录
export TB_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.taskboard-data"

node cli/tb.mjs project create --name "示例项目" --id demo
node cli/tb.mjs task create --project demo --title "跑通一次闭环" --description "验证一下"
node cli/tb.mjs task list --project demo
node cli/tb.mjs comment add 1 --body "证据：npm test 全绿"
```

CLI 约定：成功 `stdout` 输出 JSON（含 `schemaVersion`），退出码 `0`；
失败 `stderr` 输出 `{schemaVersion, error:{code,message}}`，退出码 `2/3/4/5`。
并发编辑用 `--if-version`，版本不符返回 `VERSION_CONFLICT`（退出码 5）而不静默覆盖。

## MCP 契约层（十个工具）

把「开局要读什么、规范长什么样、哪里有漂移、卡怎么建、进度怎么回填」做成 agent 可直接调用的接口，
让 Claude Code / Codex / Hermes 等外部 agent 不必靠人肉复制粘贴就能对齐同一份项目事实。

```bash
node src/mcp/server.mjs --data-dir "$TB_DATA_DIR"   # MCP 客户端作为子进程拉起（stdio）
node src/mcp/server.mjs --print-tools               # 只打印工具清单（调试用）
node src/mcp/server.mjs --read-only                 # **只读模式**：只暴露五件只读工具，写四件调用即 READ_ONLY_MODE
npm run mcp -- --data-dir "$TB_DATA_DIR"            # 同上，走 npm script
```

`--read-only` 是写工具的**回滚开关**（写路径出问题时的逃生口）：`tools/list` 里不再出现
`card_create` / `card_evidence_submit` / `card_progress` / `requirement_upsert` / `requirement_change`，直接调用返回
`isError:true` + `code=READ_ONLY_MODE`（**不是**「未知工具」，便于区分「开关生效」与「名字拼错」）。
不带该参数时行为不变（10 个工具）。

传输是 **stdio + newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0**（MCP stdio transport）：
**不占端口、不碰 `:3080`、不写 `~/.dsh/**`、不需要重载宿主**，每个 agent 会话一个进程。

### 只读五件

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `flow_start` | 开局第一步（S0）：项目身份 + `contract_version` + 缺口（未归因卡 / 未绑定主会话 / 待确认候选）+ 下一步建议 |
| `project_info` | 项目总览：任务与需求条目按状态计数 + 契约版本与基线是否漂移 |
| `norm_get` | 取机器规范正文（`flow` / `card-update` / `doc-editing` / `acceptance` / `project-defaults`；`norm="project"` 读项目自有 `<workspace>/AGENTS.md`）+ `digest` |
| `requirement_list` | 需求条目列表：条目 + 内容版本（乐观锁用）+ 每条下的卡数与完成数 |
| `workbench_audit` | 漂移盘点：`contract-stale` / `unattributed` / `unbound-session` / `candidate-flood` 四类，各带计数、样例与处置建议 |

### 写五件（形状即约束）

| 工具 | 强制的形状 | 被拒的样子 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `card_create` | **归因硬门**：`requirement` 或显式 `unattributed_reason`（落审计）。新卡只能进 `backlog` | `REQUIREMENT_REQUIRED` / `AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED`（`backlog → todo` 是人工授权） |
| `card_evidence_submit` | 四节证据（判定 / 偏离 / 边界）+ 产物 + **可核验引用**（`kind` 只接受 `commit` / `file`） | `EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE` / `INVALID_ARTIFACT_REF`（第几项非法） / 同一批证据按 `hash` 去重 |
| `card_progress` | `evidence[]` **非空**（每项 `{kind: file\|command\|url\|reading, ref, note?}`）+ **`norm_digest` 必填**（`card-update` 的 sha256） | `EVIDENCE_REQUIRED` / `NORM_DIGEST_REQUIRED` / `NORM_STALE`（回带最新正文）/ `GOVERNANCE_AGENT_DONE` |
| `requirement_upsert` | 改条目必须带 `expected_version`（`requirement_list` 返回的 `version`） | `MISSING_VERSION` / `VERSION_CONFLICT` |
| `requirement_change` | 先预览拿 `change_id` + 影响面 `affected_cards`，带 `change_id` + `apply:true` 才落地 | `CHANGE_NEEDS_APPROVAL` / `CHANGE_ID_MISMATCH`（预览后条目被改过即失效） |

**四条红线仍然由门守，不是由纪律守**：

1. `done` 只能人点 —— `card_progress` 走执行侧状态门，写 `done` 直接 `GOVERNANCE_AGENT_DONE`；
2. `backlog → todo` 是人工授权 —— `card_create` 只接受 `backlog`；
3. 人工校验任务不得被执行侧改状态；
4. 证据不能是「已完成」三个字 —— `evidence[]` 的形状就是判据；同一批证据重复回填会按 `hash` 去重。

**契约档位**：`contract_version` 目前仍是 **`warn`** 档（不符只落 `contract-warn` 审计、不阻断），
切 `reject` 要等观察期到点单独拍板；写工具的返回体里带 `contract.verdict` 让 agent 自己知道用没用旧规范。

数据源是**同一个** `taskboard.sqlite`（`--data-dir` > `$TB_DATA_DIR` > 默认），
MCP 不是第二份数据 —— 看板里看到的、CLI 改的、MCP 读的，是同一行记录。
`tests/mcp-parity.test.mjs` 守的就是这条：同一操作在 HTTP 与 MCP 上**错误码与副作用必须同形**。

同一个 server 还提供一个 **MCP prompt `taskboard.flow`**（`prompts/list` / `prompts/get`）：
内容是当前项目的「开局装载块」—— 契约版本、门档、六类缺口、下一步该做什么、八步表与五条硬规则。
它与 CLI 的 `tb-flow start` **共用一个生成器**，输出逐字节相同（`tests/skill-flow.test.mjs` 守这条）。

## 技能包（开局装载）

`skills/taskboard-flow/` 是给 agent 读的**主流程技能**（八步 S0–S7 × 六栏：入口 / 前置门 / 判据 /
证据落点 / 失败处置 / 对应 FR），随包分发。它**只教顺序与判据，不持有业务规则副本** ——
数据在 `taskboard.sqlite`，门在 `src/mcp/` 与 `src/core/`，机器规范在 `spec/norms/`。

```bash
npm run flow -- start --data-dir "$TB_DATA_DIR" --project demo   # 打印开局装载块（档 A：整块贴进会话）
npm run flow -- start --json                                     # 同上，结构化输出
npm run flow -- snippet                                          # 打印档 B 的 AGENTS.md 片段
npm run flow -- check                                            # 自检 frontmatter 与八步完整性
node scripts/tb-flow.mjs start --cwd /path/to/repo                # 缺项目时按 cwd / 目录名猜
```

三种开局方式，按侵入性排序：

| 档 | 谁用 | 怎么做 | 要不要改宿主 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **A 开局提示词** | 人在 dsh 主会话里新开一轮 | 贴 `tb-flow start` 输出；或 MCP 客户端取 prompt `taskboard.flow` | 不用 |
| **B 外部 agent 约定** | Claude Code / Codex 在项目仓库里开工 | 项目根 `AGENTS.md` 写「开工先跑 `<taskboard>/scripts/tb-flow.mjs start`」，片段用 `tb-flow snippet` 打印 | 不用 |
| **C 宿主自动注入** | dsh 会话创建即注入 | **未启用**（须报批改 `~/.dsh/**` 并重载宿主）；接口形状见 `skills/taskboard-flow/references/injection.md` | 须报批 |

## 配置

| 环境变量 | 作用 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TB_DATA_DIR` | SQLite 数据目录 | 系统临时目录（仅适合试跑，正式用请显式指定） |
| `TB_PORT` | 独立进程监听端口 | `47830` |
| `TB_HOST_URL` | `tb-flow --host` 的默认基址 | `http://127.0.0.1:3080` |
| `TB_BASE` | 开局「设置类判据」里 `node -e` 取项目设置的基址 | 同上 |
| `TEAM_ENGINE` | 团队执行引擎：`instruction`（默认，指令降级）/ `agent-teams` / `official` | `instruction` |

项目级配置（工作区路径、审批策略、执行者选择、会话关联、规范来源等）在 Web 看板的「配置」页里维护。


## 目录结构

```
index.js              DSH 插件入口（cordis patch 注入点）
lib/client.js         宿主侧客户端桥
cordis.patch.yml      dsh.bundle.patch
src/core/             存储、状态机、团队模板、执行编排、看护
src/server/           HTTP API 与事件流
src/host/             团队引擎与工具面
src/mcp/              MCP 契约层（stdio server + 十个工具：只读五 / 写五 + prompt taskboard.flow）
skills/taskboard-flow/ 主流程技能包（八步 × 六栏 + 每步 references + 错误码 + 装载说明）
scripts/tb-flow.mjs   `tb-flow` 开局装载块 CLI（start / snippet / check）
web/                  本地 Web 看板（app.js / tokens.css / index.html）
cli/tb.mjs            `tb` 命令行
spec/团队agent.md      团队契约（随包发布，供工作台里的 agent 读取）
spec/norms/           机器执行规范（运行时唯一真源，随包；manifest.json 带 sha256 digest）
tests/                `node --test` 单测
tools/                开发与验证脚本（不进 npm 包，除 seed/env-check）
assets/readme/        README 截图（随包发布，用于 GitHub 与 npm 页面）
```

## 测试

```bash
npm test          # node --test，全量单测
node --check index.js   # 语法自检（对每个源文件）
node src/mcp/server.mjs --print-tools   # MCP 工具清单自检
```

## 版本信息

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 当前版本 | **`0.3.5`**（2026-11-17） |
| 发布轨 | `stable` → npm `dist-tags.latest` |
| 版本策略 | `0.3.x` 期 patch 承载「修复 + 可选能力」；`0.4.0` 留给计划文档里预留的确认层 `acceptance_state` |
| dsh 兼容 | `>=0.2.1-rc.3`（`package.json#engines.dsh`）；真机验证 `0.2.2-rc.3` |
| Node 要求 | `>= 22.5.0`（依赖 `node:sqlite`） |
| 运行时依赖 | 无 |
| 变更记录 | [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) |
| 发布页 | [Releases](https://github.com/SilenZerOrz/taskboard-workbench/releases) |

```bash
npm view taskboard-workbench version            # registry 上的当前版本
npm view taskboard-workbench dist-tags          # 各发布轨指向
npm view taskboard-workbench time --json        # 每个版本的落地时间
```

> **判断要不要升级只看三处**：npm `dist-tags`、本仓库 GitHub Releases、dsh 插件市场条目 ——
> 不要只看 `npm outdated -g`（`latest` 可能滞后于某个预发布轨）。


## 说明：`docs/` 不随仓库发布

本仓库的过程文档（需求 / 计划 / 进度 / 验证 / 规范 / 发布 SOP 等）在本地维护，
**不进入 git 与 npm 包**（见 `.gitignore`）。仓库只发布可运行的代码与随包契约 `spec/`。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

# dsh-zentao

[English](README.en.md) · **简体中文**

DSH 的禅道面板：从 **禅道** 里读取分配给你的需求、任务与缺陷，选一个工作区、手填分支名，把选中的条目派发给 Agent；干完之后把状态和一句备注写回禅道。

本包是从 [dsh-task-hub](https://github.com/handsomeboy65/dsh-task-hub)（TAPD + 禅道双来源）中把禅道部分拆分出来的独立插件，并在拆分基础上补齐了四条能力：**数据通道可切换（含官方 zentao-cli）**、**「我的地盘」+ 侧边栏角标**、**Bug 分诊矩阵**、**状态回写**。

## 四条能力

### 1. 数据通道：v1 / v2 / auto / zentao-cli

设置里的「数据通道」决定读写的接口来源：

| 通道 | 读 | 写 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v1` | 产品/项目枚举 | ✗ | 拆分前的行为，最保守 |
| `v2` | `/my/*` 服务端「指派给我」 | ✓ | 禅道 22.5+ 有 `/my/*`，22.0+ 有状态流转端点 |
| `auto` | 先探 v2，失败回落 v1 | ✓（v2 生效时） | 换实例不用改配置 |
| `cli` | `zentao my tasks/bugs/stories` | ✓ | 交给官方 [zentao-cli](https://github.com/easysoft/zentao-cli)，登录、分页、版本门槛都由它负责 |

`cli` 通道填的是命令行本身（默认 `zentao`，也支持 `npx zentao-cli@0.4.4` 这种带参数的形式），插件不再保存禅道密码；站点和账号从 `zentao auth status` 里读，任务链接照样能拼对。

**为什么值得切到 cli**：v1 那套「先枚举产品/项目、再本地按处理人过滤」在容器多的时候请求量线性增长；`my` 是服务端过滤。而且写端点、版本判断（`E2010`）、写后回查这些规则 CLI 已经实现过一遍，插件不用二次演绎。

### 2. 「我的地盘」+ 侧边栏角标

- 通道支持 `/my/*` 时，面板默认直接读「指派给我」，不再需要选产品/项目（v1 会退化为枚举，禅道 <22.5 也会自动回退）。
- 侧边栏「禅道」图标上有一个未完成条目的角标。DSH 的 `sidebar.panellist` 只给图标传 `{ size, active }`，**没有 badge API**，所以角标是这个插件自己画的：注册时通过 `inject: () => ({ hooks: { badge } })` 把内部可观察源交给渲染器，图标组件因此拿到 `useBadge(selector)`，再在字形上绝对定位一个气泡。计数由 `/api/zentao/counts` 单独轮询（只取计数，不拉列表），`connection/reset` 时立刻刷一次。

已知取舍：同一个图标在侧栏收起的「More」菜单里会被复用一次，角标会跟着出现；图标外层带 `aria-hidden`，角标对读屏不可见（`label` 仍是「禅道」）。

### 3. Bug 分诊矩阵

「读取范围 = 产品缺陷」时多出一个「矩阵」视图：**严重程度 × 状态**（P1–P4 / 未填 × 待解决 / 已解决 / 已关闭），每格最多列 4 条、多的显示 `+N`；点条目直接进派发弹窗，补充要求会预填「先复现这个 Bug 并确认根因，再动手修改」。状态或严重程度落在轴外的条目不会消失，归到 `stray` 里。

提测之后真正落到开发头上的是 Bug，而「哪个 P1 还没解决」用看板要读 40 张卡，用矩阵一眼就够。

### 4. 回写：派发即开始

派发成功后（任务处于未开始），面板会自动打开回写弹窗，把这次派发写成一次状态流转：

```
PUT /tasks/31/start   { realStarted: "2026-11-17 10:00:00", comment: "已派发 DSH 会话，工作分支 feature/x" }
```

或者走 CLI：`zentao task start --task-id=31 --real-started=... --comment=...`。

弹窗**先给你看这次要提交的请求/命令原文**，点确认才发。执行完会重新读一次条目，把「禅道现在到底是什么状态」报给你；回查失败就明说没核实，不会假装成功。

卡片上按条目当前状态并排给出动作（第一项就是主按钮，「关闭」放最后并标红）；「派发 Agent」只在未开始/未认领时才是主按钮，已完成条目会提示「先重新激活再派发」：


| 动作 | 端点 | 必填 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 开始 | `PUT /tasks/{id}/start` | `realStarted` |
| 完成 | `PUT /tasks/{id}/finish` | `currentConsumed`、`realStarted`、`finishedDate`（面板自动预填，可改） |
| 关闭 | `PUT /tasks/{id}/close` | — |
| 重新激活 | `PUT /tasks/{id}/activate` | — |
| 指派给… | `PUT /tasks/{id}` / `PUT /bugs/{id}` | `assignedTo` |
| 解决 / 确认 | `PUT /bugs/{id}/resolve` / `/confirm` | `resolution` / — |

「指派给」的候选人是禅道的真实人员列表（`GET /users`，缓存 10 分钟），不是硬编码；改派弹窗会提醒你：改派后这条会从「我的地盘」消失。一个必须承认的限制：`PUT /tasks/{id}` **没有 `comment` 字段**，所以纯改派带不了备注；想留话就把 `assignedTo` 挂在开始/完成/激活上一起提交——面板会按这个规则来，改派弹窗里也会明说。

## 一个必须承认的接口限制

禅道 API 2.0 的 239 条路径里**没有独立的「加备注」端点**，`comment` 只挂在状态流转上（`start` / `finish` / `close` / `resolve` / `activate`）。所以「写一句备注回禅道」必然同时是一次状态变更——对派发来说这正好是 `start`，语义上也说得通。详见 [docs/zentao-api-notes.md](docs/zentao-api-notes.md)（端点、方法、必填字段都从 `zentao-api` SDK 的机器可读定义里反查得到，不是猜的）。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zentao-hub                     # 从 npm 装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:SivanCola/dsh-zentao-hub    # 或从 GitHub 装
```

> **包名与仓库名**：都是 `dsh-zentao-hub`。刻意避开了 `dsh-zentao`——那个名字在 npm 上属于别人的无关插件。

装完重启 `dsh web`，侧边栏会出现「禅道」。桌面端请在应用内的 **设置 → 插件** 里安装。需要 DSH 0.2.1+。用 `cli` 通道还需要 `npm i -g zentao-cli`（建议 0.4.4+）并先 `zentao auth login`。

## 首次配置

点面板右上角「设置」：

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 数据通道 | `v1` / `v2` / `自动` / `zentao-cli`，见上表 |
| 禅道地址 | 例如 `https://zentao.example.com`，会自动补 `/api.php/v1` 或 `/v2`（cli 通道可留空） |
| Basic Auth | 网关（Apache/Nginx）另有一层 HTTP 认证时打开 |
| 禅道账号 / 密码 | REST 通道必填；密码只写入 DSH credentials（也可用 `ZENTAO_PASSWORD`） |
| 读取范围 | `产品需求`（研发/用户/业务需求）、`项目任务`、`产品缺陷`（Bug） |
| 优先读取「我的地盘」 | 通道支持时默认开；关掉就回到产品/项目枚举 |
| 产品 / 项目 | 点「读取产品」「读取项目」后勾选，或直接填 ID（cli 通道不需要） |

## 派发流程

1. 面板列出当前范围里「处理人 = 我」的条目，按最近修改排序，可筛选 未完成 / 已完成 / 全部，按容器筛选，按任务号、父需求号或标题搜索。**「读取范围」在面板顶部就能切**（产品需求 / 项目任务 / 产品缺陷），切换会写回设置并重新拉取列表 —— 不必进设置页。
2. 点某条的「派发 Agent」，选「继续原对话」或「新开对话」。首次派发填目标工作区、**分支名称**（完整分支名，如 `feature/order-export`，用 `git check-ref-format` 校验）、worktree 与基线分支。
3. 插件依次：建/复用 worktree → 建 DSH 工作区与会话 → 把标题、来源链接、完整正文、参考资料与工作环境写进**输入框草稿**（禅道正文里的图片与附件也会下载并挂上）→ 会话标题改为 `<分支名> · <标题>` → 跳转过去。**不会自动发送**。
4. 若是任务且还在「未开始」，紧接着弹出回写弹窗，确认后置为进行中并写明这是哪次派发。

## 数据与失败模式

- 设置：`~/.dsh/zentao/settings.json`；派发记录：`~/.dsh/zentao/state.json`（按 `zentao:<条目 id>` 分）。
- 首次启动会把 `~/.dsh/task-hub/` 里的禅道配置与 `zentao:*` 记录搬过来，TAPD 记录留在原地。
- 回写是不可逆的真实操作：计划与执行分两次调用，计划先展示，确认后才落库；`comment` 上限 500 字。
- `cli` 通道没有二进制下载能力（v2 也没有附件下载端点），所以没另配账号密码时草稿里会明确写「附件未随任务下发」，而不是静默丢附件。
- 老版本 `zentao-cli`（≤0.4.1）的参数解析不同，插件会把 `E2009` 识别成「CLI 版本过旧」并给升级命令，而不是报参数错误。

## 开发

```bash
npm test     # 92 项：纯函数、v1/v2/cli 三条读通道、回写计划与执行、git 流程、宿主路由、客户端渲染与角标
```

改完代码后，已安装的 bundle 需要重启 DSH 才会加载新的 JS 代次。

## 行为说明（几处容易误以为是 bug 的地方）

- **worktree 模式下分支已在别处检出**：不再报错，直接复用那个检出目录（你自己的仓库最常见），并在派发前检查该目录有没有正在跑的会话。
- **草稿附件**：落在 `~/.dsh/zentao/drafts/`（目录 0700、文件 0600），超过 7 天的会在下次写草稿时清掉。
- **就地切换分支前的备份**：备份目录里若有文件未能保存（路径不存在、非普通文件），会记在 `manifest.json` 的 `skipped` 里，不再静默跳过。

## 限制

- 回写做「开始 / 完成 / 关闭 / 重新激活 / 改派 / 解决 / 确认」，但不做任意字段编辑（名称、截止日期、优先级等），也不写工时明细（完成时的 `currentConsumed` 会提交，`consumed` 只透传）。
- cli 通道的「我的地盘」按 CLI 版本门槛（22.5+）；低于门槛时会明确报 `E2010`。
- 处理人过滤在 v1 通道下仍是本地的，请求量随容器数增长。
- 附件上限：单图 6MB、总附件 20MB。
- 不代替 Agent 执行计划；派发后由会话里的 Agent 自己规划与实现。

# dsh-chat-migration

把 DeepSeek 对话历史导入 DSH、把会话导出成可迁移文件——做成**标准 DSH 插件**，`dsh plugin add` 一条命令装进任意 profile，不需要改宿主源码、不需要打补丁、不需要 fork。

[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

## 装什么

| 包 | 状态 | 能力 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@siweimidu/conversation-import` | ✅ 可安装 | DeepSeek 对话历史导入（预览 + 选择 + 导入成本地会话）、DSH 会话导出下载、设置页「导入对话」 |
| `@siweimidu/chat-preset` | ✅ 可安装 | 注册可移除的纯聊天 agent preset（`chat`） |
| `@xiaozhuang-dsh/composer-add-menu` | ⛔ 未移植 | 输入框加号菜单（命令/插件/技能/附件） |
| `@xiaozhuang-dsh/ui-plain-chat` | ⛔ 未移植 | 侧栏「聊天」入口 + 纯聊天表现层 |

后两个包为什么没移植、缺什么、怎么补：见 [未移植的两个插件](#未移植的两个插件)。

## 最省事：面板填包名（已发布到 npm）

DSH → **设置 → 插件 → 安装插件**，填包名（不用 URL、不用路径）：

```
@siweimidu/conversation-import
```

```
@siweimidu/chat-preset
```

已实测：`registry.npmjs.org` 的 tarball 国内直连 200 / 1.3s；`npm view` 返回 `0.3.0`；用包名装进空 profile 返回 `Done`，配置层出现插件行。面板走 npm 源，不需要访问 GitHub/jsDelivr。

## 一行命令安装（面板连不上的机器用这个）

**Windows**（PowerShell）

```powershell
irm https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@master/install-oneline.ps1 | iex
```

**macOS / Linux**

```sh
curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@master/install-oneline.sh | sh
```

这一行会自己完成全部步骤：找到 DSH → 选 profile（有 `desktop` 就用它）→ 多源下载（jsDelivr → ghfast → GitHub → raw）→ 把包写进该 profile 的 `node_modules` → 登记到 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

- **不需要** GitHub 账号、npm 账号、代理，**也不用**填 profile 名；
- 不依赖插件面板的网络（面板有独立出口，经常连不上任何外部地址）；
- 改 `package.json` 前会备份成 `package.json.bak`，回滚就是还原它并删掉 `node_modules/@xiaozhuang-dsh`；
- 想装到别的 profile：`$env:DSH_PLUGIN_PROFILE='web'` 后再跑（sh 用 `DSH_PLUGIN_PROFILE=web`）。

装完**完全退出 DSH 再启动**，设置里出现「导入对话」。

> 已验证：在真实 `desktop` profile 上跑通，两个包 `checkManifest` 均为 `contract OK`，host 半 `apply: function, inject: ["commands"]` 可加载。

### 备选：面板里粘 URL 或本地路径

DSH → **设置 → 插件 → 安装插件**，把这一行粘进去：

```
https://github.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/releases/download/v0.3.0/siweimidu-conversation-import-0.3.0.tgz
```

再粘一次（纯聊天预设，可选）：

```
https://github.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/releases/download/v0.3.0/siweimidu-chat-preset-0.3.0.tgz
```

面板的安装框接受包名、本地路径、git 地址、tarball URL（宿主 `plugin-manager` 的 spec 定义）。

### 网络到 GitHub 不顺时：用同样文件的镜像/加速地址

DSH 面板的安装走 Node 网络栈（不读系统代理），所以下面每一条都是「面板里能直接填的直链」。同一台机器实测（无代理直连）：

| 地址形态 | 实测 |
| --- | --- |
| `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@v0.3.0/dist/…tgz` | 200，1.5s |
| `https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/releases/download/v0.3.0/…tgz` | 200，1.8s |
| `https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/…/releases/download/v0.3.0/…tgz` | 200，2.0s |
| `https://github.com/…/releases/download/v0.3.0/…tgz` | ECONNRESET（国内直连不通）|

完整的一行示例：

```

```

如果面板报「无法连接」，先点一次**重试**：首次访问是冷缓存（2–3s），面板的超时比这个更短时就会误报，重试通常即成功。

### 命令行一行（自动判断 profile，不用你填名字）

宿主把 `--profile` 定为必填项，且 `desktop` 被 Electron 独占，所以命令行是这样一行（自动挑第一个非 desktop 的 profile）：

```powershell

```


```powershell
# Windows

```

```sh
# macOS / Linux

```

### 卸载

## 兼容性

宿主版本区间：`engines.dsh >= 0.1.7`。**实测**（不是声明）结果见 [docs/COMPATIBILITY.md](./docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)：

- 8 个运行时依赖包在这 4 个版本里全部可获取；
- 矩阵由 `pnpm compat:matrix` 现场从 npm 拉包解包核对，可重跑。

验收过程与真实命令输出见 [docs/VERIFICATION.md](./docs/VERIFICATION.md)。

## 未移植的两个插件

`composer-add-menu` 与 `ui-plain-chat` 依赖的是**上游 fork 私有契约**，标准宿主没有对应扩展点，硬装上去只会渲染出空壳。它们现在 `private: true`，测试会强制这一点，避免误装。

具体缺什么：

| 插件 | 依赖的私有契约 | 标准宿主现状 | 移植要做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `composer-add-menu` | slot `conversation.input.add`，owner 侧注入约 18 个 props（命令表、插件表、技能表、附件回调、`focusInput`、`onInsertSlashItem`…） | 没有该 slot；`conversation.input.left` 只给 `{}` | 改成从公开 client service 取数据（`commandUi`、`inputTriggers`、`fileUpload`），重写组件与样式，**并用能处理 CSS Modules 的构建链重建 `lib/client.js`** |
| `ui-plain-chat` | slot `sidebar.primary.action`；service `conversationPresentation`（隐藏 hero 配置/输入框模式/辅助面板）；`uiWorkspace.registerSessionGroup` | 三个都不存在（`uiWorkspace.openSession/startSession/newSession` 有，`registerSessionGroup` 没有） | 入口改挂 `sidebar.footer.action`（props 只有 `{ wide }`），丢掉表现层与分组的等价能力，或找到新的公开替代表达 |

已知的构建缺口：仓库里的 `lib/client.js` 是上游工具链产物；本仓库的 tsdown 配置能重建 **host 半**，client 半还缺 CSS Modules 支持（rolldown 那条链路目前把 class map 编译成空对象）。因此现阶段对 client 半的改动是"改源码 + 同步产物 + 测试锁死"，不是"改源码就能出包"。这一条在移植前必须补上。

## 仓库结构

```
packages/<id>/          四个插件包（每个都是自包含可安装包）
  src/                  源码（TypeScript / React）
  lib/                  已构建产物（host: ESM，client: __ModuleLoader__ 工厂）
  cordis.patch.yml      声明插入宿主的行
  tests/                包级契约测试
scripts/check-manifests.mjs   安装契约校验器（无 workspace: / patch 可解析 / client 声明完整）
scripts/compat-matrix.mjs     实测宿主 slot 与依赖包可用性
legacy/                 上游 fork 导出物：旧 payload/、manifest.json、INSTALL.md、四个核心补丁（仅作参考）
docs/                   设计、兼容矩阵、验收记录
```

`legacy/payload/shared/*.patch` 是给 DSH 本体打补丁的旧方案——**本仓库不再需要、也不再支持**。标准插件不允许修改宿主。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check:manifests     # 安装契约
pnpm test                # 26 个测试
pnpm typecheck           # 对已发布宿主类型做类型检查（两个可安装包）
pnpm typecheck:all       # 含未移植包；在移植完成前必然是红的
pnpm compat:matrix       # 重新测量 4 个宿主版本
```

`pnpm typecheck:all` 现在报的错就是移植清单本身：`conversation.input.add` / `sidebar.primary.action` 不在宿主 slot 联合类型里，`ctx.conversationPresentation` 不存在——编译器的报错就是「缺什么」的权威答案。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。源码派生自 Xiaozhuang DSH 的单向导出（见 [legacy/](./legacy/)）。

# `@deepseek-ai/dsh-composer-add-menu`

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Native one-layer add directory for the Web composer. It replaces the temporary Profile package and occupies `conversation.input.add` without creating another command, attachment, or reference protocol. It is baseline product interaction rather than a switchable catalog plugin.

Work conversations reuse the conversation owner's image-validation path and Workspace file/folder picker. The **Commands, plugins and skills** group then lists the current Session's official Host command catalog first, followed by the remaining slash-provided Skills. Selecting an entry inserts `/name ` at the textarea selection and never executes it immediately. If an official command and a Skill share a name, the official command wins. Pure Chat uses the same plus button in an upload-only posture: images keep the durable image path, while text, Markdown, CSV/JSON, and common code files up to 256 KB are inserted into the draft and persist with the message. An adjacent **Web search** capsule is an actual per-chat control: blue means enabled, gray means disabled, and disabling it blocks both public Web search and Web fetch before tool execution. Chat receives no Workspace references, command catalog, Skills, or filesystem authority.

Every Skill row uses the existing `IconSkillOutline16`; official commands use the existing plugin icon. The menu closes on selection, outside pointer, Escape, or when the composer becomes disabled, while preserving native textarea focus behavior.

## Model Experience

### Local draft insertion

#### What the model sees

Nothing at selection time. Choosing a row only edits the local `/name` draft; the command or Skill reaches the model only if the user later sends it through the existing composer flow.

#### Token effect

Opening the menu and selecting a row consumes no model tokens. A later send has the same token effect as typing the slash entry manually.

#### KV Cache effect

The menu does not change system context or model requests, so it has no independent cache effect.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

- The menu presents the live catalogs supplied by `ui-conversation`; it does not invent descriptions for providers that supply none.
- Image and Workspace actions remain unavailable when the current Session or model disables the corresponding native capability.

# dsh-chat-migration

把 DeepSeek 对话历史导入 DSH、把会话导出成可迁移文件——做成**标准 DSH 插件**，`dsh plugin add` 一条命令装进任意 profile，不需要改宿主源码、不需要打补丁、不需要 fork。

[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

## 装什么

| 包 | 状态 | 能力 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@siweimidu/conversation-import` | ✅ 可安装 | DeepSeek 对话历史导入（预览 + 选择 + 导入成本地会话）、DSH 会话导出下载、设置页「导入对话」 |
| `@siweimidu/chat-preset` | ✅ 可安装 | 注册可移除的纯聊天 agent preset（`chat`） |
| `@xiaozhuang-dsh/composer-add-menu` | ⛔ 未移植 | 输入框加号菜单（命令/插件/技能/附件） |
| `@xiaozhuang-dsh/ui-plain-chat` | ⛔ 未移植 | 侧栏「聊天」入口 + 纯聊天表现层 |

后两个包为什么没移植、缺什么、怎么补：见 [未移植的两个插件](#未移植的两个插件)。

## 最省事：面板填包名（已发布到 npm）

DSH → **设置 → 插件 → 安装插件**，填包名（不用 URL、不用路径）：

```
@siweimidu/conversation-import
```

```
@siweimidu/chat-preset
```

已实测：`registry.npmjs.org` 的 tarball 国内直连 200 / 1.3s；`npm view` 返回 `0.3.0`；用包名装进空 profile 返回 `Done`，配置层出现插件行。面板走 npm 源，不需要访问 GitHub/jsDelivr。

## 一行命令安装（面板连不上的机器用这个）

**Windows**（PowerShell）

```powershell
irm https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@master/install-oneline.ps1 | iex
```

**macOS / Linux**

```sh
curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@master/install-oneline.sh | sh
```

这一行会自己完成全部步骤：找到 DSH → 选 profile（有 `desktop` 就用它）→ 多源下载（jsDelivr → ghfast → GitHub → raw）→ 把包写进该 profile 的 `node_modules` → 登记到 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

- **不需要** GitHub 账号、npm 账号、代理，**也不用**填 profile 名；
- 不依赖插件面板的网络（面板有独立出口，经常连不上任何外部地址）；
- 改 `package.json` 前会备份成 `package.json.bak`，回滚就是还原它并删掉 `node_modules/@xiaozhuang-dsh`；
- 想装到别的 profile：`$env:DSH_PLUGIN_PROFILE='web'` 后再跑（sh 用 `DSH_PLUGIN_PROFILE=web`）。

装完**完全退出 DSH 再启动**，设置里出现「导入对话」。

> 已验证：在真实 `desktop` profile 上跑通，两个包 `checkManifest` 均为 `contract OK`，host 半 `apply: function, inject: ["commands"]` 可加载。

### 备选：面板里粘 URL 或本地路径

DSH → **设置 → 插件 → 安装插件**，把这一行粘进去：

```
https://github.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/releases/download/v0.3.0/siweimidu-conversation-import-0.3.0.tgz
```

再粘一次（纯聊天预设，可选）：

```
https://github.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/releases/download/v0.3.0/siweimidu-chat-preset-0.3.0.tgz
```

面板的安装框接受包名、本地路径、git 地址、tarball URL（宿主 `plugin-manager` 的 spec 定义）。

### 网络到 GitHub 不顺时：用同样文件的镜像/加速地址

DSH 面板的安装走 Node 网络栈（不读系统代理），所以下面每一条都是「面板里能直接填的直链」。同一台机器实测（无代理直连）：

| 地址形态 | 实测 |
| --- | --- |
| `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@v0.3.0/dist/…tgz` | 200，1.5s |
| `https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/releases/download/v0.3.0/…tgz` | 200，1.8s |
| `https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/…/releases/download/v0.3.0/…tgz` | 200，2.0s |
| `https://github.com/…/releases/download/v0.3.0/…tgz` | ECONNRESET（国内直连不通）|

完整的一行示例：

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@v0.3.0/dist/siweimidu-conversation-import-0.3.0.tgz
https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/releases/download/v0.3.0/siweimidu-conversation-import-0.3.0.tgz
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@v0.3.0/dist/siweimidu-chat-preset-0.3.0.tgz
```

如果面板报「无法连接」，先点一次**重试**：首次访问是冷缓存（2–3s），面板的超时比这个更短时就会误报，重试通常即成功。

如果重试仍然连不上（说明这台机器的面板进程没有可用出口），改填**本地路径**——面板接受 `.tgz` 绝对路径和本地目录，两种都不需要网络：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1
# 脚本会打印可直接粘贴的 .tgz 路径与解包目录路径
```

实测（用与面板相同的安装机制）：从本地 `.tgz` 绝对路径安装返回 `Done`，配置层出现 `id: conversation-import`，host 半 `apply` 可加载。

### 命令行一行（自动判断 profile，不用你填名字）

宿主把 `--profile` 定为必填项，且 `desktop` 被 Electron 独占，所以命令行是这样一行（自动挑第一个非 desktop 的 profile）：

```powershell
$p=(Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles" -Directory | ?{ $_.Name -notin 'desktop','node_modules' } | Select -First 1).Name; 'conversation-import','chat-preset' | %{ dsh plugin --profile $p add "https://github.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/releases/download/v0.3.0/xiaozhuang-dsh-$_-0.3.0.tgz" }
```

macOS / Linux：

```sh
p=$(ls ~/.dsh/profiles | grep -vx -e desktop -e node_modules | head -1)
for k in conversation-import chat-preset; do dsh plugin --profile "$p" add "https://github.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/releases/download/v0.3.0/xiaozhuang-dsh-$k-0.3.0.tgz"; done
```

### 想先下载再手动选目录

```powershell
# Windows
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1
```
```sh
# macOS / Linux
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration/master/install.sh | sh
```

两个脚本都会自动在 GitHub / jsDelivr / raw 之间挑一个可用的源，解包后打印可直接粘进「从本地目录安装」的绝对路径。

### 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @siweimidu/conversation-import
```

四种安装源各自验证到哪一步、以及发布者收尾命令，见 [docs/INSTALL-ANYWHERE.md](./docs/INSTALL-ANYWHERE.md)。

## 兼容性

宿主版本区间：`engines.dsh >= 0.1.7`。**实测**（不是声明）结果见 [docs/COMPATIBILITY.md](./docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)：

- 插件注册的两个 slot（`settings.section`、`conversation.session.header.utilities`）在 `0.1.7-rc.2`、`0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.2-rc.3` 全部存在；
- 8 个运行时依赖包在这 4 个版本里全部可获取；
- 矩阵由 `pnpm compat:matrix` 现场从 npm 拉包解包核对，可重跑。

验收过程与真实命令输出见 [docs/VERIFICATION.md](./docs/VERIFICATION.md)。

## 未移植的两个插件

`composer-add-menu` 与 `ui-plain-chat` 依赖的是**上游 fork 私有契约**，标准宿主没有对应扩展点，硬装上去只会渲染出空壳。它们现在 `private: true`，测试会强制这一点，避免误装。

具体缺什么：

| 插件 | 依赖的私有契约 | 标准宿主现状 | 移植要做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `composer-add-menu` | slot `conversation.input.add`，owner 侧注入约 18 个 props（命令表、插件表、技能表、附件回调、`focusInput`、`onInsertSlashItem`…） | 没有该 slot；`conversation.input.left` 只给 `{}` | 改成从公开 client service 取数据（`commandUi`、`inputTriggers`、`fileUpload`），重写组件与样式，**并用能处理 CSS Modules 的构建链重建 `lib/client.js`** |
| `ui-plain-chat` | slot `sidebar.primary.action`；service `conversationPresentation`（隐藏 hero 配置/输入框模式/辅助面板）；`uiWorkspace.registerSessionGroup` | 三个都不存在（`uiWorkspace.openSession/startSession/newSession` 有，`registerSessionGroup` 没有） | 入口改挂 `sidebar.footer.action`（props 只有 `{ wide }`），丢掉表现层与分组的等价能力，或找到新的公开替代表达 |

已知的构建缺口：仓库里的 `lib/client.js` 是上游工具链产物；本仓库的 tsdown 配置能重建 **host 半**，client 半还缺 CSS Modules 支持（rolldown 那条链路目前把 class map 编译成空对象）。因此现阶段对 client 半的改动是"改源码 + 同步产物 + 测试锁死"，不是"改源码就能出包"。这一条在移植前必须补上。

## 仓库结构

```
packages/<id>/          四个插件包（每个都是自包含可安装包）
  src/                  源码（TypeScript / React）
  lib/                  已构建产物（host: ESM，client: __ModuleLoader__ 工厂）
  cordis.patch.yml      声明插入宿主的行
  tests/                包级契约测试
scripts/check-manifests.mjs   安装契约校验器（无 workspace: / patch 可解析 / client 声明完整）
scripts/compat-matrix.mjs     实测宿主 slot 与依赖包可用性
legacy/                 上游 fork 导出物：旧 payload/、manifest.json、INSTALL.md、四个核心补丁（仅作参考）
docs/                   设计、兼容矩阵、验收记录
```

`legacy/payload/shared/*.patch` 是给 DSH 本体打补丁的旧方案——**本仓库不再需要、也不再支持**。标准插件不允许修改宿主。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check:manifests     # 安装契约
pnpm test                # 26 个测试
pnpm typecheck           # 对已发布宿主类型做类型检查（两个可安装包）
pnpm typecheck:all       # 含未移植包；在移植完成前必然是红的
pnpm compat:matrix       # 重新测量 4 个宿主版本
```

`pnpm typecheck:all` 现在报的错就是移植清单本身：`conversation.input.add` / `sidebar.primary.action` 不在宿主 slot 联合类型里，`ctx.conversationPresentation` 不存在——编译器的报错就是「缺什么」的权威答案。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。源码派生自 Xiaozhuang DSH 的单向导出（见 [legacy/](./legacy/)）。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
--- description: "Native Web conversation portability: DeepSeek history import plus Session-log ZIP export." kind: "package-reference" --- # @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export English | [中文](README.zh.md) ## Summary The plugin owns its original chat icon in Settings; its icon contribution is removed with the plugin. `dsh-session-log-export` owns the Web product's conversation portability surfaces. From **Settings → Import conversations**, users can select an official DeepSeek JSON or ZIP export, preview each independent conversation window, then search and choose exactly which conversations to import. The imported sessions preserve conversation order, titles, timestamps, questions, answers, and exported reasoning. The existing `Session log` action and `/export` command still download a DSH session tree — including descendants and attachments — as a ZIP. Setup and usage come first; implementation details follow. ## Table of Contents - [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) ----- ## Use this package Use this package when the Web bundle should let users move conversations into or out of DSH. It requires Connection, the command registry, Session query and persistence, and attachments. Mount the plugin, then either open **Settings → Import conversations** and select a DeepSeek export, or click `Session log` in a Session Header / type `/export` to download `dsh-session-.zip`. ### When to choose it Choose it for a Web deployment that needs native user-facing conversation import and export. Import writes standard DSH Session events and works with normal Session persistence. Export still requires a backend that stores a per-session raw artifact (the shipped JSONL backend supports plaintext and zstd; SQLite export is not supported). Avoid it when a programmatic or Host-path export is needed: exports are browser downloads. ### Composition ```yaml - id: session-log-download name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export' ``` The Web bundle mounts the package with Connection, `dsh-commands`, `dsh-client-ui-commands`, and `dsh-client-ui-conversation`. ### Configuration | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `compressionLevel` | `6` | DEFLATE level from 0 through 9 for each ZIP entry. | ### Command contract | Input | Result | |---|---| | `/export` | Records a human-command lifecycle; the submitting browser downloads `GET /api/session.export?sessionId=&includeDescendants=true` | | `/export ` | An error; browser downloads choose their destination through the browser's ordinary download behavior | ### What to expect DeepSeek import accepts the official `.json` file or a `.zip` containing it. Selecting a file first performs a read-only preview: each DeepSeek conversation window appears as one row with its title, timestamp, message count, and reasoning count. The picker supports search, selecting the current results, and clearing the selection. Previously imported sources remain visible but disabled, while new conversations are selected by default. On confirmation, the browser submits the same file plus the selected source ids; the Host reparses it and writes only exact matches. Both the official mapping shape and the raw DeepSeek API export shape are normalized. Regenerated branches are reduced to the selected branch, `THINK` fragments become native reasoning blocks, reference markers become links when source URLs are present, and imported sessions use the `chat` preset. Conversations are written incrementally and the UI stays in a busy state until the native Session list refreshes. Re-importing the same source ids skips duplicates without rewriting them. The dialog reports three phases: preparing, download started, or failed. Closing the dialog does not cancel an in-flight download, and the dialog does not reopen when that operation later settles. One session admits one active download at a time; repeated gestures share that operation. The export includes the live session's newest events: the host endpoint flushes a live root session before reading, so a slash-triggered ZIP includes the `command/run` and `command/done` pair that started the download; cold persisted sessions need no flush. ### Failures The dialog shows a preparation error when the preflight fails before ZIP streaming starts — for example an unreachable or misconfigured host endpoint. A descendant or attachment read failure after the browser accepts the GET is reported by the browser download manager, not by the dialog. ----- ## Understand the implementation
Implementation internals — click to expand This section explains how the package wires the export control and points at the code that realizes it; the observable behavior is fully covered in [Use this package](#use-this-package). ### Design split The package has two halves. The Host half ([`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts)) registers the `/export` command and contributes exact authenticated routes for `GET`/`HEAD /api/session.export` and `POST /api/session.import.deepseek`; the latter supports read-only preview, selection-aware confirmation, and backward-compatible whole-file import. [`src/archive.ts`](src/archive.ts) builds the bounded ZIP stream, while [`src/deepseek-import.ts`](src/deepseek-import.ts) produces previews, validates selections, normalizes exports into native Session events, and refreshes durable projection indexes. The browser half ([`src/client/index.ts`](src/client/index.ts)) retains the selected `File`, provides the shared download controller, registers the import settings page, and refreshes the Session list after confirmation. ### Download flow Both entry paths issue a `HEAD` preflight to `GET /api/session.export?...`, then hand the GET URL to the browser download manager without buffering the ZIP in JavaScript. One controller owns one in-flight download per session, collapses concurrent gestures into that operation, and cancels the preflight on plugin disposal. Modal state lives in a snapshot store keyed by session, so the button and the command share one dialog per session. The Host route is a feature-owned exact Fetch contribution. Connection applies its Host/Origin and browser-session checks and bridges the streaming `Response`; this package owns query validation, live-session flushes, raw artifact and attachment reads, ZIP generation, and HTTP status semantics.
----- ## Further Exploration Read these pages when the package-level contract is not enough. They move from the Web control to the host endpoint and the surrounding command and session surfaces. - [dsh-client-connection](../../packages/client/connection/README.md) — the authenticated Fetch-route carrier used by the Host endpoint. - [Commands subsystem reference](../../docs/subsystems/commands.md) — the human-command registry the `/export` command registers on. - [dsh-client-ui-commands](../../packages/client/ui-commands/README.md) — the browser command surface that renders and acknowledges `/export`. - [Session Query package map](../../packages/session/README.md) — the retrieval family this package belongs to. ----- ## Model Experience ### Human `/export` control #### What the model sees Nothing. `/export` stays on the human-command plane, and the ZIP download does not enter model history. #### Token effect Zero. The command creates no model turn. #### KV Cache effect None. The log-only command lifecycle and browser download do not change the derived request prefix. ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work These limits define when this package is a poor fit or needs special operational care. They are current package constraints, not a task backlog. - **Requires a per-session raw artifact backend** — the download endpoint needs a persistence backend with a per-session raw artifact; the shipped JSONL backend supports plaintext and zstd, and SQLite export is not supported. - **Browser download, not a Host-path writer** — the browser chooses the local destination; no Host path or native folder action is returned. - **Preflight reports only pre-stream failures** — a descendant or attachment failure after the browser accepts the GET is reported by the browser download manager, not by the dialog. - **DeepSeek import only** — the import page currently accepts DeepSeek official history exports; other chatbot schemas are rejected rather than guessed. - **Only data present in the export can be restored** — questions, answers, timestamps, reasoning, and link references are mapped when present. Binary attachments that DeepSeek does not include in the export cannot be recreated. ### Dev Note
Working context for maintainers — click to expand This Dev Note is working context for maintainers: open design questions and directions that are not decided. It is explicitly non-authoritative — shipped behavior, limits, and accepted rationale live in the sections above, the package code, and the linked pages. #### Future: export destinations beyond the browser The download is deliberately browser-scoped; a Host-path or native folder export would need a new endpoint contract and a decision on where the ZIP lands.

# @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plain-chat

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## Summary

Adds a compact `Chat mode` action to the official sidebar footer. It reuses an existing blank Session already composed with the shipped `chat` preset, or creates one Session, selects that preset, and opens it. Repeated clicks while creation is in flight share the same operation.

## Model Experience

The UI package itself is not model-facing. The separate shipped `chat` preset provides the plain conversational persona and mounts no tools.

# dsh-chat-migration

把 DeepSeek 对话历史导入 DSH、把会话导出成可迁移文件——做成**标准 DSH 插件**，`dsh plugin add` 一条命令装进任意 profile，不需要改宿主源码、不需要打补丁、不需要 fork。

[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

## 装什么

| 包 | 状态 | 能力 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@siweimidu/conversation-import` | ✅ 可安装 | DeepSeek 对话历史导入（预览 + 选择 + 导入成本地会话）、DSH 会话导出下载、设置页「导入对话」 |
| `@siweimidu/chat-preset` | ✅ 可安装 | 注册可移除的纯聊天 agent preset（`chat`） |
| `@xiaozhuang-dsh/composer-add-menu` | ⛔ 未移植 | 输入框加号菜单（命令/插件/技能/附件） |
| `@xiaozhuang-dsh/ui-plain-chat` | ⛔ 未移植 | 侧栏「聊天」入口 + 纯聊天表现层 |

后两个包为什么没移植、缺什么、怎么补：见 [未移植的两个插件](#未移植的两个插件)。

## 最省事：面板填包名（已发布到 npm）

DSH → **设置 → 插件 → 安装插件**，填包名（不用 URL、不用路径）：

```
@siweimidu/conversation-import
```

```
@siweimidu/chat-preset
```

已实测：`registry.npmjs.org` 的 tarball 国内直连 200 / 1.3s；`npm view` 返回 `0.3.0`；用包名装进空 profile 返回 `Done`，配置层出现插件行。面板走 npm 源，不需要访问 GitHub/jsDelivr。

## 一行命令安装（面板连不上的机器用这个）

**Windows**（PowerShell）

```powershell
irm https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@master/install-oneline.ps1 | iex
```

**macOS / Linux**

```sh
curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/siweimidu/dsh-chat-migration@master/install-oneline.sh | sh
```

这一行会自己完成全部步骤：找到 DSH → 选 profile（有 `desktop` 就用它）→ 多源下载（jsDelivr → ghfast → GitHub → raw）→ 把包写进该 profile 的 `node_modules` → 登记到 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

- **不需要** GitHub 账号、npm 账号、代理，**也不用**填 profile 名；
- 不依赖插件面板的网络（面板有独立出口，经常连不上任何外部地址）；

装完**完全退出 DSH 再启动**，设置里出现「导入对话」。

| 插件 | 依赖的私有契约 | 标准宿主现状 | 移植要做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `composer-add-menu` | slot `conversation.input.add`，owner 侧注入约 18 个 props（命令表、插件表、技能表、附件回调、`focusInput`、`onInsertSlashItem`…） | 没有该 slot；`conversation.input.left` 只给 `{}` | 改成从公开 client service 取数据（`commandUi`、`inputTriggers`、`fileUpload`），重写组件与样式，**并用能处理 CSS Modules 的构建链重建 `lib/client.js`** |
| `ui-plain-chat` | slot `sidebar.primary.action`；service `conversationPresentation`（隐藏 hero 配置/输入框模式/辅助面板）；`uiWorkspace.registerSessionGroup` | 三个都不存在（`uiWorkspace.openSession/startSession/newSession` 有，`registerSessionGroup` 没有） | 入口改挂 `sidebar.footer.action`（props 只有 `{ wide }`），丢掉表现层与分组的等价能力，或找到新的公开替代表达 |

已知的构建缺口：仓库里的 `lib/client.js` 是上游工具链产物；本仓库的 tsdown 配置能重建 **host 半**，client 半还缺 CSS Modules 支持（rolldown 那条链路目前把 class map 编译成空对象）。因此现阶段对 client 半的改动是"改源码 + 同步产物 + 测试锁死"，不是"改源码就能出包"。这一条在移植前必须补上。

## 仓库结构

```
packages/<id>/          四个插件包（每个都是自包含可安装包）
  src/                  源码（TypeScript / React）
  lib/                  已构建产物（host: ESM，client: __ModuleLoader__ 工厂）
  cordis.patch.yml      声明插入宿主的行
  tests/                包级契约测试
scripts/check-manifests.mjs   安装契约校验器（无 workspace: / patch 可解析 / client 声明完整）
scripts/compat-matrix.mjs     实测宿主 slot 与依赖包可用性
legacy/                 上游 fork 导出物：旧 payload/、manifest.json、INSTALL.md、四个核心补丁（仅作参考）
docs/                   设计、兼容矩阵、验收记录
```

`legacy/payload/shared/*.patch` 是给 DSH 本体打补丁的旧方案——**本仓库不再需要、也不再支持**。标准插件不允许修改宿主。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check:manifests     # 安装契约
pnpm test                # 26 个测试
pnpm typecheck           # 对已发布宿主类型做类型检查（两个可安装包）
pnpm typecheck:all       # 含未移植包；在移植完成前必然是红的
pnpm compat:matrix       # 重新测量 4 个宿主版本
```

`pnpm typecheck:all` 现在报的错就是移植清单本身：`conversation.input.add` / `sidebar.primary.action` 不在宿主 slot 联合类型里，`ctx.conversationPresentation` 不存在——编译器的报错就是「缺什么」的权威答案。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。源码派生自 Xiaozhuang DSH 的单向导出（见 [legacy/](./legacy/)）。
