Your coding agent forgets everything between sessions. Claude-Mem remembers for it.


Quick Start • How It Works • Search Tools • Documentation • Configuration • Troubleshooting • License

Every new session, your agent starts from zero. It re-reads the same files, re-asks the same questions, and walks back into mistakes you already fixed together.

Claude-Mem runs a second agent beside it that takes notes while it works. The next session starts with a short index of what matters, and pulls in the details only when it needs them. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and 11 more agents. Copilot CLI, Goose, Roo Code, Warp and Zed can search your memory, but their sessions aren't recorded.

--- ## Quick Start **Installing for someone as an AI agent?** If the user is available, run `npx claude-mem install --setup browser` on their computer and keep it running. It prepares the local runtime, then opens setup in their browser; if the page doesn't open, give them the printed URL. Every choice (agents, integrations, skills, model, usage analytics, the optional email) is made by the user on that page, so there are no terminal questions to relay. If the user is away, run `npx claude-mem install --setup defer`: it prepares the runtime and leaves setup waiting for their first visit, and their next session shows them the link. Don't make their choices for them. ```bash npx claude-mem install ``` The installer finds the agents on your machine and asks which ones to set up. Then just start working: observations stream in from your first prompt, and your second session in a project opens with memory from the first. (Copilot CLI, Goose, Roo Code, Warp and Zed get memory search only, so their sessions don't add to it.) The installer sets everything up first, then asks you to sign in to claude-mem in your browser (email magic link, no card required to sign in). Choosing the **claude-mem observer** then starts its **30 Day Free Trial** on a checkout page that asks for a payment method; once it completes, the installer saves your memory key. With the observer, memory runs off-plan, so you get up to 100% more usage from your plan. When the free trial ends, memory automatically falls back to your Anthropic plan unless you subscribe. After sign-in you pick your memory provider: the claude-mem observer, your own OpenRouter or Gemini key, or your Anthropic plan. Prefer to skip the sign-in? Pass an explicit `--provider` flag, set `CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false`, or run in CI/non-interactive shells — the installer completes without any account interaction. Your memory lives in `~/.claude-mem` on your machine. Cloud sync is opt-in. Anonymous usage analytics are on by default; `npx claude-mem telemetry disable` turns them off ([what's collected](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/telemetry)). Or install from the plugin marketplace inside Claude Code: ```bash /plugin marketplace add thedotmack/claude-mem /plugin install claude-mem ``` Restart Claude Code. Context from previous sessions will automatically appear in new sessions. > **Note:** Claude-Mem is also published on npm, but `npm install -g claude-mem` installs the **SDK/library only** — it does not register the plugin hooks or set up the worker service. Always install via `npx claude-mem install` or the `/plugin` commands above. ### Other agents `npx claude-mem install` covers every supported agent. To set up one agent directly, pass `--ide`. **OpenCode** (1.3.4 or later, including OpenCode 2). Restart OpenCode after installing. ```bash npx claude-mem install --ide opencode ``` **T3 Code** (Codex and Claude Code providers). The installer discovers T3 Code's enabled providers, registers native Claude-Mem plugins in their configured homes, and supports T3-managed Codex. Restart T3 Code, trust the provider's hooks when prompted, and start a new thread. See the [T3 Code integration guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/t3code-integration) for custom server settings, status, and removal. ```bash npx claude-mem install --ide t3code ``` **Antigravity CLI** ([setup guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/antigravity-cli/setup)): ```bash npx claude-mem install --ide antigravity ``` **OMP (Oh My Pi):** ```bash npx claude-mem install --ide omp ``` **Pi and DeepSeek Harness** use the worker runtime. See [native harness setup](docs/native-harness-integrations.md) for capture, recall, and troubleshooting. ```bash npx claude-mem install --ide pi npx claude-mem install --ide dsh --dsh-profile tui ``` **Grok Bot:** see [Grok Bot](#grok-bot) below. ```bash npx claude-mem install --ide grok-bot ``` The full list of `--ide` values is in `npx claude-mem --help`. #### Grok Bot Grok Bot has no host hooks, so we watch the chat log files. Default is CMEM Pro, the hosted memory. Local observer is opt-in: `--provider host`. Installing this plugin does not install Cursor. **Opt-in awareness push:** needle observations (`decision`, `bugfix`, `security_alert`, `sensitive`) are appended as dated `- YYYY-MM-DD [awareness] …` lines into that bot's `memory/log/YYYY-MM.md`. Grok Bot already re-reads the log from disk. This does not write `profile.md`, user-memory, or project memory. Enable with `CLAUDE_MEM_GROK_BOT_AWARENESS_ENABLED=true` and set `CLAUDE_MEM_GROK_BOT_AWARENESS_AGENT_IDS` to your agent UUIDs (empty by default). #### 🦞 OpenClaw Gateway Install claude-mem as a persistent memory plugin on [OpenClaw](https://openclaw.ai) gateways with a single command: ```bash curl -fsSL https://install.cmem.ai/openclaw.sh | bash ``` The installer handles dependencies, plugin setup, AI provider configuration, worker startup, and optional real-time observation feeds to Telegram, Discord, Slack, and more. See the [OpenClaw Integration Guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/openclaw-integration) for details. ## What You Get - 🧠 **The next session starts where the last one left off.** Each session opens with a compact index of past observations, layered so the agent opens full details only when it needs them, and the header can show what each layer costs in tokens. - 🔍 **Find anything you worked on.** The mem-search skill searches your project history in three steps (index, timeline, details), so the agent spends tokens only on what it opens. - 🖥️ **Watch it work, and keep track of yours.** My Work shows live requests, progress, human handoffs and a saved review queue at the worker URL printed on startup. [Guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/usage/my-work). Memory, sessions and settings remain at `/viewer`. - 👥 **Share with your team, if you want.** TeamBrain is an optional shared workspace beside My Work, with real team work lists, member attribution and linked findings. Each person chooses what to share; personal requests and review notes stay separate. [Set up a team](https://cmem.ai/teambrain/start). - 💻 **Search from Claude Desktop.** Search your memory from Claude Desktop conversations. - 🔒 **Keep secrets out.** Wrap anything in `` tags and it never gets stored. - 🖼️ **Screenshots, kept by default.** Keep converted copies of tool screenshots under `~/.claude-mem/media-v1/` and show them in My Work, upload them to cmem.ai only when Cloud Sync is on, and send them to the observer model only when image inference is separately enabled. Turn it off with the "Keep images" switch in Settings ([details](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/configuration#screenshots-and-images)). - ⚙️ **Choose what gets injected.** Fine-grained settings for what context a new session starts with. - 🤖 **Nothing to remember to do.** It runs on its own once installed. - 🔗 **Point back to past work.** Every observation has an ID you can cite through the worker API or open in the web viewer. --- ## Documentation 📚 **[View Full Documentation](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/)** - Browse on official website ### Getting Started - **[Installation Guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/installation)** - Quick start & advanced installation - **[Usage Guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/usage/getting-started)** - How Claude-Mem works automatically - **[Search Tools](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/usage/search-tools)** - Query your project history with natural language - **[Cloud Sync](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/cloud-sync)** - Back up your memory to cmem.ai — no daemon, the worker syncs on write ### Best Practices - **[Context Engineering](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/context-engineering)** - AI agent context optimization principles - **[Progressive Disclosure](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/progressive-disclosure)** - Philosophy behind Claude-Mem's context priming strategy ### Architecture - **[Overview](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/architecture/overview)** - System components & data flow - **[Architecture Evolution](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/architecture-evolution)** - The journey from v3 to v5 - **[Hooks Architecture](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/hooks-architecture)** - How Claude-Mem uses lifecycle hooks - **[Hooks Reference](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/architecture/hooks)** - Every hook entry explained - **[Worker Service](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/architecture/worker-service)** - HTTP API & Bun management - **[Database](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/architecture/database)** - SQLite schema & FTS5 search - **[Search Architecture](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/architecture/search-architecture)** - Hybrid search with Chroma vector database ### Configuration & Development - **[Configuration](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/configuration)** - Environment variables & settings - **[Development](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/development)** - Building, testing, contributing - **[Troubleshooting](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/troubleshooting)** - Common issues & solutions --- ## How It Works 1. **Your agent works.** Hooks in your agent hand each tool call (what it reads, edits and runs) to a small local worker. 2. **The observer takes notes.** A second agent turns that activity into short observations, and writes a summary when the session ends. 3. **The next session starts with them.** When a session starts, your agent gets a compact index of the observations that matter for this project, and fetches full details only when it needs them. Memory injection starts on your second session in a project. To front-load a whole repo instead, run `/learn-codebase` (~5 minutes on a typical repo, optional). See [Architecture Overview](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/architecture/overview) for details. ### How it fits together For contributors, the main parts and where they live: - **The `claude-mem` command** (`src/npx-cli/index.ts`): install, repair, doctor, start, search and the rest. The installer puts a small launcher on PATH so hooks can run `claude-mem` directly. - **Hooks** (`src/cli/hook-command.ts`, one adapter per agent in `src/cli/adapters/`): each agent event runs one shell-free command, such as `claude-mem hook claude-code `. For Claude Code that's Setup (`claude --init` / `--maintenance`), SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, Stop, SubagentStop and SessionEnd. - **The worker** (`src/services/worker-service.ts`, routes in `src/services/worker/http/routes/`): a local HTTP service managed by Bun. It takes tool activity from the hooks, runs the observer, and serves the viewer and search. - **The observer** (prompts in `src/sdk/`, one provider per model source in `src/services/worker/`, such as `ClaudeProvider.ts` and `OpenRouterProvider.ts`): turns tool activity into observations and summaries. - **Storage** (`src/services/sqlite/`): SQLite at `~/.claude-mem/claude-mem.db` holds sessions, observations and summaries. Chroma adds semantic search on top of SQLite's keyword search (`src/services/worker/search/`). - **Context** (`src/services/context/`): builds the block a new session starts with. - **Search** (`src/servers/mcp-server.ts`, `plugin/skills/mem-search/`): the MCP tools and the mem-search skill that drives them. - **The viewer** (`src/ui/viewer/` at `/viewer`, `src/ui/my-work/` at `/`): memory, sessions and settings, plus My Work. - **The built plugin** (`plugin/`): written by `npm run build`; edit `src/`, not the generated scripts. The words we use for each of these, and the story they tell, are in [docs/story.md](docs/story.md). --- ## MCP Search Tools Search runs through three MCP tools in a token-efficient three-step workflow. The mem-search skill drives it for you: **The three steps:** 1. **`search`** - Get compact index with IDs (~50-100 tokens/result) 2. **`timeline`** - Get chronological context around interesting results 3. **`get_observations`** - Fetch full details ONLY for filtered IDs (~500-1,000 tokens/result) **Step by step:** - Your agent uses MCP tools to search your memory - Start with `search` to get an index of results - Use `timeline` to see what was happening around specific observations - Use `get_observations` to fetch full details for relevant IDs - **Index rows are about a tenth the size of a full record**: ~50-100 tokens versus ~500-1,000. Filtering decides how many records you pay to fetch, not how large each one is; the workflow's total cost also includes the timeline and the selected details. The ratio is not a measured recall or end-to-end saving ([#4138](https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/issues/4138)). **Available MCP Tools:** 1. **`search`** - Search memory index with full-text queries, filters by type/date/project 2. **`timeline`** - Get chronological context around a specific observation or query 3. **`get_observations`** - Fetch full observation details by IDs (always batch multiple IDs) **Example Usage:** ```typescript // Step 1: Search for index search(query="authentication bug", type="bugfix", limit=10) // Step 2: Review index, identify relevant IDs (e.g., #123, #456) // Step 3: Fetch full details get_observations(ids=[123, 456]) ``` The worker also offers tools for code navigation (`smart_search`, `smart_outline`, `smart_unfold`), saving a note on purpose (`save_memory`) and tracking work in progress. See [Search Tools Guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/usage/search-tools) for detailed examples. --- ## System Requirements - **Node.js**: 20.19 or later in the 20.x line, or 22.12 or later - **A supported agent**: Claude Code (latest, with plugin support) or any agent in [Other agents](#other-agents) - **Bun**: JavaScript runtime and process manager (auto-installed if missing) - **uv**: Python package manager for vector search (auto-installed if missing) - **SQLite 3**: For persistent storage (bundled) --- ### Windows Setup Notes If you see an error like: ```powershell npm : The term 'npm' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet ``` Make sure Node.js and npm are installed and added to your PATH. Download the latest Node.js installer from https://nodejs.org and restart your terminal after installation. Claude Code hooks do not need Git Bash. Each hook runs `claude-mem` directly, and `npx claude-mem install` places that launcher at `%LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-mem\bin\claude-mem.exe` and adds the folder to your user Path. Restart your terminal or IDE afterwards so Claude Code picks up the new Path. If hooks report `Executable not found in $PATH: "claude-mem"`, run `npx claude-mem doctor` and see [Troubleshooting](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/troubleshooting#claude-mem-command-not-found-in-hooks). --- ## Configuration Settings are managed in `~/.claude-mem/settings.json` (auto-created with defaults on first run). Configure AI model, worker port, data directory, log level, and context injection settings. To include observations from every harness in Claude Code and Codex SessionStart context, set `"CLAUDE_MEM_SESSION_START_INCLUDE_ALL_SOURCES": "true"` in that file, or enable **Include all sources at session start** in the viewer settings. The default is `"false"`, which limits startup context to the current harness. The observation count limit still applies across the selected sources. See the **[Configuration Guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/configuration)** for all available settings and examples. ### Mode & Language Configuration Claude-Mem supports multiple workflow modes and languages via the `CLAUDE_MEM_MODE` setting. This option controls both: - The workflow behavior (e.g. code, chill, investigation) - The language used in generated observations #### How to Configure Edit your settings file at `~/.claude-mem/settings.json`: ```json { "CLAUDE_MEM_MODE": "code--zh" } ``` Modes are defined in `plugin/modes/`. To see all available modes locally: ```bash ls ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/thedotmack/plugin/modes/ ``` #### Available Modes | Mode | Description | |------------|-------------------------| | `code` | Default English mode | | `code--chill` | Records fewer observations, keeping only what would be painful to rediscover | | `code--[lang]` | Same as `code`, with observations and summaries written in another language | Built-in language codes: `ar`, `bn`, `cs`, `da`, `de`, `el`, `es`, `fi`, `fr`, `he`, `hi`, `hu`, `id`, `it`, `ja`, `ko`, `nl`, `no`, `pl`, `pt-br`, `ro`, `ru`, `sv`, `th`, `tr`, `uk`, `ur`, `vi`, `zh`. For example, `code--ko` writes observations and summaries in Korean. See [Modes](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/modes) for each language's name, the email investigation mode, and custom modes. > Note: All of these modes are built in. No additional installation or plugin update is required. #### After Changing Mode Restart Claude Code to apply the new mode configuration. --- ## Development See the **[Development Guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/development)** for build instructions, testing, and contribution workflow. --- ## Troubleshooting Start with `npx claude-mem doctor`. It checks Bun, uv, the hook launcher and the worker, and tells you what to fix. See the **[Troubleshooting Guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/troubleshooting)** for common issues and solutions. --- ## Bug Reports Create comprehensive bug reports with the automated generator: ```bash cd ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/thedotmack npm run bug-report ``` ## Contributing Contributions are welcome! Please: 1. Fork the repository 2. Create a feature branch 3. Make your changes with tests 4. Update documentation (user-facing words follow [docs/story.md](docs/story.md)) 5. Submit a Pull Request against `main` Releases ship from `main` and are published to npm. See [Development Guide](https://docs.claude-mem.ai/development) for contribution workflow. --- ## License Claude-Mem is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. We chose Apache-2.0 because durable agentic memory should be easy to embed in developer tools, local agents, MCP servers, enterprise systems, robotics stacks, and production agent harnesses. See the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for full details. See [docs/license.md](docs/license.md) and [docs/ip-boundary.md](docs/ip-boundary.md) for licensing scope and the open/commercial boundary. --- ## Support - **Documentation**: [docs/](docs/) - **Issues**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/issues) - **Repository**: [github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem](https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem) - **Official X Account**: [@Claude_Memory](https://x.com/Claude_Memory) - **Official Discord**: [Join Discord](https://discord.com/invite/J4wttp9vDu) - **Author**: Alex Newman ([@thedotmack](https://github.com/thedotmack)) --- **Built with Claude Agent SDK** | **Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more** | **Made with TypeScript** --- ### What About CMEM? CMEM is a token created by a 3rd party but officially embraced by the creator of Claude-Mem (Alex Newman, @thedotmack). The token acts as a community catalyst for growth and a vehicle for bringing CMEM to the developers and knowledge workers that need it most. Official BASE CA: 0x76b1967eec0ccaeb001bbbb2b40dc4badba31ba3

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dev-stack

A plan-backed development workflow for Claude Code, Pi, and DeepSeek Harness (DSH): skills, subagents, phase gates, shared rules, and the `/dev-stack-*` commands. It ships as one package holding one plugin, `dev`, that each harness installs natively. The sources are TypeScript, type-checked with TypeScript 7 and linted with Biome; `bun run build` compiles them to JavaScript in `dist/dev/`, the plugin every harness loads.

## Install

Requires [Bun](https://bun.sh) 1.4 or later on `PATH`: the gates and CLIs run under `bun`. Pre-install `bun install && bun run build`

| Harness | Install | Skills |
| ------- | ------- | ------ |
| Claude Code | `claude plugin marketplace add ~/dev-stack` and `/plugin install dev@dev-stack` | `/dev:<skill>` |
| Pi | `pi install ~/dev-stack` | `/dev:<skill>` (registered, so Pi lists it) or `/skill:<skill>` |
| DSH | install this checkout as a linked bundle: `plugin_manager` action `install_bundle` with the checkout's absolute path | `dev-<skill>`, as the session skill catalog shows |
| Antigravity (`agy`) | `agy plugin install ~/dev-stack/dist/dev-agy` | `<skill>` (from the `dev` plugin) |

The marketplace also lists `typescript-lsp`, a Claude Code-only plugin that runs [vtsls](https://github.com/yioneko/vtsls) as the language server for `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.mts`, `.cts`, `.js`, `.jsx`, `.mjs`, and `.cjs` files. Install `vtsls` on `PATH` (`npm install -g @vtsls/language-server`), then `/plugin install typescript-lsp@dev-stack`. It is plain JSON, so it needs no build.

`dist/` is not committed: rebuild after each change to `plugins/dev/`. Claude Code copies the plugin into its cache, so reinstall it through `/plugin` after a rebuild; Pi loads `dist/dev` in place, so `/reload` picks up a rebuild. For development, `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS=~/dev-stack/dist/dev claude` loads the built plugin from the checkout; restart the session after `bun run build`. DSH links the checkout, so it runs `dist/dev/dsh/index.js` in place; rebuild and restart the session after changing the plugin.

The plugin injects [CORE.md](plugins/dev/rules/CORE.md) and [CODING.md](plugins/dev/rules/CODING.md) into the context (Claude: a `prompt.context` block, which subagents also receive; Pi: `before_agent_start`; DSH: a `dev-stack:rules` system-prompt section; Antigravity: `SessionStart` `injectSteps` via `bin/agy-hook.js`) and defines `$DEV_LIB` there as the plugin's absolute install root. No `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`, or `GEMINI.md` pointer is needed.

DSH has no Skill tool arguments and no prompt-submit hook. A phase's plan is the one named by the assistant message that loaded the skill, else by the latest user message, and a gated phase typed as `/dev-<name>` ends the turn instead of loading ungated: enter a gated phase through the model, asking it to run the skill on the plan, so a refusal carries its reason.

## Layout

```
.claude-plugin/marketplace.json   the marketplace: dev, from dist/dev, and typescript-lsp
package.json                      the Pi package manifest (dist/dev), the DSH bundle manifest, dev tooling
cordis.patch.yml                  the DSH bundle patch: inserts the dev-stack Host plugin
locale/, icon.svg                 DSH display metadata and icon
plugins/typescript-lsp/           the Claude Code vtsls language-server plugin, shipped as is
plugins/dev/                      the plugin's sources; their build ships alone
  skills/<name>/SKILL.md          skills
  agents/<name>.md                subagents (Claude); Pi's main agent reads them directly
  rules/                          CORE.md, CODING.md, plan.md, frontend-design.md
  core/                           the workflow logic: plans, stacks, gates (Node APIs, synchronous)
  bin/                            CLIs over core (`bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null $DEV_LIB/bin/<name>.js` once built); bin/hook.ts is the gate
  hooks/                          Claude Code plugin module (no Node): rules, and gates and commands
                                  that run bin/ through $.process.run; commands.ts, the rules text
                                  and /dev-stack-* commands the other adapters share
  pi/                             Pi extension: rules, gates, and commands, calling core in-process
  dsh/                            DSH Host plugin: rules, skills, commands, and gates, calling core in-process
scripts/build.ts                  compiles plugins/dev into dist/dev and copies its rules, skills, agents,
                                  and manifests beside the output
dist/dev/                         the built plugin every harness loads (gitignored)
test/                             bun test suites
```

## Skills

[plan.md](plugins/dev/rules/plan.md) is the shared contract for plan-backed delivery. Load only the current skill and what it links.

| Need | Skill |
|---|---|
| Understand existing code | [explore](plugins/dev/skills/explore/SKILL.md) |
| Plan application work | [design-feature](plugins/dev/skills/design-feature/SKILL.md) |
| Review a plan before approval | [review-feature](plugins/dev/skills/review-feature/SKILL.md) |
| Implement an approved or auto-approved plan | [execute-feature](plugins/dev/skills/execute-feature/SKILL.md) |
| Review implemented work | [review-code](plugins/dev/skills/review-code/SKILL.md) |
| Review a direct edit before its PR, or an open PR | [review-change](plugins/dev/skills/review-change/SKILL.md) |
| Publish reviewed PRs | [create-pr](plugins/dev/skills/create-pr/SKILL.md) |
| Split a PR into atomic PRs, on request only | [split-pr-atomic](plugins/dev/skills/split-pr-atomic/SKILL.md) |
| Drive a stack through its phases | [run-stack](plugins/dev/skills/run-stack/SKILL.md) |
| Run the whole flow from an issue or requirement, auto-approving | [autopilot](plugins/dev/skills/autopilot/SKILL.md) |
| Diagnose a bug and route its fix | [fix-bug](plugins/dev/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md) |
| Design/review system boundaries | [design-system](plugins/dev/skills/design-system/SKILL.md), [review-system](plugins/dev/skills/review-system/SKILL.md) |
| Design/review an infrastructure runbook | [design-infra](plugins/dev/skills/design-infra/SKILL.md), [review-infra](plugins/dev/skills/review-infra/SKILL.md) |
| Capture a standalone issue | [create-issue](plugins/dev/skills/create-issue/SKILL.md) |
| Extract session lessons | [recap](plugins/dev/skills/recap/SKILL.md) |
| Write or read a session handoff | [handoff](plugins/dev/skills/handoff/SKILL.md) |

[frontend-design.md](plugins/dev/rules/frontend-design.md) holds UI guidance; [CODING.md](plugins/dev/rules/CODING.md) applies it to all UI work.

## Agents

In Claude Code they are `dev:<name>`. DSH has no named plugin agents, so its skills hand these files' instructions to the `subagent` tool.

| Need | Agent |
|---|---|
| Implement a plan or an assigned chunk | [executor](plugins/dev/agents/executor.md) |
| Diagnose a bug | [inspector](plugins/dev/agents/inspector.md) |
| Design or revise plans and design documents | [planner](plugins/dev/agents/planner.md) |
| Review under [plan.md — Review](plugins/dev/rules/plan.md#review) | [reviewer](plugins/dev/agents/reviewer.md) |

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
DSH Explore

A branching-conversation canvas for DeepSeek Harness.

[![CI](https://github.com/tzzs/dsh-explore/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tzzs/dsh-explore/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/tzzs/dsh-explore)](https://github.com/tzzs/dsh-explore/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/tzzs/dsh-explore)](LICENSE) ![Platform: DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DeepSeek%20Harness-3B6FD4) **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) --- ## What it is A conversation in DSH is a line: A → B → C. Real thinking does not look like that — on one answer you often want to ask several unrelated things at once, and once asked they all sink into history with no way to put them side by side. DSH Explore adds an **Infinite Exploration** tab to every conversation: it lays the turns out on an infinite canvas where **any answer can become a fork point**. Ask a follow-up on a node and a new branch grows from it, carrying the full context from the root to that node while leaving its siblings untouched. A branch is not a prompt with history pasted into it. It is a real DSH session created with `ctx.sessions.fork({ sessionId, atSeq })`, so it inherits the exact event prefix up to that answer; tools, approvals, streaming, cancellation and retries all behave like any other conversation. ## Features - **Infinite canvas** — drag to pan, scroll to zoom (20%–200%), fit to canvas; the minimap in the bottom-right corner shows the current viewport and jumps on click. On supported DSH layouts, the canvas extends behind the title and composer. - **Both tree directions** — the toolbar carries a two-way layout switch: **top to bottom** or **left to right**. Both options are visible at once and the active one is pressed, so the current direction never has to be guessed from the shape of the canvas. The choice is saved in this browser and applies to other conversations. - **Host appearance** — the interface follows DSH in eight languages (Chinese, English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian) and in both the light and the dark theme: elevation, overlay surfaces, scrollbars and native form controls are all theme-aware. - **Fork from any answer** — the `+` in the corner of a finished card opens an inline composer; press Enter and the new node appears immediately. - **Concurrent branches** — several branches can run at once. A running card carries a live progress row (spinner, "Thinking… / Calling read / Writing…", step N, elapsed seconds), renders streamed tokens as Markdown while they arrive, and offers Stop. - **You can see what it is thinking** — an elapsed time says the agent is busy, not what it is doing. A running card carries a live "reasoning tail" with the model's newest line; a settled card carries a row saying how much thinking there is and what it ends on. Both open the reader, where the whole chain sits at the top of the answer, folded away and one click from being read. Expanding it inside the card would stretch a 320px card into a long strip, so it does not. A model that does not think shows none of this. - **Waiting on you** — a branch parked on a question or an approval says so on its card ("Waiting for your answer…" / "Waiting for your approval…") with an accent ring; the canvas expands the path to it and centres it, and the toolbar chip "N waiting on you" jumps there. The path to a running or waiting node is never hidden by the default fold. - **Jump to latest** — expands the ancestor path of the newest node and centres that card; newest is judged by creation time, so out-of-order completions cannot send you to a stale card. - **Fold and search** — branches at depth 3 and deeper start folded, except on the path to a running or waiting node; `Ctrl/Cmd+F` focuses the search box, and Enter steps through matches, revealing their ancestor paths. - **Full-screen reader** — click a card body to open the reader (Esc, backdrop, or × closes it); long answers no longer have to fit in 320 px. - **Delete and restore** — deleting writes a tombstone and archives the fork's session; the toolbar restores them in one click. The session log itself is never rewritten. ## Requirements - **DeepSeek Harness**, desktop or web, on a profile that allows installing plugins. - **Node.js 22+** — development only. The plugin has no build step and no npm dependencies of its own. ## Install The plugin is published to npm as `@tanzz/dsh-explore`. Install it through DSH's plugin manager: 1. Open the plugin manager (`plugin_manager`) → `install_bundle`. 2. Set `target` to `@tanzz/dsh-explore`; pin a version with `@tanzz/dsh-explore@0.1.0`. 3. When it finishes, the conversation tabs include 「无限探索」 / Infinite Exploration. > The package name is an install identifier, not a display name: the display name comes from `locale/` — 「DSH 探索」 in Chinese, DSH Explore in English. npm's unscoped `dsh-explore` is taken by an unrelated project, so the package lives under the user scope. To work on the plugin itself, install the clone instead — the profile records it as a `link:` dependency, and edits hot-swap: ```bash git clone https://github.com/tzzs/dsh-explore.git # target: the absolute path, e.g. E:\workspaces\dsh-explore ``` To install a specific release without npm, download the `.tgz` attached to that GitHub Release and point `install_bundle` at the unpacked `package` directory: ```bash mkdir dsh-explore-release tar -xzf tanzz-dsh-explore-0.1.0.tgz -C dsh-explore-release # target: /dsh-explore-release/package ``` ## Naming Four layers, four jobs, deliberately not collapsed into one name: | Layer | Name | Where it appears | Why this one | |---|---|---|---| | Repository | `dsh-explore` | GitHub URL, `git clone` | the public address; short, lowercase, no spaces, and it does not change after release | | Package | `@tanzz/dsh-explore` | `package.json`, npm registry, the profile's dependency | matches the repo, so an install is easy to trace; npm's unscoped `dsh-explore` is taken, so it uses the user scope; renaming it means uninstall and reinstall | | Plugin (display name) | DSH Explore / 「DSH 探索」 | plugin list, settings page | the product name a human reads; the `DSH` prefix says which host it belongs to | | View (tab) | Infinite Exploration / 「无限探索」 | the third tab inside a conversation | describes what the view does, not the product; follows the UI language | The tab is a **view name**, so it is not folded into the display name — "DSH Infinite Exploration" would collide with the tab and read badly in both languages. Nor is the tab shortened to `Explore`: that drops the "infinite" part, and the canvas really does extend without bound. ## Project layout ``` client.js client view: event projection, layout, canvas, cards, reader overlay index.js host half, an empty apply() — all the work happens in the client cordis.patch.yml inserts the dsh-explore row into the DSH profile locale/zh.json Chinese display name and description locale/en.json English display name and description icon.svg plugin icon assets/hero.svg README hero: one line branching into several paths test/render-smoke.cjs renders the whole view with a fake React and asserts both language tables test/canvas-visibility.cjs running/waiting nodes must be laid out and drawn; waiting copy; projection whitelist test/session-rebind.cjs re-subscribe on a new eventSource, no pruning on an empty window, cold session open() test/theme-tokens.cjs no literal colours, required tokens exist, inverted primary-button foreground test/motion.cjs camera interpolation, gesture interruption, navigation replacement, reduced motion test/wheel-scroll.cjs the canvas yields the wheel to inner scroll areas and stops at their ends test/live-clock.cjs the running card counts wall clock, and only one timer exists test/reader-dialog.cjs the reader is a native modal: no hand-built focus trap, contained scroll test/markdown-table.cjs GFM tables: alignment, escaped pipes, scrollable wrapper test/markdown.cjs the whole supported Markdown surface, plus what it refuses test/layout-direction.cjs horizontal and vertical geometry, unequal heights, collapsed branches test/host-overlay.cjs conversation overlay, chrome measurement, reader and fallback test/locale-parity.cjs all eight dictionaries: same key set, aligned {placeholders}, no cross-script leakage test/reasoning.cjs the reasoning card: live tail, disclosure, no-reasoning, retry, cap, truthful count test/reasoning-persist.cjs reasoning stays out of the snapshot and is re-derived after a reload test/real-log.cjs end-to-end harness over a real session.v4.jsonl.zstd docs/design.md design doc: data model, trade-offs, known gaps docs/releasing.md CI, Release Please and npm publishing .github/workflows/ CI, Release Please and the manual npm publish workflow ``` ## How it works The view is a single client plugin; the full design — data model, trade-offs, known gaps — is in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) (currently in Chinese). - **Registration.** One `conversation.view` slot: `id: 'tree'`, `order: 5`, and a `label` thunk that is re-evaluated on every projection, next to Chat and Trajectory. - **Copy follows the host language.** Every visible string is a key in the `dsh-explore` namespace resolved through the client locale service, so switching language swaps the tab title and the whole view. A profile without the locale plugin falls back to the built-in Chinese/English tables, chosen by `document.documentElement.lang`. - **Nodes are projections.** The view reads a session's `entries` (durable events plus the transient `assistant/live-chunk`) and projects one turn onto one card. Nothing extra is recorded, so continuing the chat in Chat simply grows the tree. - **"Waiting on you" has no event of its own.** In the host, `ask_user_question` and approvals are just "a tool that has not returned yet": no `turn/end` is emitted while waiting and `running` stays `true`. The plugin derives the state from `tool/call` (`ask_user_question`, settled by `callId` in `tool/result`) and `approval/asked → approval/decided`, and relabels the card from calling a tool to waiting. `user/message` only ever carries `source.kind: 'user'` or `'user-question-reply'`, and both are projected. - **Reasoning is visible, and it is already in the event window.** The model writes its thinking as `reasoning` content blocks — live as a `reasoning-delta` chunk on the transient `assistant/live-chunk`, settled as `{ type: 'reasoning', text }` inside the durable `assistant/message`. Both reach the plugin unchanged, so one projection covers "thinking now" and "done thinking": while a branch runs the card shows the newest line as a tail, and once it settles the thinking moves into a collapsible section (whose collapsed state still names the last paragraph and admits when the text was capped). A model that does not think renders nothing. A retry reuses the same turn/step, so the failed attempt's thinking is dropped first. Each card keeps at most 12000 characters, and the dropped count is derived from the bytes each block delivered (`received − kept`) rather than accumulated, because a block is trimmed more than once. Reasoning is **not** persisted to `localStorage`: it is re-derived from the log, and that snapshot also holds the parent links, which cannot be rebuilt. - **The path to an active node is never folded.** Layout only walks unfolded nodes, and a folded node has no position and is never drawn — that was the root cause of "the canvas does not show the node that is running". So the ancestor path of a running or waiting node skips the default fold; a node entering the running state also expands and persists that path, and a node that starts waiting moves the canvas onto itself. The toolbar's running count and "waiting on you" count are both jump buttons. - **Sessions get re-bound.** Leaving a conversation drops the host's reference; at zero the scope is collected and the `Session` instance is discarded together with its event window. On the way back, `materializeScope` mints a new `eventSource` and the window starts empty. Subscriptions therefore follow `eventSource` (the old one unsubscribes), an empty window is never treated as "the session is empty" and pruned, and a cold session is `open()`ed once — otherwise returning straight to the tab gives a blank canvas while Chat-then-tab works. `test/session-rebind.cjs` pins this. - **Forks are real sessions.** `ctx.sessions.fork({ sessionId, atSeq })` gives the child the prefix context up to that answer. Each branch also lands in the session list, so it is renamed `⟂ parent question · new question` to stay recognisable. - **Parent links live locally.** This DSH build does not record `parentSession`, so the plugin keeps the tree in `localStorage`, alongside fold state, tombstones and the layout preference. Card heights are measured at runtime. - **Theme.** All colours are `--dsw-alias-*` variables, so light and dark follow the host and no literal value is written. `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` inverts between themes, so primary-button text must use the matching `--dsw-alias-label-primary-foreground` rather than `#fff`; inline code is tinted with 7% `label-primary` because the official inline-code token is nearly white in light mode. Fonts read the composed `--dsw-font-family` / `--ds-font-family-code` tokens, which already join the user's font with the built-in fallback stack. `test/theme-tokens.cjs` guards all of it. ## Development ```bash npm test # all sixteen commands below (scripts.test in package.json) node --check client.js # syntax node test/render-smoke.cjs # render the whole view with a fake React; assert both language tables node test/canvas-visibility.cjs # running/waiting nodes must be laid out and drawn; waiting copy; projection whitelist node test/session-rebind.cjs # re-subscribe after a scope rebuild; no pruning on an empty window; cold session open() node test/theme-tokens.cjs # no literal colours, tokens exist, primary buttons use the inverted foreground node test/motion.cjs # camera moves, gesture interruption, navigation replacement, reduced motion, cleanup node test/wheel-scroll.cjs # the wheel belongs to the reasoning box, not the canvas zoom node test/live-clock.cjs # the elapsed time advances between events, from one timer node test/reader-dialog.cjs # the reader is a native : showModal, close mirroring, backdrop scroll containment node test/markdown-table.cjs # GFM tables in answers node test/markdown.cjs # every Markdown construct the renderer supports node test/layout-direction.cjs # geometry in both directions, unequal heights, collapsed branches node test/host-overlay.cjs # host overlay, chrome measurement, reader, fallback node test/locale-parity.cjs # all eight dictionaries agree on keys, placeholders and script node test/reasoning.cjs # reasoning: live tail, disclosure, no-reasoning, retry, cap, truthful count node test/reasoning-persist.cjs # reasoning stays out of the snapshot; re-derived after reload; parent links survive ``` `node test/real-log.cjs ` replays a real session end to end; it is optional and not part of `npm test`. `client.js` is a client plugin — the lazy factory behind `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` — and edits hot-swap into the running host without a page reload. Note that the stylesheet rewrites the same `

# DSH PM Workbench · 工作台 v2

DSH 右侧栏常驻的一个 tab。v2 把「待办清单」换成了**记事本式备忘**，并让备忘、项目、收件箱、日历、周报共用同一份数据。

- 规划与取舍：[docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md)
- 视觉：Material Design（紫色主色 + 宿主主题 token），深浅色都跟随宿主（`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`）。

## 五个 tab

| tab | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| **备忘** | 一句话/多行记事；可加多行备注；可设**每天重复**（完成则次日新建，未完成则把当前这条改到次日）；勾选后划线；标签（默认七种，含「项目」，或任意 `#标签`，支持新增/重命名/删除）；任意截止日期与时间；置顶、编辑、删除（2.6 秒撤销）；按全部/未完成/重要/今天筛选；置顶/逾期/今天/本周/以后/无日期/已完成分组；**点击卡片右侧滑出抽屉**，可「在对话中处理」或打开更多操作 |
| **日历** | 月视图 + 选中日议程；**只读投影**：备忘的截止日期、项目任务的截止日期都会自动出现在日历上，不在日历里单独添加日程。议程里可勾完成，点备忘跳回备忘，点项目任务直接打开任务编辑 |
| **项目** | 底部新增项目；项目内添加任务（负责人默认「我」、岗位、依赖、起止日期、进度）；甘特图展示时间线和多任务依赖；项目进度按任务平均计算 |
| **收件箱** | **多渠道收件箱**：顶部「全部 / QQ 邮箱」切换和「+ 添加渠道」；QQ 邮箱 IMAP **只读收信**，首次打开有配置引导；同步最近邮件、阅读正文；一键把邮件主题+正文加入待办（自动打「邮件」标签）。微信、钉钉、飞书、RSS 已预留渠道位，目前只实现 QQ 邮箱，且只读：不发送、不删除、不标记已读 |
| **周报** | 本周完成/新增/进行中/重要四个数字；**AI 总结本周工作内容**（完成/推进/风险/下周）；按周缓存；可复制 Markdown；AI 不可用时自动降级为本地统计 |

**信息跟踪（关键词、扫描、时间轴、可信度定级）已整体删除**，Host 的 `/pm-workbench/scan` 路由也一并移除。

## 录入语法

```text
明天下午 3 点跟设计对齐会员改版 #重要
周五前补验收标准 #会员 #紧急
下周一 10:00 周会
10-30 交季度报告
记一下：空状态文案再想一版
```

- 日期：今天/明天/后天/大后天、N 天后、周一…周日、本周X、下周X、10月30日、10-30、2026-12-01、月底
- 时间：15:30、下午 3 点、晚上 8 点半、早上 9 点；有日期没时间 = 全天
- 标签：`#任意标签`，或点输入框下方的快捷 chip
- **备注**：编辑备忘时可填多行备注；卡片上会显示备注，长备注可滚动查看。微信/对话里的 `pm_memo_add`/`pm_memo_update` 也支持 `note`。
- **每天重复**：编辑备忘时打开「每天重复」。当天完成 → 次日自动新建一条；当天没完成 → 次日把同一条的截止日期改到次日（不会复制出两条）。时间、标签、备注一起保留。
- **从待办转项目**：卡片「更多 → 新建项目」或卡片上的「转为项目」会把当前待办作为项目名并生成第一个任务；加上「项目」标签后，卡片左侧会有项目色条，和普通待办区分。仅勾「项目」标签只是标记，不会自动建项目；要建项目请点「转为项目」。
- **项目甘特图**：项目卡里按任务起止日期画横条，依赖用虚线箭头连接；点任务条或左侧名称编辑任务；拖动左侧 ⠿ 可以调整任务行顺序，依赖关系不变。
- **任务进日历**：项目任务的截止日期会出现在日历月视图和当天议程里，完成状态与任务进度同步。
- **标签管理**：标签行里的「管理标签」可新增、重命名、删除；重命名会同步所有备忘，删除会从所有备忘中移除。备忘编辑态里也能直接输入一个新标签。
- 解析在本地即时完成，不等模型；解析结果以 chip 显示，日期/标签可以在保存前改

### 长文本批量录入

- 输入多行或超过 50 字后，Enter / 发送按钮不再存成一条，而是打开 **AI 识别 / 拆分待办**：把整段话按语义拆成多条备忘，带日期/时间的直接写进截止日期，逐条勾选后一次保存（最多 12 条）。
- `Ctrl/Cmd + Enter` 始终按「一条」保存；拆分结果里也有「存为一条」。
- AI 不可用时退化为本地按行/句拆分，界面标注「本地识别」。
- 输入框下方的 AI chip 也会带着当前草稿直接进入拆分预览。

## 收件箱（多渠道）

- 收件箱按「渠道」组织：只接入一个渠道时直接显示该渠道列表；接入多个渠道后顶部出现「全部 / 各渠道」切换。
- 标题栏的「+」打开渠道面板，可以查看已连接渠道、断开连接，以及后续渠道；微信、钉钉、飞书、RSS/网页已预留为「即将支持」。
- 目前只有 QQ 邮箱，读取最近 10 封收件箱邮件，**只读**：不发送、不删除、不标记已读。
- 连接前先在 QQ 邮箱「设置 → 账户」开启 IMAP，并生成**授权码**；连接时填邮箱地址 + 授权码，不要填 QQ 登录密码。
- 授权码保存在 DSH 凭据服务里，本机 `storages/pm-workbench/inbox.json` 只保存邮箱地址和同步时间。
- 第一次打开工作台且未配置邮箱时，顶部会出现配置引导；也可以直接打开「收件箱」tab 配置。
- 邮件列表点开正文后，点「加入待办」会把主题作为待办正文，发件人/时间/正文放进备注，并自动加「邮件」标签。
- 全部渠道视图里每条消息会显示渠道来源；后续渠道接入后可以直接聚合到这个列表。



客户端只发一个请求：

```text
GET  /pm-workbench/ai   → 当前会用哪个 provider/model（健康检查）
POST /pm-workbench/ai   → { task: 'parse' | 'summary', ... }
```

Host 侧：

1. 模型路由顺序：`agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` → 活跃会话的 provider/model → 任意已注册 provider 的第一个模型。
2. 调用 `ctx.llm.stream()`，请求模型支持的最低 reasoning 档位，输出上限 1600 tokens，45 秒超时。
3. 强制 JSON 输出；Host 剥代码围栏、清洗字段，客户端再做一次白名单校验。
4. 失败一律返回可降级的结果：`parse` 用本地规则按行/分号拆条；`summary` 用本地统计生成同样的四组结构，并在 UI 上标注「本地」。

浏览器不接触密钥，也不直连模型服务。路由只在同源页面可用（不返回 CORS 头），第三方页面无法调用它消耗模型额度。

## 数据

- **Host 文件是共享数据源**：`$DSH_HOME/storages/pm-workbench/workbench.json`。浏览器 localStorage 只作为缓存；打开工作台时会把旧缓存与 Host 合并，之后本机编辑会同步到 Host，Host 工具/微信改动会轮询回 UI。
- 存储键 `dsh.pm-workbench.v2` 仍保留；首次打开会读取旧键 `dsh.pm-workbench.v1`，把旧 `todos` 转成备忘（标题、标签、截止日、完成态），`keywords`/`intel` 直接丢弃。
- 周报按周一日期缓存在 `reports`，重新生成会覆盖。
- **升级后请打开一次工作台**：旧 localStorage 数据需要这一下才会迁移到 Host；之后微信/IM 才能读到同一份待办。

## 对话与微信/IM

### 一键送进对话

点击任意备忘卡片，右侧滑出操作抽屉：「对话」把该条待办的正文、标签、截止日期、状态和 id 作为提示词追加到当前会话输入框并直接发送；「更多」里有置顶/编辑/删除。agent 处理时会用 `pm_memo_update` 回写状态。

### 微信/IM 自然语言

任意 DSH agent（包括 `dsh-im` 接入的微信机器人）都可以直接调用 Host 工具：

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `pm_memo_list` | 查看待办：按未完成/已完成、今天/逾期/本周、标签、关键词筛选，返回 id |
| `pm_memo_add` | 新增一条或多条待办（支持相对日期换算后的 `dueDate`/`dueTime`） |
| `pm_memo_update` | 完成/重开、改正文、标签、截止日期、置顶；按 id 或唯一文本片段 |
| `pm_memo_delete` | 删除，必须显式 `confirm:true` |
| `pm_workbench_stats` | 未完成、今天、逾期、本周、本周完成、重要与标签分布 |
| `pm_project_list` | 项目、任务、负责人、岗位、依赖、进度 |
| `pm_project_create` | 新建项目 |
| `pm_project_update` | 改项目信息；`progress` 可统一设置所有任务进度 |
| `pm_project_task_add` | 加任务，支持 `owner`/`role`/`dependsOn`/`progress` |
| `pm_project_task_update` | 改任务进度、负责人、岗位、日期、依赖 |

示例：

- 微信发「今天还有什么待办？」→ agent 调 `pm_memo_list({due:'today'})`
- 「把设计对齐那条标完成」→ `pm_memo_list` 拿到 id → `pm_memo_update({id, done:true})`
- 「记一下：周五前给老王验收标准 #重要」→ `pm_memo_add`
- 「这周完成了多少？」→ `pm_workbench_stats`

前提：微信机器人使用的 Agent Preset 允许工具调用（标准 preset 默认允许），并且 Host 已加载本插件。

## 文件

```text
pm-workbench/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # insert 一行
├── index.js              # Host：AI 路由 + 数据路由 + 工具注册
├── store.js              # Host 共享存储（$DSH_HOME/storages/pm-workbench）
├── tools.js              # 待办与项目工具（pm_memo_* / pm_project_*）
├── inbox.js              # QQ 邮箱只读收信（IMAP + 凭据存储）
├── client.js             # 全部 UI、本地逻辑与 Host 同步
├── locale/{zh,en}.json
├── icon.svg
└── test/
    ├── smoke.mjs         # 注册链路
    ├── core.mjs          # 解析 / 分组 / 周统计 / 迁移 / AI 结果清洗
    ├── host.mjs          # AI 与数据路由、baseRev 冲突
    └── tools.mjs         # 工作台工具的新增/查询/更新/删除/统计
```

## 安装与更新

在 DSH 的「插件 → 添加插件」里选择本目录，或：

```text
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<绝对路径>/pm-workbench" }
```

也可以在终端执行 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <绝对路径>/pm-workbench`。

已安装时，改动文件后**刷新页面**即可加载新 client；Host 路由或工具改动需要重新加载插件（禁用再启用）或重启 DSH。

收件箱依赖 `imapflow` 和 `mailparser`，已写进 `package.json`；本地开发如果没有在插件目录安装依赖，会自动尝试复用 DSH profile 里已安装的同名包。

首次安装：

```text
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<绝对路径>/pm-workbench" }
```

或 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <绝对路径>/pm-workbench`。

回滚：删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `pm-workbench` insert 行和 `dsh.profile.bundles` 条目；localStorage 数据不会丢。

## 验证

已做：

- `node --check client.js / index.js / store.js / tools.js`
- `test/smoke.mjs`：tab 类型、pane body、session header 启动器全部注册
- `test/core.mjs`：日期/时间/标签解析、分组、周统计、日历合并、迁移、AI 结果清洗
- `test/host.mjs`：AI 路由、数据路由、baseRev 冲突
- `test/tools.mjs`：工具的新增/查询/更新/删除/统计
- 300px 单列的组件结构按 CSS 固定；未做真实页面截图验证

未做（需要真实页面/可用模型）：

- 右侧栏 300–480px 的实际排版与深浅色对比
- 一键「对话」按钮在真实会话中的发送效果（需要页面）
- 微信机器人实际调用 pm_* 工具的端到端链路（需要微信侧发消息）
- `/pm-workbench/ai` 在真实默认模型下的返回质量与延迟
- 桌面 `dsh-app://` 外壳下 Host 同源请求是否可达（旧版同样限制）

## 已知取舍

- 语言按 `navigator.language` 切换中英文，未接 `ctx.locale`。
- 数据仍在 localStorage：换取零迁移成本，代价是 agent 读不到。需要时再迁 Host 存储域。
- 月视图固定 6 行，窄栏下优先保证日期可点，不做周视图。

No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

--- ## 目录 | 想干的事 | 去哪看 | |---|---| | 看它长什么样、有什么功能 | [它长什么样](#它长什么样) | | 不装插件先试试 | [demo/index.html](demo/index.html) 双击打开 | | 装进 DSH / 卸载 / 出问题自救 | [装进 DSH](#装进-dsh) | | 生词本：收录的词怎么自动有了释义 | [生词本](#生词本收录的词会自动补上释义) | | 搞懂它内部怎么组织的 | [它是怎么工作的](#它是怎么工作的) | | 跑测试 | [测试](#测试) | | 它承诺不做什么（12 条硬约束） | [12 条硬约束](#12-条硬约束) | | 它现在**还做不到**什么（诚实清单） | [已知缺口](#已知缺口诚实清单) | | 开发中踩过的坑（14 个事故） | [docs/INCIDENTS.md](docs/INCIDENTS.md) | --- ## 状态 | 项 | 说明 | |---|---| | 版本 | `0.3.6`（[Releases](https://github.com/wt0812/dsh-vocab-study/releases)） | | 成熟度 | 功能可用、**在真界面里逐条点过**；13 套件 / 644 条断言全绿（详见[测试](#测试)） | | 依赖 | **零**。没有 `node_modules`，不联网、不上报，数据只在本机浏览器里 | | 体积 | `lib/client.js` 5,716,627 B ≈ **5.45 MB**（内含六本词库共 **34,216** 词，见[为什么这么大](#构建)） | | 装法 | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-vocab-study`（npm，推荐）
或 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:wt0812/dsh-vocab-study` | | 国内镜像 | [gitee.com/wutong2005/dsh-vocab-study](https://gitee.com/wutong2005/dsh-vocab-study)（**与 GitHub 逐提交一致**，见下） | | 市场收录 | 已被第三方市场 dshmarket **收录**（[PR #7043](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/7043) 于 2026-10-17 合并） | | 已知缺口 | 见[已知缺口](#已知缺口诚实清单)（8 条，含"未在真实网络环境验证词库拉取"这种） | ### 国内镜像（Gitee） GitHub 在国内时常连不上，所以有一份 Gitee 镜像：**https://gitee.com/wutong2005/dsh-vocab-study** 它和 GitHub **逐提交一致**（HEAD sha 相同，全部提交 + 标签都在）。 我在两边的克隆里各跑过 13 个套件（605 条断言），都是 0 失败。 从 Gitee 装的做法是「先克隆，再装本地目录」（`dsh plugin` 没有 `gitee:` 这种形态）： ```powershell git clone https://gitee.com/wutong2005/dsh-vocab-study.git cd dsh-vocab-study python tools/install.py ``` `install.py` 默认装到 `desktop`（桌面客户端）。要装进浏览器 Web 界面那套 profile， 把脚本里的 `DEFAULT_PROFILE` 指到 `web` 下的同名目录。 > **镜像不是自动同步的**，是我推的。一切以 GitHub 为准。 > 「成熟度」这一行我写得很克制：**能用**是真的（你亲手点过）， > 但它是 0.3.6、只有一个人在用、只有一台机器验过 —— 不是"生产级"。 --- ## 它长什么样 **① 输入框旁那颗胶囊**（`conversation.input.right`，排在「权限」与「模型」之间）： ![输入框旁的胶囊，以及左侧栏底部的眼熟小组件](assets/screenshot-1-capsule.png) > 整个工作区的截图：左边栏底部那张「今天背过的词 ablaze」是 0.3.1 加的眼熟小组件， > 右边是它在对话里怎么被用起来。词库选的是托福，所以一轮只有 3 个词。 **② 右侧栏里的面板 · 卡片背面**（`sidebar.right.pane.tab`，四个页签：今日 / 进度 / 生词本 / 设置）： ![右侧栏面板的卡片背面：常见搭配、词根词缀、词源、同族词](assets/screenshot-2-panel.png) > 这张特意截的是背面 —— 常见搭配、词根词缀、词源、同族词、例句， > 0.2.8 之后卡片才逐项加上这些（`abject`，五项全在）。 | 位置 | 内容 | |---|---| | `conversation.input.right` | 一颗胶囊 `今天第一词`，排在「权限」与「模型」之间 | | `sidebar.right.pane.tab` | 一个叫「今日背单词」的标签页，四个页签：今日 / 进度 / 生词本 / 设置 | > **截图**：上面两张图就在 `assets/` 里（`screenshot-1-capsule.png`、`screenshot-2-panel.png`）， > 同时由 `screenshots.json` 声明，市场详情页会用同一份声明 > （上游 `probe-screenshots.mjs` 从仓库 HEAD 实时读取，不需要另外提 PR）。 ### 四个页签各自的样子 上面那两张是"它长在哪"；下面这四张是**它长什么样** —— 每个页签一张，都是把面板展开到内容结束拍的整图： | 页签 | 一句话 | 图 | |---|---|---| | **今日** | 一张词卡 + 三档评分；下方是今天这批的进度环、KPI、半月热力图 | ![今日](assets/screenshot-3-today.png) | | **进度** | 30 天留存曲线、半月热力图、顽固词榜、需要对着练的混淆对 | ![进度](assets/screenshot-4-progress.png) | | **生词本** | 从对话里收的词，**自动补上音标 + 词性 + 释义**，可以手改 | ![生词本](assets/screenshot-5-vocab.png) | | **设置** | 一轮几个词、加量步长、攻守天平、**字号四档 + 背景色自定义**、数据导入导出 | ![设置](assets/screenshot-6-settings.png) | > 「字号四档 + 背景色自定义」是 0.3.6 加的（用户反馈要的）：字号只放大文字不放大版面， > 背景色支持任意取色、字色按亮度自动翻深翻浅（对比度保证 ≥ 4.5:1）。 > 这一项的验收脚本是 `node tools/verify-appearance.mjs`（真 Chrome 里量计算值 + 窄屏 380px 查溢出）。 > 这四张图是 `node tools/make-releasshots.mjs` 出的，脚本自带两道闸门（裁切区里只能有面板和背景、 > 产出图四角必须是背景色），拍错了会直接报错拒绝出图。 不用它的日子它什么都不做。面板**永远不会自己弹出来**（这是刻意的，见下面「12 条硬约束」）。 ### 背完一轮之后（不是死角） 一轮走完时不再只剩一个「换词库」，而是给三条**各自不同**的出路： | 控件 | 做什么 | 什么时候出现 | |---|---|---| | **再背一轮** | 把刚才这一批**原样重来一遍**（不动记忆数据，不算新词） | 这一轮有内容可重背时 | | **再来 N 个新词** | 往后加量：容器扩大，接在队列后面，**不重复**（N 在设置里可调，默认 5） | 新词闸门开着时 | | **我还是想继续** | 打开新词闸门（安全阀仍然自动触发，只是给了用户自己开门的权力） | 闸门**自动关闭**时 | | 换词库 | 换一本词库 | 始终有，但降到最弱的样式 | 两个容易搞混的数字，故意分开： - **进度环** = **这一轮**（`0/20` → `5/20` → 走完 `5/20`），点「再背一轮」后归零； - **今天已背** = **今天累计**（KPI 里第一个，抽空背 3 个也看得见），跨轮累加、不归零。 > 为什么拆开：环原来用的是跨轮累加的值，点了「再背一轮」之后环显示上一轮的数字， > 和「今天已背」互相矛盾（实测：环说 1、今日说 6）。用户会以为数字坏了。 「再来 N 个」的 **N 可以自己定**（设置页「点「再来几个」时加几个」，3 / 5 / 10，默认 5）—— 加量是用户的决定，不该由插件自作主张定死一个数（P4）。 **新词安全阀**（规格 §7.6）：今天新词错得太多时自动停新词。这是安全阀不是拦路虎 —— 它仍然自动触发，但界面上给一个「我还是想继续」，用户自己决定要不要开。 ![一轮走完的今日页：这一轮走完了、今天已背 3 词、三条出路，下面是今天背过的词](assets/screenshot-7-round.png) > 走完不是空白页：上面写清这一轮走完、今天已背几个词，下面把**今天背过的词**列出来，再给三条出路。 > （这张和上面两张一样是真界面截图；其余四张是脚本从 demo 里拍的。） --- ## 生词本：收录的词会自动补上释义 在对话里选中一个纯英文单词，输入框旁会出现「加入生词本」。点了之后： | 它做什么 | 说明 | |---|---| | **自动补音标 + 词性 + 释义** | 从内置的 29,841 词里**离线**查一遍（`lookupWord`），命中就填上 | | **顺手抓例句** | 把你在对话里选中它的那句话存下来当例句 | | **查不到就留空并说明** | 生词本上标「（还没释义）」，并给一个手填输入框 —— 不编造（P7） | | **手填的会标来源** | 自己填的释义标 `manual`，查到的标 `lookup`，一眼看得出哪个是它自己查的 | **「收服」的意思是：这个词真的记住了，就不该再占着生词本。** 所以判定为收服（记忆强度 ≥ 0.9 **且**拼写答对）之后，它会**自动从生词本移走**， 但不会凭空消失 —— 进「已收服 N 个」的归档，带时间戳，随时能查。 > 这一条以前是坏的：收录进来的词**永远没有释义**，生词本是个空壳 —— > 因为只有几万条释义摆在旁边，代码里却**根本没有查询动作**。 > 症状 → 根因 → 修法见 [排查笔记 · 事故十三](docs/INCIDENTS.md)。 **不熟的词不给提示？给。** 今天错过的词会攒起来，生词本页顶上有一条提示问你要不要一起收进去 —— 但**它只是提示，不会自动加**：加什么进你的生词本是你的决定（P4）。 --- ## 想先看效果，不装插件 ```powershell # 双击即可，纯本地，不需要装任何东西 start demo\index.html ``` `demo/` 是一个自包含的演示页：里面有一个假的 DSH 外壳（对话区 + 输入框 + 工具栏）， 胶囊和面板都是**同一份源码**编译出来的，不是另写的仿制品。 `demo/` 里的几个文件： | 文件 | 用途 | |---|---| | `index.html` | 打开就是这个 demo，可以真的点着背 | | `smoke.html` | 自检页：外壳 11 项检查 + core 自检，全绿才算过 | | `preview.html` | 直接截到「词卡」态（未揭晓） | | `preview-reveal.html` | 截到「已揭晓」态 | | `preview-progress.html` | 截到「进度」页 | | `preview-settings.html` | 截到「设置」页 | | ### 为什么必须「完全退出」而不是刷新页面 `cordis.patch.yml` 是**启动时**读的，客户端模块清单也在启动时扫描并缓存 （客户端半身的机会只有启动那一次）。只按 F5 不够 —— 现象就是「装了、重启了、 界面上什么都没有」。而 `lib/client.js` 的字节变化在刷新后是能生效的（走 `?rev=`）， 所以**改了插件代码只要刷新；改了 `cordis.patch.yml` 必须重启**。 ### 万一重启后客户端起不来了（自救） 如果重启后**整个客户端停在启动页**、弹窗写着「DeepSeek Harness 无法使用」， 按弹窗那个「禁用第三方插件」按钮就能恢复（它会备份 profile patch 再禁用）。 然后**完全退出 DSH**，在本仓库里跑： ```powershell python tools/uninstall.py # 卸干净，回到装之前的状态 ``` 或者临时只改 `cordis.patch.yml`：把末尾 `- id: vocab-study` 那一条删掉（**必须完整重启**）。 这个问题曾经真实发生过一次，根因与修法见 [排查笔记 · 事故二](docs/INCIDENTS.md)。 装插件前跑一遍 `python tools/install.py --dry-run` 可以确认不会动到别的插件。 ### 换用 dsh plugin 命令也可以 ```powershell # 装本机这个开发目录（注意不是 --profile desktop，那个 CLI 会拒绝） dsh plugin --profile web add "F:\DeepSeek Harness\projects\vocab-study" ``` 但它有两个已知副作用，所以本仓库默认用 `tools/install.py`： 1. 它可能把安装位做成**真实副本**而不是联接（于是以后重建产物到不了插件目录）； 2. 它在管理界面里点「停用」会往 `cordis.patch.yml` 写 `disabled: true`，而且 **点「启用」不会删掉那一行** —— 那种状态下 Host 侧显示 `enabled: true / fiberPhase: active`，但客户端半身永远不加载。 `tools/install.py` 每次都会把这两件事纠正过来（重建联接、清掉 `disabled`）。 ### 手动安装（不想用 dsh plugin 命令） **关键：一定要用联接（junction），不要复制文件。** 原因见下面「最大的坑」。 ```powershell $profile = "C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop" $src = "F:\DeepSeek Harness\projects\vocab-study" # 用联接，不要 Copy-Item cmd /c mklink /J "$profile\node_modules\dsh-vocab-study" "$src" # 然后往 $profile\package.json 里补： # dependencies: { "dsh-vocab-study": "file:F:/DeepSeek Harness/projects/vocab-study" } # dsh.profile.bundles 数组末尾加 "dsh-vocab-study" ``` ### 最大的坑：profile 里那份可能是「副本」，不是「联接」 `pnpm install` 装 `file:` 依赖时，**可能把包复制成真实目录**，而不是建联接。 一旦是副本，你在源码目录里 `python tools/build-plugin.py` 重建， **profile 里那份永远不会变** —— 现象就是「改了没反应、刷新也没用」， 而所有测试又是绿的，非常难查。 **判断方法**（PowerShell 的 `LinkType` 属性不可靠，用 fsutil 或 Node）： ```powershell fsutil reparsepoint query "$profile\node_modules\dsh-vocab-study" # "不是重解析点" / "not a reparse point" → 是副本，下面的坑就在你身上 ``` ```javascript // 或者用 Node（最准） const fs = require('fs'); fs.lstatSync(path).isSymbolicLink(); // junction 在 Windows 上也算 true fs.realpathSync(path); // 指向源码目录 = 联接；指向自己 = 副本 ``` **修法**：删掉副本目录，改建联接（本节顶部那行 `mklink /J`）。 **每次重建后自检**（两边大小必须一致）： ```powershell (Get-Item "$src\lib\client.js").Length -eq (Get-Item "$profile\node_modules\dsh-vocab-study\lib\client.js").Length # True = 一致（联接正常）；False = 你在看一份旧副本 ``` ### 第二个坑：插件管理器写的 `disabled: true` 清不掉 在插件管理界面里点「停用」，它会在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写下： ```yaml - id: vocab-study disabled: true ``` **然后在界面里点「启用」并不会删掉这行。** 插件会一直处于停用状态： Host 侧看起来是 `enabled: true / active`（因为运行时的树还记得启用过）， 但**客户端半身永远不加载**，现象就是「装了、重启了、界面上什么都没有」。 **修法**：手动删掉那两行。文件末尾留一条注释提醒自己。 另外注意：`cordis.patch.yml` 是**启动时读取**的，改完必须**完整重启 DSH** （刷新页面没用——客户端清单在启动时就扫描完了）。 --- ## 它是怎么工作的 ### 三层结构，界面与逻辑严格分开 ``` core/ 单测）：ui/pages.mjs 自己登记 setCore({ memory: M_, mistake: MK_, game: G_, queue: Q_, library: L_, beckon: B_ }); // 摊平形态（构建产物）：构建脚本按 CORE_EXPORTS 统一登记 setCore({ memory: { newMemory, encode, ... }, mistake: { ... }, ... }); ``` 读的时候**键名只有全名**，单字母只能当别名： ```js const { queue: Q } = getCore(); // ✅ const { Q } = getCore(); // ❌ Q 是 undefined（构建期就会报错拦下） ``` 这个坑真的踩过：设置页报 `Q.buildDailyContainer is not a 两个脚本读的是**同一份源码**，没有手抄的核心逻辑。 **构建是确定性的**：同一份源码构建两次，产物**逐字节相同**（`lib/` 和 `demo/` 都是）。 产物头里那行构建时间取的是 `core/` 与 `ui/` 里最新的源码修改时间，不是 `datetime.now()`； 也可以用标准的 `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` 环境变量覆盖它。 `test/` 发出去却没带源码，结果装完跑测试 **8 个套件红 5 个** —— > 那是**假红**，比不发测试更坏（会让人以为包是坏的）。 > 现在 `test/` 不进包，`test/core.test.mjs` 里有一条断言守着这件事（会红那种）。 > **要跑测试就克隆仓库**，`test/` 和源码都在那里。 **「600 条断言」是怎么数的**（口径写在这里，免得下次自己都对不上）： 跑 `node tools/count-assertions.mjs` 现算，**每个套件打印的汇总数字 + 该套件 「健全性附加检查」里 ✓ 的条数**。它数的是 **12 个套件 = 600 条**； 第 13 个套件 `test/eye-candy.test.mjs`（5 条，只打 ✓ 不打汇总）还没进那个列表， 所以全量跑（`node tools/make-promo.mjs _promo --count`）是 **13 个套件 / 605 条**。 对外统一说「13 个套件 / 约 600 条断言」。 > 为什么不是只数汇总行：`core.test.mjs` 先打印 `85 通过 / 0 失败`，**之后**才跑一段 > 附加体检，那些 ✓ 不在汇总里。只抓汇总的话，附加检查里加多少条、数字都不动 —— > 我吃过这个亏：新加了 8 条断言，总数还是 372，一度以为没生效。 > 现算明细：`core=108 demo-boot=62 round-control=107 mount=33 plugin=33 bundle-audit=37 client-activation=18 multi-conversation=13 roots=90 weekly-report=26 examples-etym=44 collocations=29 eye-candy=5`。 ### CI 每次推送和 PR 都会在 GitHub Actions 上跑一遍（Node 20 / 22 两档 × Ubuntu）： `.github/workflows/test.yml`。它验四件事，都是**能挡住真问题**的那种： 1. **仓库确实零依赖** —— 出现 `node_modules` 就红（装插件本来也不需要它）； 2. **提交的产物是最新的** —— 重新构建后 `lib/` 有 diff 就红（靠上面那条确定性构建才成立）； 3. **十三个套件全过** + 命名空间清单守卫； 4. **市场收录要的字段没坏** —— `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向的文件真的存在、`dsh.client.platform` 仍是 `web`。 > 第 2 条以前是**做不了**的：构建时间戳用 `datetime.now()`，重新构建必然差一行， > 这条检查永远是假红。是加 CI 的过程中发现并修掉的 —— 见上面「构建」一节。 另外有两个**浏览器里真点一遍**的验证工具（不是单测，需要本机 Chrome）： ```powershell python tools/verify-clicks.py # 真的点胶囊、背完一轮、点每个新按钮，断言状态变化 python tools/render-states.py # 把「开局 / 走完一轮 / 放行之后」三个状态截成一张对比图 ``` > **为什么要"真点一遍"**：这一轮修「背完一轮之后」时，单元测试全绿、截图看着也对， > 但我把按钮真点了一遍，抓到三个**渲染和源码都看不出来**的问题： > > 1. 闸门关着时「再来 5 个新词」**点了什么也没发生** —— 闸门把新词挡住，容器扩了但没有新词进来。 > 一个"点了没反应"的按钮比没有按钮更坏，所以闸门关着时**不显示**它。 > 2. 点「再背一轮」后进度环显示上一轮的数字（环说 1、今日已背说 6），两个数字互相矛盾。 > 3. 点「我还是想继续」后，端上来的居然是**刚背完的那个词** —— > 根因是 `createSession` 无条件把容器里所有条目变成 `answered:false` 的新队列， > 把整个容器丢给它，就等于让用户把刚背的 20 个词原样再背一遍。 > > 教训：**渲染出来 ≠ 能用**。截图能证明"画对了"，证明不了"点下去有反应"。 > 这三个都锁进了 `test/round-control.test.mjs`（第 ⑦ 节）。 > `client-activation`、`bundle-audit`、`mount` 三个都是**真实事故的产物**，而且它们守的是 > 三个**不同的**失效模式，缺一个就会漏： > > - `client-activation` 守「**激活不了**」——插件把整个客户端拦在启动页（事故二）； > - `bundle-audit` 守「**契约写错**」——调了不存在的方法、服务没声明、静默吞异常（事故三前半）； > - `mount` 守「**注册成功了但看不见**」——槽位 `active: true`、存储有痕迹，屏幕上却什么都没有（事故三后半）。 > > 还有第四个失效模式，**上面三套一个都守不住**：界面**画出来了、也在 DOM 里、也不报错**， > 但布局是塌的（事故五：面板只占 32% 高度、内容贴在左边）。这种只能靠 > 「把 `offsetWidth` / `getComputedStyle` 打出来」或截图看出来。 > `bundle-audit` 第 9、10 节是把当时量出来的那两条契约固化了 —— > 它们的特征是**静默失效**：不会抛错，测试也不会红，只有肉眼看得出来。 > `demo-boot` 里那两条「真的点一次」是**故意**这么写的：以前那个 AI 按钮是假的 > （有加载态、有失败文案，看着像"功能正常只是 AI 挂了"），只读代码发现不了； > 而且它还顺带抓出了一个真 bug —— 在「设置」页待过之后切回「今日」，页面会空白 > （`lastCardKey` 没变就跳过重建卡片骨架，`mount(null)` 抛错）。 调试开关： ```powershell $env:VS_DUMP=1; node test/demo-boot.test.mjs # 打印外壳 DOM 树与关键计数 ``` `test/plugin.test.mjs` 是**装进 DSH 之前**的最后一道闸：它用假宿主真的把四个槽位的组件 各实例化一次。这一轮它抓出了 4 个「插件装上了但界面不出现」级别的 bug （命名空间对象在摊平后不存在、TDZ、模板字面量剥离漏掉、ESM 别名残留）。 --- ## 12 条硬约束 下面这些是设计规格里的顶层原则（那份规格不在本仓库里，它写在开发时的工作目录中），实现时当成不可协商的约束： | # | 约束 | 怎么落地的 | |---|---|---| | P1 | 面板永不自作主张 | 胶囊只在那里待着，绝不自动展开；demo 外壳也一样 | | P2 | 不打断当前工作 | 胶囊是输入框旁的普通按钮，不抢焦点、不弹窗 | | P3 | 文案永不指责 | 断签文案是「好久不见」，不是「你落下了」；没有欠债措辞 | | P4 | 加量必须点头 | 「每天几个词」要用户自己调，系统不悄悄加 | | P5 | 任何时刻可离开 | 关面板不丢状态；Esc 把焦点还给输入框 | | P6 | 不阻塞等待 | 词库拉不到就用内置词表；没有语音就静默跳过 | | P7 | 数据诚实 | 「收服」要记忆强度 ≥ 0.9 **且**拼写答对，学了两下不算 | | P8 | 互动不劫持 | 快捷键绑在面板元素上，焦点在输入框时按 1/2/3 完全没反应 | | P9 | 不制造欠债感 | 断签后容器自动缩量（≤14 天 60%，再久 40%），不催补课 | | P10 | 不主动召回 | 没有通知、没有红点、没有倒计时 | | P11 | 进步必须可见 | 进度页有 30 天留存曲线、半月热力图、顽固词榜 | | P12 | 回归门槛低于坚持门槛 | 回来随时能用，缩量后仍然算打卡（≥60% 容器即打卡） | --- ## 已知缺口（诚实清单） 1. **客户端半身需要重启 DSH 才会出现。** 已实测：在 DSH **运行中**把插件装进 profile 后，Host 侧会被 Loader 正常认领 （`include:vocab-study / enabled: true / fiberPhase: active`），但**浏览器里不会长出来**—— 客户端模块清单（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules`）在启动时就完成了扫描， 它按 Loader 条目名逐包做增量对账，且注释明确写着"包元数据（包括『这不是客户端包』 的否定结论）**缓存到重启为止**"。在运行中停用→启用该插件触发重扫，实测**无效**。 **结论：装完必须完整退出 DSH 再打开。** 2. **`isStreaming` 恒为 false。** `adapter/dsh/client.js` 里 `createCapsulePuppet({ core, onOpen })` 的 `isStreaming: () => false`。§3.1 的「交接态」招呼（任务在输出时把胶囊切成 「我先退到一边」）因此暂时不会触发。原因：我无法从 DSH 文档确认客户端能读到的 「本轮是否正在输出」信号（尝试过 Client inspect 查询，它挂在等待页面响应上）。 这是**可降级缺口**：不影响背词，只是少一种招呼文案。 3. **发音依赖系统语音。** `speech.mjs` 用 `speechSynthesis`。没有语音的环境静默跳过，不报错、不挡流程。 4. **`AiPort` 没有实现 —— 记忆钩子是本地算出来的，不是 AI 编的。** 规格 §9 设计了一个 `AiPort` 接口，让 DSH 适配层实现它、由一个模型生成记忆钩子。 本插件的 `AiPort` **仍然是空的**，原因是纯客户端插件拿不到宿主的模型通道 （`lib/index.js` 那个 Host 入口刻意什么都不做）。 所以 `✨ 让我记住它` 现在走 `core/hook.mjs`：**只用词库里真实存在的字段** （词根 / 例句 / 搭配 / 易混词）重组成一句钩子，离线可算、零等待、不编造。产出带 **来源标注**（「· 来自词根」），满足规格 §9「让人看得出它凭什么这么说」； 结果**永久缓存**（§9「每词一生只付一次」），第二次点零等待。 为什么这样做：以前这个按钮是**假的** —— 假装加载 900ms，然后写死一句 「✨ 暂时没编出来 · 重试」。它违反 P7（数据诚实），而且用户永远用不上这个功能。 与其留一个点了必然失败的按钮，不如给一个真的能用的。 以后接上 AI 的正确形态是**叠加**而不是替换：有 AI 时用 AI，AI 挂了回落到本地 结果（§9「AI 挂了不阻塞」）。那时「暂时没编出来」才是一句诚实的失败文案。 5. **词库网络拉取**（这一条原来写的是"未在真实环境验证"，现已实测，附结果）。 实测命令：`NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 HTTPS_PROXY=... node tools/make-seeds.mjs` 之外， 用 `loadCollection(id, {fetcher: 真fetch})` 逐个跑过一遍，结果： | 词库 | 远程词数 | 内置词数 | 状态 | |---|---|---|---| | cet4 | 4565 | **4491**（116 手写 + 4375 补全） | ✅ | | cet6 | 2207 | 5406 | ✅ | | kaoyan | 5304 | 4801 | ✅ | | ielts | **无远程源** | 5040 | 只有内置 | | toefl | 4534 | 6974 | ✅ | | gre | 7779 | 7734 | ✅ | ⚠️ 两个当时才发现的 bug，都记在 `docs/INCIDENTS.md`： - `loadCollection` 用 `meta.urls || SOURCES[c]` 取源，而 `meta.urls` 是空数组 （**真值**），于是 `SOURCES` 里那些 URL 一行都没生效。六个词库全部落到内置， 而且内置又是四级词换个前缀 —— 切到六级拿到的是四级词。 改成按 `.length` 判断。 - `parseWordlist` 只按「制表符 / 2+ 空格」切行，而 CET6 / 考研 / GRE 的源是 **单空格**格式（`abandon [əˈbændən] v. 放弃`）→ 整行被当成一个"单词"丢掉。 实测 CET6 只解出 7 个词、考研 0 个、GRE 1 个。改成**优先按 `[...]` 音标括号切**。 ⚠️ 本地测试需要 `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`：Node 24 的 `fetch` 不自动读 `HTTPS_PROXY`，直连 jsdelivr 会 ECONNRESET。这只影响本机测试，不影响插件运行 （浏览器里 fetch 走系统代理设置）。 6. **`node_modules` 那份安装是联接，跑 `pnpm install` 可能把它换成副本。** 换了以后插件**照旧能用**（副本内容是完整的），只是以后重建产物不会自动生效。 自查与修复办法见下面「最大的坑」，或直接重跑 `python tools/install.py`。 7. **多窗口只读锁是「尽力而为」。** `client-store.mjs` 用 `sessionStorage` 的 tab id + 8 秒租约做单写者。浏览器异常退出 时锁会在 8 秒内自然过期，不会永久卡死；但极端时序下仍可能出现短暂的双写。 8. ~~**胶囊点击不能把右侧栏标签页"拉出来"。**~~ **已修（见[排查笔记 · 事故三](docs/INCIDENTS.md)）。** 当时的判断是错的：`openTab` **确实**在 `ctx.sidebarRight` 上，只是无参形态内部走 `require()` 守卫、侧栏没打开时必抛。正解是带 `sessionId` 走 `openTabIn(sessionId, kind)`， 它走 `actionsFor(sessionId)`，**不要求侧栏已经打开**。 > 这条留在清单里而不是删掉：**"已知缺口"也可能是自己判断错了**。 > 当时把它写成"宿主不提供这个能力"，实际上是"我调错了方法"。 ## 排查笔记（事故记录）→ [docs/INCIDENTS.md](docs/INCIDENTS.md) 开发过程中真实踩过的 13 个坑都记在那份文档里（症状 → 根因 → 修法 → 怎么验的）， **从 README 搬过去单独放，内容一行没删** —— 这样 README 是产品文档，那份是工作日志。 这里只留一条**对其他 DSH 插件作者也有用**的结论，因为它不属于这个插件、属于 DSH： - **纯客户端插件装完之后，必须完全退出 DSH 再打开，刷新页面没用。** 客户端模块清单（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules`）在启动时就扫完了， 之后按 Loader 条目名逐包做增量对账，而包元数据（包括「这不是客户端包」这个 否定结论）会被缓存到**重启为止**。所以运行中装插件，Host 侧会被正常认领， 浏览器里却不会长出来。详见 [已知缺口](#已知缺口诚实清单) 第 1 条。 被搬走的坑里，有几条是**排查方法**而不是产品 bug，同样值得一读： 「别用 `/plugins//client.js` 探测客户端是否加载（那条路由本来就 404）」、 「Host 侧成功不代表客户端会加载，两条链路要分别验」。 ## 目录速查 ``` VOCAB-STUDY-SPEC.md 设计规格（不在本仓库里，写在做它时的上一层目录） package.json dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client.platform 在这里 cordis.patch.yml host 一行条目（不注册服务） core/ store/ ui/ adapter/dsh/ 源码 lib/ 构建产物（client.js / index.js） demo/ 自包含演示与截图页 test/ 八个测试（core / plugin / demo-boot / client-activation / bundle-audit / mount / round-control / multi-conversation） tools/build.py demo 构建 tools/build-plugin.py 插件构建 tools/install.py 正式安装（幂等，可 --dry-run） tools/uninstall.py 卸载（诚实报告失败） ``` > `python tools/verify-clicks.py` 需要本机 Chrome，且**跑之前先清掉残留 chrome 进程** —— > 残留实例会让 `--dump-dom` 卡死（我撞过一次，白等十分钟）。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-vault

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）
插件，把**所有对话和日志保存在工作区文件夹内部**，让工作区文件夹成为自包含、
可移植的存档。

安装 `dsh-vault` 后，每个工作区文件夹里会出现一个 `dsh-session-vault/` 目录：

```
my-project/
  dsh-session-vault/
    workspace.json          # 工作区名称（标题）+ 保险库标记
    sessions/
      <session-id>.jsonl    # 每个会话一个追加式对话日志
```

- 每个 `cwd` 指向该工作区的会话都会在发生时被实时镜像到
  `dsh-session-vault/sessions/`。
- 工作区标题被缓存在 `dsh-session-vault/workspace.json` 里。

## 为什么这样就能在新电脑上恢复

1. 把工作区文件夹（整个目录，包括 `dsh-session-vault/`）复制到新电脑。
2. 在新电脑上安装 DSH 和本插件。
3. 把复制的文件夹作为工作区打开。

打开时，`dsh-vault` 会把保险库里的每个会话导入回 DSH 持久化（并把每个会话的
`cwd` 重新绑定到文件夹当前所在位置），同时从 `workspace.json` 恢复工作区名称。
所有对话——包括工作区名称——都会回来。

## 安装

### DeepSeek Harness 桌面版

在桌面版的**插件管理**里添加插件时，填 GitHub 规格（注意不是包名）：

```
github:XiaoWind/dsh-vault
```

桌面版会在 profile 目录里执行 `pnpm add github:XiaoWind/dsh-vault`，从 GitHub
拉取默认分支的最新 commit，校验通过后把本包加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`。
**安装后按提示重启桌面应用**才会生效。

> **必须使用 `github:owner/repo` 这种规格。** 本插件没有发布到 npm registry，
> 只写 `dsh-vault` 会去 npm 上查找，安装会失败。

> 桌面版在安装时会逐条校验本插件 `peerDependencies` 里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`
> 范围是否接受当前运行时版本（即 `dsh-app-boot` 的版本，例如 `0.2.0-rc.2`）。
> 不兼容时会拒绝安装，并回滚 `package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml` 和
> `node_modules`；遇到这种情况请更新到最新版插件。

### CLI / Web 版

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（立即可用，无需发布到 npm）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XiaoWind/dsh-vault

# 等价写法
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/XiaoWind/dsh-vault.git
```

`dsh plugin` 会把参数转发给 `web` profile 目录内的 `pnpm`，随后自动把该包加入
`dsh.profile.bundles` 层级列表（因为本包声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`）。安装后请
重启 Web 应用。

> 本插件注入 `sessionPersistence`、`workspaceRegistry` 和 `commands` 服务，因此
> 只在包含这些 host 服务的 profile 中生效——官方自带的 `web` profile 就包含它们。

## 更新

**桌面版**：在插件管理里重新安装该插件，或先移除再按
`github:XiaoWind/dsh-vault` 重新添加。pnpm 可能缓存旧的 git 解析结果，移除后重新
添加最可靠；更新后重启桌面应用。

**CLI / Web 版**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-vault
```

`dsh plugin` 会把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 `pnpm update dsh-vault`，把
`github:XiaoWind/dsh-vault` 重新解析到默认分支的最新 commit。锁文件按 commit
钉住 git 依赖，因此不必升级 `version` 也能更新。若 pnpm 因缓存没有拉到新
commit，可显式重新钉一次：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XiaoWind/dsh-vault
```

更新后请重启应用——bundle 层在启动时组合，运行中的进程不会热更已安装的插件。

## 用法

保险库全自动运行，无需额外配置。提供了 `/vault` 斜杠命令用于查看和手动控制：

| 命令 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/vault status` | 查看已保险的工作区及每个工作区的会话数量。 |
| `/vault restore` | 立即为已知工作区导入保险库中的会话/标题。 |
| `/vault export` | 立即把当前持久化数据（重新）写入保险库文件。 |
| `/vault help` | 查看帮助。 |

### 行为说明

- **持续镜像。** 会话每追加事件，就按顺序写入该工作区的
  `dsh-session-vault/sessions/<id>.jsonl`；会话销毁时会把文件重写为一份干净快照。
- **按当前会话格式原样保存头部。** 保险库文件头部的字段集完全跟随宿主会话格式
  （v4 要求 `isSeeded`，并拒绝早已废弃的 `seedLength`），因此插件不会因为宿主
  格式演进丢字段或伪造字段。
- **自动恢复。** 启动时、以及每次打开工作区时，插件都会导入 DSH 持久化中缺失
  的保险库会话，并应用保险库里的标题。在全新电脑上把复制的文件夹作为工作区打开，
  同样会触发恢复。
- **路径可移植。** 导入时会把会话的 `cwd` 重新绑定到工作区当前的绝对路径，因此
  复制到不同位置的文件夹也能干净恢复。
- **幂等。** 已存在于持久化中的会话不会被重复导入；无需变更时，挂载/重命名不会
  产生任何写入。
- **记录会自动补全。** 插件只在自己运行期间镜像事件；如果某个会话在插件未加载时
  （切换运行时、重装插件等）继续追加事件，这一段就不会进入保险库文件。会话再次
  打开时，插件会比对文件与内存中的完整日志并补全文件；会话销毁时也会写入完整
  快照。`/vault export` 则按当前持久化数据强制重写全部保险库文件，可随时彻底修复。
- **记录只会被补全，不会被缩短。** 插件只在能读到会话完整日志时才重写记录；读不到
  日志时只补建缺失的头部，绝不拿一份"空日志"覆盖已有记录。任何重写若会让文件丢掉
  已有事件（记录末尾的 `seq` 比日志更靠后），都会被拒绝并记录一条警告。DSH 0.2.1
  把 `session.events` 换成了 `snapshotEvents()`，旧写法曾因此把若干条记录写成只剩
  头部；现在两种形状都支持。
- **空壳记录自动修复。** 若保险库记录只剩头部、而 DSH 持久化里该会话仍有内容
  （按存储产物大小判断），启动导出流程会从持久化重新写回整份记录。被误清空的记录
  在重启后会自动恢复，不需要手动操作。
- **不完整的记录按"能还原多少就还原多少"处理。** DSH 的持久化日志必须是 `seq` 从 0
  开始、逐条连续的序列。
  - **缺少开头**（记录从 `seq 6` 开始）：开头的事件已无来源，把后面的事件当成 0 号会
    篡改历史，因此整条记录会被跳过，并在日志里写明原因（`its log starts at seq 6`）。
  - **中间有缺口、开头完整**：插件会导入缺口之前那段连续的**前缀**，让会话结束在缺口
    处——崩溃的会话本来就是这个形态——同时记一条警告说明有多少条后续事件无法到达
    （例如 `restoring session "…" up to seq 1078: 2 later event(s) are unreachable
    because its log has a hole`）。这样丢一条事件不会毁掉整段对话。
  - 想要完整记录，请在源机器上执行 `/vault export`（按持久化重写），或把会话再打开
    一次让插件补全，然后再复制。
- **持久化里"已存在"但更短的会话会被检查。** 恢复只导入"持久化里没有"的会话，但
  *已存在不等于完整*：同一段对话在另一台机器上继续过（工作区文件夹通过 Syncthing /
  OneDrive 等同步，保险库记录被同步过来，而会话存储 `~/.dsh/sessions` 是每台机器各自
  的），或者日志被崩溃截断，都会留下一个很短的会话把保险库内容永久挡住。插件会在
  启动和 `/vault restore` 时比较两者：
  - **存储里的日志是记录的真前缀**：把记录多出来的连续事件**追加**进去，会话直接恢复
    完整（会写入 `info` 日志说明补了多少条）。
  - **已经分叉**（后面的事件对不上，例如中间插入了新的"恢复"标记或别的命令）：**不拼**，
    因为把旧历史接在新事件之后会伪造出从未发生过的顺序。此时只记录一条明确警告并给出
    处理办法：`session "…" holds 49 of 1587 vaulted event(s) but diverged at seq 40, so
    it cannot be extended; delete this session in DSH and run /vault restore to rebuild it
    from the vault`，`/vault restore` 的回复里也会说明需要重建几个会话。
  - 为了不拖慢启动，启动时的比较以"存储产物远小于记录"为门槛（约 8 倍）；`/vault
    restore` 会强制逐个比较。
- **缺失的图片附件会被标记为"已卸载"。** 保险库镜像的是会话日志，**不含附件二进制**
  （图片按内容寻址存放在 `<DSH_HOME>/attachments/v1/objects/`）。会话被复制到另一台
  机器后，日志里的图片引用仍在、字节却不在，而宿主会在发请求前逐个读取这些图片——
  读取失败会以与文件无关的 `DeepSeek Messages transport failed` 形式报错，导致**每一轮
  都失败**。插件在会话打开时会检测这种缺失，并按 DSH 自己的机制追加一条
  `image/offload` 事件，把该图片替换为文本占位；对话随即恢复可用，缺的只是那几张图。
  重新打开会话（或重启应用）即可触发这次修复。

  > 这是已知边界：**图片/附件不随保险库迁移**。需要完整保留图片时，请把
  > `<DSH_HOME>/attachments/v1` 一并复制。

## 配置

无需配置。插件以空 `config` 插入；保险库目录名（`dsh-session-vault`）和 JSONL
格式是固定的，以保证不同机器之间的保险库可以互换。

每个保险库的 `workspace.json` 还带有 `kind: "dsh-vault"` 标记，因此插件按内容
识别保险库，而不只依赖目录名。

## 开发

```sh
# 语法检查
node --check lib/index.js
node --check lib/vault.js
```

插件是无第三方依赖的 ESM（`lib/index.js` + `lib/vault.js`），无需构建步骤。它导出
`apply`、`inject`、`name`，并由 bundle 层 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入到 profile 组合中。
JSONL 格式是自包含的、独立于 harness，因此 `lib/vault.js` 可直接做单元测试。
